fdroid:com.fauxx.full.name: Fauxx - Privacy Through Deception
fdroid:com.fauxx.full.summary: Poison data collection profiles by generating decoy signals.
fdroid:com.fauxx.full.description:
Fauxx runs believable fake browsing in the background, so the companies that profile you can't tell your real interests from the decoys. The decoy activity looks like real people with different interests from yours, not random noise that is easy to filter out.
HOW IT WORKS
Fauxx quietly searches, visits pages and makes DNS lookups across many topics, as a made-up person with a stable device identity. Your real interests get buried under a steady stream of coherent decoy activity, so data brokers and ad networks can't tell which "you" is real.
FEATURES
• Searches on Google, Bing, DuckDuckGo, Yahoo and Yandex about topics far from your real interests; switch off any engine you want to spare
• Visits to a wide range of websites across dozens of topics
• Ad profile pollution: loads ad-heavy pages so ad networks see interests that aren't yours (it never clicks ads)
• Synthetic personas: a fake person with their own interests and one believable phone, replaced by a new persona every 30 to 90 days
• Separate cookies and site storage for each persona, on recent versions of Android System WebView
• Decoys steer away from you: optionally tell Fauxx about yourself, or import your advertising data from Google Takeout or Facebook
• Add your own searches and sites, such as local news in your language
• Optional custom DNS (encrypted DNS-over-HTTPS or a plain DNS server) for Fauxx's own traffic, so a Pi-hole or VPN that blocks tracker domains does not stop it
• DNS lookups for a wide spread of domains
• Natural timing: random gaps between actions and a daily rhythm, only during the hours you choose
• Full activity log with CSV, JSON and HTML export
• No accounts, no cloud storage, no analytics, no telemetry
OPTIONAL: TELL FAUXX ABOUT YOURSELF
Tell Fauxx your age range, gender, interests, profession and region, and its decoys will steer away from them. You can skip every question; the decoys then follow the synthetic personas alone.
PRIVACY FIRST
• Everything stays on your device
• Your profile, imported ad data and activity log are kept in an encrypted database (SQLCipher, with the key protected by the Android Keystore). App settings are stored unencrypted in the app's private storage.
• No analytics, no advertising identifiers, and no automatic crash reports: after a crash, Fauxx asks before you share a report
• Fully open source, so you can inspect the code
• Clear All Data wipes everything at once
Fauxx is free, open source and contains no ads.

fdroid:net.quietrebellion.name: Quiet Rebellion

fdroid:net.quietrebellion.description:
Quiet Rebellion gives you full control over your Bose QC Ultra Headphones (2nd Gen) directly over Bluetooth — without the Bose app, without a cloud account, and without sending any data off your device.
It implements the BMAP protocol (Bose Messaging and Protocol), the same protocol the official app uses, accessed through the unauthenticated SETGET and START operators. No keys are extracted, no encryption is broken, no traffic is replayed.
 Supported device 
Bose QuietComfort Ultra Headphones (2nd Gen) — codename "wolverine"
 Noise Control 
- ANC level 0–10 (0 = full isolation, 10 = full awareness)
- Wind Block on/off
- Spatial Audio: Off / Room / Head
 Sound 
- 3-band graphic equalizer (Bass / Mid / Treble, –10 to +10 dB)
- Sidetone level (Off / Low / Medium / High)
- Self Voice Persistence toggle: keep sidetone behavior persistent across context changes (experimental)
 Listening Modes 
- Switch between Quiet, Aware, Immersion, Cinema
- Custom mode slots (up to 7 user profiles)
- Favourite modes — mark modes with ★, long-press any mode to toggle
 Connections 
- Multipoint on/off
- Switch active audio source between paired devices (names resolved from headphone memory)
- Enter Bluetooth pairing mode
 Device Settings 
- Auto Play/Pause (pause when headphones removed)
- Auto-answer calls
- Device rename
- Power off
 Appearance 
- Two built-in themes: Fresh & Clean (cyan) and Monochrome, each in Light and Dark
- Material You (Android 12+): colours follow your wallpaper
- Tap the settings icon (top right) to switch themes
 System Integration 
- Persistent foreground notification — connection stays alive when the app is in the background
- Notification actions: ANC toggle · Switch to [next mode] · Power Off
- Mode cycling respects your favourite list
 Requirements 
- Android 8.0+ (API 26)
- Bose QC Ultra Headphones (2nd Gen) already paired via Android Bluetooth settings
- The Bose app must not be running while this app is active (both hold the RFCOMM channel)
 Privacy 
No network access. No analytics. No accounts. All communication is local Bluetooth only.
 Open Source 
Source code: github.com/MadEyez/quietrebellion 
Fork of the original aaronsb/bosectl protocol library.

fdroid:org.y20k.voxscribe.name: Voxscribe - Offline Voice Input
fdroid:org.y20k.voxscribe.summary: Voxscribe is an offline voice keyboard that transcribes speech on-device.
fdroid:org.y20k.voxscribe.description:
Voxscribe is an offline voice-input keyboard (input method) for Android. Hold the mic button to record; your speech is transcribed entirely on-device with whisper.cpp using a Whisper model file you supply yourself, and the result is written into the focused text field.
Voxscribe is free software. It is published under the MIT open-source license. Voxscribe uses whisper.cpp for on-device transcription, which is also free software published under the MIT license.
 SETUP 
Voxscribe does not ship a speech model. You download one yourself and point the app at it.
 Download a Whisper model file in GGML format from the Hugging Face repository ggerganov/whisper.cpp: https://huggingface.co/ggerganov/whisper.cpp/tree/main 
Recommended files:
 ggml-base-q5_1.bin (~60 MB), the recommended default
 ggml-small-q5_1.bin (~190 MB), better quality but slower
 ggml-tiny-q5_1.bin (~32 MB), for older or weak devices
Use a multilingual model only. The .en (English-only) variants break both language modes.
 Open Voxscribe, tap "Model file", and pick the file you downloaded.
 Under "Setup", tap "Enable Voxscribe keyboard" and turn Voxscribe on in the system keyboard settings.
 Under "Setup", tap "Microphone permission" and allow recording. You can also grant it the first time you hold the mic button.
 In any text field, switch to Voxscribe with the keyboard's mic button or the system input-method switcher, then hold the mic button to record and release to insert the transcript.
 FEATURES 
 Offline, on-device transcription, so nothing leaves your phone
 Push-to-talk: hold to record, release to transcribe
 Two favourite languages to switch between on the panel, or automatic language detection
 Light and dark themes, plus Material You dynamic colors
 A WORD ON PRIVACY 
Voxscribe works entirely on your device. Your speech is recorded while you hold the mic button, transcribed locally by whisper.cpp. There is no web service behind Voxscribe. The Whisper model stays wherever you saved it. The only permission Voxscribe requests is microphone access, needed to record your voice. Voxscribe does not hold the INTERNET permission. It cannot transmit data.

fedora-packages:bcel/bcel.name: bcel
fedora-packages:bcel/bcel.description: The Byte Code Engineering Library (formerly known as JavaClass) is intended to give users a convenient possibility to analyze, create, and manipulate (binary) Java class files (those ending with .class). Classes are represented by objects which contain all the symbolic information of the given class: methods, fields and byte code instructions, in particular. Such objects can be read from an existing file, be transformed by a program (e.g. a class loader at run-time) and dumped to a file again. An even more interesting application is the creation of classes from scratch at run-time. The Byte Code Engineering Library (BCEL) may be also useful if you want to learn about the Java Virtual Machine (JVM) and the format of Java .class files. BCEL is already being used successfully in several projects such as compilers, optimizers, obsfuscators and analysis tools, the most popular probably being the Xalan XSLT processor at Apache.

fedora-packages:cddlib/cddlib.description: The C-library cddlib is a C implementation of the Double Description Method of Motzkin et al. for generating all vertices (i.e. extreme points) and extreme rays of a general convex polyhedron in R^d given by a system of linear inequalities: ``` P = { x=(x1, ..., xd)^T : b - A∙x ≥ 0 } ``` where `A` is a given `m×d` real matrix, `b` is a given `m`-vector and `0` is the `m`-vector of all zeros. The program can be used for the reverse operation (i.e. convex hull computation). This means that one can move back and forth between an inequality representation and a generator (i.e. vertex and ray) representation of a polyhedron with cdd. Also, cdd can solve a linear programming problem, i.e. a problem of maximizing and minimizing a linear function over `P`.

firefox-addons:2861739.name: AliExpress Price Tracker
firefox-addons:2861739.summary: Track prices, set alerts, compare sellers, and analyze trends for products on AliExpress with AliPricePro, your all-in-one shopping companion.
firefox-addons:2861739.description:
AliPricePro is your ultimate shopping companion on AliExpress. This powerful Firefox extension allows you to track product prices, set custom alerts, compare prices from multiple sellers, and analyze price trends over time—all directly within your browser. Whether you’re a casual shopper looking for the best deals or a seasoned bargain hunter, AliPricePro simplifies the process, ensuring you never miss out on the best prices.
With AliPricePro, you can effortlessly monitor the prices of your favorite products. The extension inserts a "Track Price" button directly onto AliExpress product pages. With just one click, you can start tracking prices and receive notifications whenever there’s a change in the price—whether it’s an increase or a decrease. The extension also allows you to compare prices from different sellers for the same product, giving you a broader view of your purchasing options.
In addition, AliPricePro keeps a detailed history of price changes, enabling you to analyze trends and make informed decisions. You can view this history and even set alerts to notify you when a product’s price drops below your desired amount.
Features:
Track Prices: Monitor the prices of your favorite products on AliExpress with a single click.
Multi-Seller Comparison: Compare prices from multiple sellers to ensure you’re getting the best deal.
Price History & Trend Analysis: View detailed price histories and analyze trends over time.
Custom Alerts: Set alerts to be notified when a product’s price drops below a specified threshold.
User-Friendly Interface: Easily manage your tracked products, view histories, and set alerts through the popup dashboard.
Automatic Background Price Checks: The extension automatically checks for price updates at regular intervals, so you don’t have to.
Usage:
Install the AliPricePro extension on your Firefox browser.
Visit any AliExpress product page.
Click the "Track Price" button at the top-right corner of the page to start tracking the product's price.
Open the extension’s popup dashboard to view tracked products, price histories, and set alerts.
Receive notifications when there’s a change in the tracked product's price or when it meets your alert criteria.

firefox-addons:2641439.name: Live Stream Downloader
firefox-addons:2641439.summary: Download M3U8 HLS Streams (HTTP Live Stream) to your local disk
firefox-addons:2641439.description:
This extension detects M3U8 streaming formats on the active tab and offers to download these segmented streams as a single file to the user's local disk. 
This extension detects all possible video qualities and uses direct disk writing to store segments. So there is no need to have a recovery plan from a possible crash. Your data is written instantly to the local file and is ready to use. It also merges all segments automatically when the file is fetched. To improve download capability, the extension also sets the referrer header of the original page.
This extension uses multiple threads to download the HLS stream to increase the downloading speed and stability. Also, it supports resuming the download process when there is a network failure (Thanks to the TDM.JS engine).
How to use it:
1. Go to a streaming website like https://videojs.com/ 
2. Wait until the toolbar color changes
3. Click on the toolbar button once to select a quality
4. Wait until the download is over. You can see the progress as a badge text.
Features:
1. Download HSL Streams
2. Detect any audio, video, or media streams on the active tab
3. Uses multi-threading to increase download speed
4. Write directly to the disk
5. Supports detecting many audio and video formats
6. Retries several times to fetch each segment even if downloading is broken or you get disconnected from the internet for a short period.
7. Keep awake while downloading a file (this feature is optional; use Ctrl + P or Command + P when the interface is open to enable it)
8. Download any arbitrary file with multiple threads and network failure protection (copy the link and use Ctrl + V or Command + V to add it as a new job to the interface)
9. Unlimited retires. The extension uses multiple threads to fetch the data as fast as possible. If a thread breaks, the extension retries several times to reconnect to the server. Even after multiple tries, the extension pauses the downloading process and displays a prompt to resume when the network issue is fixed.
10. Suitable to download very large files for two reasons: 1) It is the fastest downloader because of multiple thread fetching. 2) it writes directly to the disk, so there is no need to move the file from the internal storage to the local disk later.
Use Cases:
1. You want to store a multi-segmented stream to your local disk for later use.
2. On an unstable network, you can use this extension to fetch a video file and start watching it with your media player even when it is not yet fully downloaded.
Extra Features:
1. You can download any file with this tool. Just drag and drop the link to the interface. Since it uses multiple simultaneous threads to fetch data, you can get the file a lot faster. Also, the downloader is protecting you against network failures and resumes interrupted downloads.
2. This downloader writes directly to the disk and can handle a download speed of about 300 MBytes / seconds. This is the best you can get even with native download managers.
Content Creators:
If for any reason, you want this extension to ignore your website, please open a bug report on the GitHub repository.

firefox-addons:706537.name: Passwordstate
firefox-addons:706537.summary: Autofill logins and one-time passwords, save new logins, use passkeys and generate passwords from your Passwordstate server.
firefox-addons:706537.description:
Passwordstate is the on-premise enterprise password manager from Click Studios. This extension connects your browser to your organisation's Passwordstate server, so the logins you are allowed to use are ready on the sites you visit.
ALL-NEW FOR PASSWORDSTATE 10
This version has been rebuilt from the ground up, with a redesigned interface, passkey support, and autofill built for the way modern sites sign you in.
SIGN IN FASTER
• Autofill usernames and passwords on the sites you have saved logins for.
• Fill or copy one-time passwords (TOTP) for logins that use two-factor authentication.
• Handles sign-ins split across several steps or screens.
• Choose between logins when more than one matches a site.
• See at a glance from the toolbar icon how many logins match the current site.
• Search all of your records from the toolbar, copy usernames, passwords and one-time codes, and open the site or the record in Passwordstate.
PASSKEYS
• Create passkeys on sites that support them and save them to a Passwordstate record.
• Sign in with a saved passkey from any browser where the extension is installed.
• Remove a passkey from a record when you no longer need it.
• Anything Passwordstate can't handle is passed to your browser's built-in passkey support.
SAVE AND GENERATE
• Save new logins to Passwordstate as you sign in to sites, and update saved logins when a password changes.
• Generate strong passwords using the password generator policies set on your server.
• Choose the default Password List and Password Generator for new logins.
MAKE IT FIT YOUR SITES
• Control how a login's URL is matched to the sites you visit.
• Map a login's fields to a site's form when it isn't detected automatically.
• Tell the extension to ignore sites you don't want it to work on.
• Turn autofill and the in-field icons on or off.
• Light and dark themes.
FILLING AND COPYING
• Checks that login fields are visible before filling them.
• Can clear copied passwords from the clipboard after a set time.
• Optional confirmation before every fill, set by your administrators.
BUILT FOR THE ENTERPRISE
• Works with your organisation's own Passwordstate server.
• Access follows the permissions set in Passwordstate, including time-limited access, and activity is recorded in its audit log.
• Supports records that must be checked out or need a reason for access.
• Protected by a master password, with unlock options controlled by your administrators.
• Administrators control who can use the extension and which features are available.
REQUIREMENTS
This extension requires a Passwordstate server and cannot be used on its own. Some features need a recent Passwordstate build. Ask your Passwordstate administrator for your server's address, then pair the extension to it the first time you open it.
Find out more at https://www.clickstudios.com.au

firefox-addons:778246.name: Password Depot Extension
firefox-addons:778246.summary: Connects Firefox to Password Depot — the award-winning, German-engineered password manager. Auto-fill logins, passkeys, and TOTP codes. Your passwords stay where you choose — never on our servers.
firefox-addons:778246.description:
This extension connects Firefox to Password Depot — the award-winning password manager developed in Germany since 1998. It is not a standalone tool: it communicates with the Password Depot desktop client via secure Native Messaging to auto-fill credentials, passkeys, and TOTP codes directly from your encrypted database.
 🔒 Your data. Your choice. Your control. 
Unlike cloud-only password managers, Password Depot never requires you to store passwords on third-party servers. You decide where your encrypted database lives:
 On your local PC or USB drive
 In your own cloud (Dropbox, Google Drive, OneDrive, Box, HiDrive, or any WebDAV service)
 On a Password Depot Enterprise Server within your organization
Your passwords never leave the infrastructure you trust — ideal for privacy-conscious users and organizations that require full data sovereignty and GDPR compliance.
 ⚡ Completely rebuilt for v19 
This is a brand-new extension, written from the ground up with a modern Manifest V3 architecture and a new client API. Key capabilities:
 Credential auto-fill — Detects login forms and fills usernames and passwords automatically
 Passkey support — Register and authenticate with WebAuthn/FIDO2 passkeys stored in Password Depot
 TOTP/2FA auto-fill — Fills one-time codes automatically, even across multi-page login flows
 Password generator — Create strong passwords directly in the browser with configurable options and strength indicator
 Breach checker — Verify whether a password has been exposed in known data breaches (via HaveIBeenPwned)
 Credential capture — Detects new logins and offers to save them to Password Depot
 Secure clipboard — Automatically clears copied passwords after a configurable timeout
 🌐 Built for the modern web 
 Works with login forms inside iframes and cross-origin frames
 Full Shadow DOM support for web components
 Compatible with React, Vue, Angular, and other modern frameworks
 Handles multi-step login flows across page navigations
 Works seamlessly with modal dialogs (Radix UI, HeadlessUI, etc.)
 🎨 Designed for comfort 
 Light, Dark, and System themes
 Available in English, German, French, Spanish, and Dutch
 Quick-access popup with search, one-click copy, and password generator
 Configurable settings for security and behavior
 🏆 Backed by 25+ years of German security engineering 
Password Depot is developed by AceBIT GmbH in Darmstadt, Germany. Certified by SySS GmbH — Germany's leading penetration testing firm. Trusted by over 100,000 customers. Member of TeleTrusT e.V. AES-256 encryption. No backdoors.
Download Password Depot: https://www.password-depot.de/en/download/download.htm 
 ⚠️ Requirements 
This extension requires Password Depot v19.0.4 or newer .
The native client must be installed before the extension can function.
 Note for users of Password Depot versions prior to 19: 
This extension uses a new client API and cannot connect to older Password Depot clients. If you are using Password Depot 18 or earlier, please install extension version 18.0.3 instead:
 https://addons.mozilla.org/en-US/firefox/addon/password-depot/versions/ 
We also recommend disabling automatic extension updates in Firefox to prevent unintended upgrades.

bluejetty:00073087:ios.summary: Water Sort Puzzle: Fun SortPuz is an engaging and addictive game that challenges players to unravel colorful liquid-based puzzles. Dive into a world where logic and strategy meet vibrant aesthetics, and immerse yourself in the captivating t
bluejetty:00073087:ios.description:
Water Sort Puzzle: Fun SortPuz is an engaging and addictive game that challenges players to unravel colorful liquid-based puzzles. Dive into a world where logic and strategy meet vibrant aesthetics, and immerse yourself in the captivating task of sorting and merging water-filled containers. With its intuitive gameplay and visually appealing design, this game offers hours of entertainment for puzzle enthusiasts of all ages.
The objective of Water Sort Puzzle: Fun SortPuz is to rearrange a collection of differently colored containers, each filled with various hues of water. Your task is to organize the containers in a way that all the liquids match, creating complete sets of colors. However, there’s a catch – you can only pour the water from one container to another if the target container has enough space to accommodate the liquid. This adds an exciting element of strategy, as you must carefully plan your moves to successfully complete each puzzle.
As you progress through the game, the complexity of the puzzles increases, challenging your problem-solving skills and putting your logical thinking to the test. You’ll encounter increasingly intricate arrangements of containers, requiring you to analyze the colors, sizes, and available space in order to make the perfect moves. With hundreds of unique levels to conquer, Water Sort Puzzle: Fun SortPuz offers a never-ending journey of brain-teasing entertainment.
The game features a user-friendly interface, designed to provide a seamless and immersive experience. The intuitive controls allow you to effortlessly pour and merge the water, making it accessible to both casual and experienced players. The visually stunning graphics and mesmerizing liquid animations add a delightful touch, enhancing the overall enjoyment of the game.
Water Sort Puzzle: Fun SortPuz also offers a range of additional features to enhance the gameplay. You can earn rewards and bonuses by completing levels with the fewest moves possible, adding an element of competition and encouraging replayability. The game also provides hints and tips to assist you when you encounter particularly challenging puzzles, ensuring that you never get stuck for too long.
Whether you’re looking for a relaxing way to unwind or a stimulating mental challenge, Water Sort Puzzle: Fun SortPuz has something for everyone. Immerse yourself in a world of vibrant colors, captivating puzzles, and strategic thinking. Download the game today and embark on a captivating journey through an enchanting liquid-filled realm. Get ready to pour, merge, and conquer the fascinating puzzles that await!
This game has a subscription-based premium feature package, it enables users to use the app without advertisements and with extra features. It's an auto-renewable subscription. The subscription period is weekly. Payment is charged to the App Store account at confirmation. Subscription is renewed unless turned off 24 hours before the end of the period, and the account will be automatically charged for renewal as well. You may turn it off in your Account Settings anytime.
Privacy Policy: https://pofudukgames.com/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://pofudukgames.com/terms-conditions

bluejetty:00146511:ios.description:
Play Cooking Stories, the ultimate time management game that will satisfy your craving for fun! Manage your cafe, renovate, decorate, and conquer the culinary world!
Are you passionate about fashion, cooking, and interior design? Perfect! In Cooking Stories, you're the producer of a trendy cooking makeover show. Embark on wild adventures as you balance time management, cooking skills, and creative design!
RESTAURANT AND CAFE MANAGEMENT
Every new star gives you a cafe or restaurant to manage with your culinary and time management expertise. Choose what to upgrade, pick the best menu, and keep your guests happy! Master dishes and drinks from global cuisines, ensuring each star’s restaurant achieves top ratings with your help!
TRANSFORM STARS AND THEIR HOMES
With your expert design skills, transform the stars' homes to reflect their unique personalities. Whether it’s Art Deco, Loft, or Classic, you'll create stunning interiors while keeping your time management sharp.
STAY ON-TREND WITH MAKEUP
Guide the makeup artist team in selecting the perfect look! From lipstick shades to hairstyles, your decisions will ensure the stars look their best under the spotlight.

bluejetty:00153144:ios.description:

Encrypted VPN Protection: Browse securely with advanced encryption that keeps your internet activity and personal information away from prying eyes. Protexo's VPN creates a secure tunnel for your data.

Download Play The Bible for free and enjoy this unique, patent-pending word matching game and learn Bible verses while you have fun playing through!
You can play awhile every day for free, forever, as your moves regenerate one every minute
bluejetty:00015591:ios.description:
Download Play The Bible for free and enjoy this unique, patent-pending word matching game and learn Bible verses while you have fun playing through!
You can play awhile every day for free, forever, as your moves regenerate one every minute. Really! But if you want even more - get unlimited play by either 1) sharing with friends and/or 2) by using real money to acquire gold bars. The choice is yours.
Find your way through beautifully tiled scripture as you set off an epic chain reaction of matching colored words. Unlock new Bible verses for your favorite characters by progressing through the game or by unlocking them early.
You can use Fireballs to clear a word, an Iceboom to clear a line, an Electrocon to clear 3 lines or a Lightstrike to clear an entire verse! Play with a brilliant Angel who helps you progress through the game, one verse after another.
Earn Spirit Points by answering a question after playing every verse to earn more gold.
Take on Play The Bible alone or play with friends to see who can achieve the highest level!
Multiplayer games can be customized for friends to play one-on-one or with groups of 10, 20, 50 or more, and you can customize the multiplayer experience for each and every verse.
Play The Bible features:
• Stunning graphics and effects in beautiful, colored tiles for each verse
• Highlight all the letters of each word to progress through each level
• Play The Bible through the verses containing your favorite characters in more than 31,000 Bible verses
• Game play becomes more challenging as levels progress, as you learn to avoid strange tiles and those on-fire
• Wisdom Breaks give you an opportunity to focus on encouraging words from the ancient texts - featuring value verses
• Bonus Rounds give you a chance to earn gold bars and get more moves as you match colors to words for each verse
• Character Progress shows you how you are progressing while learning about your favorite characters in each scripture verse
• New game preview
• Add a church feature
• New tutorial video
• Easy and fun to play, challenging to master
• Easily sync the game between devices (progress but not gold) and unlock full game features when playing while connected to the Internet
• Great fun for Sunday school lessons and activities, too
• A great evangelism tool! Become as knowledgable as a disciple, learning more every day
• A fantastic Christian Bible game for those interested in becoming more Godly and closer to Christ
In the event you do not desire to allow anyone playing our game to acquire gold bars with real money, you can turn off the payment feature by disabling in-app purchases in your device's settings.

bluejetty:00075182:ios.name: AO Office
bluejetty:00075182:ios.summary:
AO Office is the world's first porting of OpenOffice for iOS and it's a powerful and complete office suite for OpenOffice / LibreOffice documents.
You can view, edit, import, and export PDF, Word, Excel & PowerPoint documents using full fe
bluejetty:00075182:ios.description:
AO Office is the world's first porting of OpenOffice for iOS and it's a powerful and complete office suite for OpenOffice / LibreOffice documents.
You can view, edit, import, and export PDF, Word, Excel & PowerPoint documents using full features of the OpenOffice in the PC version.
AO Office has 5 components:
Writer: a word processor you can use for anything from writing a quick letter to producing an entire book.
Calc: a powerful spreadsheet with all the tools you need to calculate, analyze, and present your data in numerical reports or graphics.
Impress: the fastest, most powerful way to create effective multimedia presentations.
Draw: lets you produce everything from simple diagrams to dynamic 3D illustrations.
Math: lets you create mathematical equations with a graphic user interface or by directly typing your formulas into the equation editor.
* AO Office is a forked project from the Apache OpenOffice project.
AO Office is not affiliated with the Apache OpenOffice and LibreOffice projects.
■ Features ■
- View / edit / import / export documents
- High reproducibility for Open Document Format
- Export and import documents as PDF
- Formatting paragraphs
- Create stylized text with special effects
- Support for extensive file formats
- Support for embedded object
- Support for Dropbox / iCloud Drive / Google Drive / OneDrive / Box
- Support for NAS / WebDAV (Paid version only)
- Support for Audio and Video
- Support for recovering the unsaved work
- Support for modern encryption
- Support for Markdown documents
■ Supported File Formats ■
AO Office can open and save to:
- Microsoft Word (DOC / DOT / RTF)
- Microsoft Word 2007 (DOCX / DOTX / DOCM)
- Microsoft Excel (XLS / XLT)
- Microsoft Excel 2007 (XLSX / XLTX / XLSM)
- Microsoft PowerPoint (PPT / POT)
- Microsoft PowerPoint 2007 (PPTX / POTX / PPTM)
- OpenDocument (ODT / ODS / ODP / ODG / ODF)
- Portable Document Format (PDF)
- OpenOffice.org1.0 / StarOffice6.0 (SXW / SXC / SXD / SXI / SXG / SXM)
- Text (TXT / CSV / XML)
- HyperText Markup Language (HTML)
- Markdown (MD / MARKDOWN)
- Adobe Photoshop (PSD)
- Scalable Vector Graphics (SVG)
- Windows Metafile (EMF / WMF)
- Tagged Image File Format (TIFF)
- Data Interchange Format (DIF)
- SYLK (SLK)
- Portable Anymap Format (PBM / PGM / PPM)
- OS/2 Metafile (MET)
- Sun Raster Image (RAS)
- Mac Pict (PCT)
- X PixMap (XPM)
- StarView Metafile (SVM)
AO Office can open:
- WordPerfect Document (WPD)
- AutoCAD (DXF)
- T602 Document (602)
- Computer Graphics Metafile (CGM)
- Truevision Targa (TGA)
- X Bitmap (XBM)
- Zsoft Paintbrush (PCX)
- Kodak Photo CD (PCD)
AO Office can save to:
- PlaceWare (PWP)
- Macromedia Flash (SWF)
- JPG / GIF / PNG / BMP
■ Gesture Assignments ■
- Hard Press or 2 Finger Tap = Context Menu
- Pinch In & Out = Zoom In & Out
- Drag = Scrolling
- Drag with Hard Press or 2 Finger Tap = Drag & Drop
■ Limitations ■
- Not supported for macro
■ Contact Us ■
Email: support-ios@aooffice.app
Twitter: @office700
The paid version includes the following functions.
· Access to cloud storages
· Printing
- Export as PDF
· Other useful functions

FREE FOREVER

bluejetty:00073882:ios.description:
Explore the connection between your diet and health with mySymptoms. Easily track your meals, symptoms, and share detailed journals with your clinicians. Our sophisticated analysis highlights patterns and associations between your dietary habits and symptoms, empowering you with the insights needed to support your digestive health journey.
Try mySymptoms free for 7 days. The app is subscription-based and includes food and symptom tracking, plus analysis to uncover patterns that support your health journey.
Featured in ‘The Best Gut Health Apps’ by Healthline. Join over 1 Million people who use mySymptoms for their IBS, IBD, low FODMAP diet, migraines, eczema, and more.
“This app is simply the best in terms of keeping track of your foods and symptoms. In addition to medication and exercise. It is helping me a lot to keep a journal to track my SIBO and IBS.” [mySymptoms customer]
DIARY / JOURNAL
• Food & health tracking: Log all aspects of your health, including food, drink, medication, stress, exercise, and environmental factors.
• Food database: Search or scan barcodes to access our extensive database of foods.
• Symptom tracking: Log symptom intensity, duration, and additional notes.
• Wellness Metrics: Log your energy, sleep quality, and bowel movements (using Bristol scale)
• Customization: Add your own drinks, foods, meals, medications, exercises, and symptoms.
INSIGHTS & ANALYSIS
• Correlation analysis: Explore how different foods affect your symptoms, helping you identify potential triggers and patterns.
• Detailed reports: Featuring specific metrics, histograms, and trend charts that visually illustrate trends over time.
• Event review: A detailed list of instances where specific foods or symptoms occurred.
SHARING & REPORTS
• Share with your clinician: Securely share your diary with your clinician through our dedicated Clinic web app.
• Family access: Share access on multiple devices using the same account.
• Data export: Export your food diary for review or sharing with health professionals in PDF or CSV formats.
PRIVACY & SECURITY
• Privacy first: Your account starts with an anonymous username ensuring confidentiality. Your name and email are only required if you choose to share your diary with a clinician.
• Robust security: Your data is fully encrypted both during transmission and while stored in the cloud.
• Control your data: We never share or sell your personal data. You may choose to participate in optional studies that help advance health research.
• HIPAA & GDPR compliant: Share your diary with clinicians confidently, knowing our app meets HIPAA & GDPR (Health Data) standards for protecting sensitive patient information. 
mySymptoms is used by individuals managing conditions such as:
• IBS (Irritable Bowel Syndrome)
• IBD (Inflammatory Bowel Disease)
• Food intolerance and sensitivities such as dairy, gluten, lactose
• Acid reflux
• Crohn’s disease
• Celiac disease
• SIBO (Small Intestinal Bacterial Overgrowth)
• Ulcerative colitis
• Migraines & cluster headaches
• Eczema
• Bloating, heartburn, and many other digestive conditions 
Try mySymptoms and start your journey to improved digestive health and well-being today!
SUBSCRIPTION INFO
mySymptoms provides a subscription service with a free trial. Cancel anytime during the trial without fees. After the trial, you’re billed monthly, semi-annually, or annually based on your plan.
Manage or cancel your subscription anytime through your App Store subscriptions. Ensure changes are made 24 hours before renewal to prevent charges.

Featured in ‘The Best Gut Health Apps’ by Healthline. Join over 1 Million people who use mySymptoms for their IBS, IBD, low FODMAP diet, migraines, eczema, and more.

“This app is simply the best in terms of keeping track of your foods and symptoms. In addition to medication and exercise. It is helping me a lot to keep a journal to track my SIBO and IBS.” [mySymptoms customer]


DIARY / JOURNAL

• Food & health tracking: Log all aspects of your health, including food, drink, medication, stress, exercise, and environmental factors.
• Food database: Search or scan barcodes to access our extensive database of foods.
• Symptom tracking: Log symptom intensity, duration, and additional notes.
• Wellness Metrics: Log your energy, sleep quality, and bowel movements (using Bristol scale)
• Customization: Add your own drinks, foods, meals, medications, exercises, and symptoms.


INSIGHTS & ANALYSIS

• Correlation analysis: Explore how different foods affect your symptoms, helping you identify potential triggers and patterns.
• Detailed reports: Featuring specific metrics, histograms, and trend charts that visually illustrate trends over time.

SHARING & REPORTS

• Share with your clinician: Securely share your diary with your clinician through our dedicated Clinic web app.

bluejetty:00172523:ios.name: Taximeter. GPS taxi cab meter.
bluejetty:00172523:ios.summary: GPS taxi meter app for those who earn by driving. Perfect for towing, shuttle buses, limo services or taxi drivers. Allows to setup unlimited number of tariffs, and charge for distance driven or time passed (or both). Provides trip extras m
bluejetty:00172523:ios.description:
GPS taxi meter app for those who earn by driving. Perfect for towing, shuttle buses, limo services or taxi drivers. Allows to setup unlimited number of tariffs, and charge for distance driven or time passed (or both). Provides trip extras management, so extras can be added or removed with one tap.
+UNLIMITED NUMBER OF TARIFFS. Each tariff allows to charge either for distance (miles or kilometers) or for time. It is even possible to charge for time only when speed drops under some configurable value.
+TRIPS LOG, STATS, RECEIPTS. Everything you need for billing and book keeping. Filter by month or year. Search through the trips log with start/end address, notes.
+FLEXIBLE EXTRAS. You can define your extras in advance and add to the trip easily or you can add arbitrary extra amounts to the trip as you drive. You can review trip extras at any moment to remove or edit them.
+ONE TAP TARIFFS SWITCH. You can pick which tariffs to see in the tariffs switch panel and switch with one tap between them.
+CONFIGURABLE NUMBER OF DECIMAL PLACES IN TAXI FARE. Setup speedometer to show 1 or 2 decimal places in a taxi fare, or no decimals at all.
+SQUARE PAYMENTS AND PRINTING. Integrates with Square Point Of Sale app for secure payments (including credit cards) and also for receipt printing. *Square integration requires in-app upgrade.
+SUMUP PAYMENTS. Integrates natively with SumUp payments/terminal provider so you use all of the payment types that SumUp provides without leaving the app.
+ FARE CALCULATOR. Estimate a trip price given a start and end address. Start a trip in the app and open turn by turn navigation in another app, or just review turn by turn routes in another app. Provide fare calculations (quotes) to your customers. From version 4.2 you can also create a taxi trip directly in the Fare Calculator > add/manage extras > adjust total and note in the receipt, collect payment, send the receipt - all without leaving the Fare Calculator screen.
+BUILT-IN SPEEDOMETER. As you often need to know the speed when you drive. 
+ UNIVERSAL APP. No need to pay twice! Taximeter works on iPhones and cellular iPads. All in retina graphics. Side by side and split view is supported on iPads, so you can run navigation apps side by side with taximeter!
+ BACKGROUND MODE! Taximeter automatically works in background when taxi trip is active. You can use other apps while taximeter does its job in the background!
FREE version provides you with 10 taxi trips. If you need more taxi trips please upgrade. If you've ever purchased the paid app or upgraded, please use "Restore purchases" button.
! You can use this app on your iPhone as well as on any cellular iPad. **App will not work properly on iPods and wifi only iPads as they don't have GPS (external GPS module is required). 
! Please note that as with all GPS apps, continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00153192:ios.description:
PhotoKit is an all-in-one tool for photo cleanup, privacy protection, and AI image creation. Clean up your library, block unwanted messages, enjoy safer Safari browsing, and create AI photos in just a few taps.
Why PhotoKit?
* Photo & Video Cleanup
PhotoKit helps you quickly organize and clean up your photo library by finding duplicates, similar shots, blurry images, and large videos. With clear suggestions and easy controls, you decide what to keep and what to remove.
【Clear Duplicates】
Instantly detect and remove exact duplicate photos and videos.
【Choose the Best from Similar Shots】
PhotoKit AI groups similar and burst images, highlights the sharpest or most expressive version, and helps you keep your best shots.
【Weed Out Blur & Low Quality】
Detect fuzzy, poorly lit, or dull photos—so you keep only clear, vivid memories.
【Video Size Made Visible】
View and sort videos by file size to quickly find large files taking up storage.
【Stored Locally, 100% Private】
Photo and video scanning happens on your device—secure, private, and offline.
-------
* SMS Protection

bluejetty:00097524:ios.description:
The ultimate game for fans of fashion, makeup, narrative games, and building your own style empire!
Step into the magical world of Magic Princess – an adorable anime chibi dress up game where you can become a character maker, a top stylist, and even the CEO of your own fashion brand! This isn't just a makeover game; it's a fashion story where your choices matter. Build your fashion empire from the ground up in this unique business sim and choices game, perfect for every style lover.
1- Build Your Fashion Empire! - A New CEO Game!
+ Experience a unique fashion tycoon gameplay loop where you are the boss!
+ Make tough, witty, and sometimes hilarious decisions to grow your brand in this engaging business sim.
+ Your choices matter! Balance your Team, Creativity, Brand, and Finances. One wrong move could lead to a fun and dramatic crisis!
+ Shape your fashion story through hundreds of dilemmas. Will you be a kind leader or a ruthless tycoon? The choice is yours.
2- Dress Up Your Own Magic Princess!
+ Explore a world of fashion games and makeover fun with 200+ outfits, hairstyles, accessories, and more!
+ Mix and match styles to create gothic dolls, celebrity avatars, or kawaii chibi princesses.
+ Be a real doll maker and express your creativity in this anime dress up and makeup game!
3- Avatar Creator, Makeup & Memoji Maker Fun!
+ Become your own avatar creator and make cute versions of yourself and your friends.
+ Play with makeup, skin tones, and expressions – perfect for every style and makeover lover.
4- Decorate & Customize Your Dream Room!
+ Love decorating? Now you can decorate your room with adorable furniture and interior styles!
+ Be your own room designer and build the coziest, dreamiest space for your dolls and your brand's head office.
+ This is more than a character maker – it's also a relaxing home decor and makeover game!
5- Play Offline Anytime!
You can enjoy Magic Princess even without internet. Whether you’re traveling or just want to play offline, your favorite dress up, makeover, CEO game, and room decorating fun is always at your fingertips!
6- Game Features:
+ 200+ fashion, makeover & makeup items to dress up your anime doll
+ A deep narrative game mode where you play as a CEO and build your fashion tycoon!
+ Interior design mode to build and decorate dream rooms
+ High-quality animated outfits and accessories
+ Now supports offline play – create anytime, anywhere!
How to Play:
Tap and swipe to dress up your princess doll
Apply cute makeup looks and makeover styles
Make key decisions as a CEO to grow your brand
Decorate her dream room with stylish furniture
Keep a gallery of your best doll & room designs!
Whether you're a fan of makeup games, choices games, or just love dress up fun – Magic Princess is your next obsession!
Download now and become the ultimate doll maker, fashion stylist, and CEO of your own fashion empire today!

bluejetty:00069922:ios.summary: Dictate⁺ turns your iPhone or iPad into a professional dictation device that can do more than most high-end dictation devices. Dictate⁺ is an indispensable app for doctors, lawyers, tax consultants, surveyors, journalists and anyone who wan
bluejetty:00069922:ios.description:
Dictate⁺ turns your iPhone or iPad into a professional dictation device that can do more than most high-end dictation devices. Dictate⁺ is an indispensable app for doctors, lawyers, tax consultants, surveyors, journalists and anyone who wants to record speech and send it in accordance with the highest security standards. 
Dictate⁺ offers excellent sound quality, impressively accurate voice activation, secure encryption and a wealth of transmission options for your dictations and recordings.
Professional dictation recordings
 ∙ Lightning-fast recording control and precise voice activation
 ∙ Configurable recording quality (8 - 48 kHz) 
 ∙ Control with Bluetooth footswitch possible
 ∙ Recording in the background¹
Easily edit and transcribe dictations
 ∙ Smooth rewinding, overwriting and inserting
 ∙ Move and delete section in the dictation
 ∙ Set bookmarks in the dictation
 ∙ Different playback speeds
 ∙ Offline speech recognition
Transmission according to the highest security standards
 ∙ Highest data security thanks to AES-256 encryption 
 ∙ Access control (also biometric) possible
 ∙ No collection of usage or telemetry data²
 ∙ Wide range of sending options (email, download, FTP, WebDAV, SFTP, Dropbox and more)
 ∙ Preconfiguration of sharing destinations
 ∙ Dictate⁺ Transfer: end-to-end encrypted transfer of dictations to PC or Mac at no extra cost
Easy management of dictations
 ∙ Organize dictations in folders
 ∙ MP4/AAC, WAV and AIFF formats
 ∙ Barcode scanner
 ∙ File attachments (photos, PDF, etc.)
 ∙ Document scanner
JOTOMI has been developing dictation apps since 2008. “Dictamus” first became “Dictate + Connect” and now “Dictate⁺”. With more than 500,000 downloads worldwide, we are one of the most successful app developers in the field of professional dictation. Together with users from a wide range of industries, we are constantly working on improvements.
Dictate⁺ offers all functions out of the box, but the recording length is limited to 15 seconds. Purchase a subscription to remove this limitation. With a "Feature Unlock" subscription, the length of each individual dictation is limited to 24 hours at “Normal” recording quality (5 hours at “Studio” recording quality).
Your iTunes account will be charged immediately after confirmation of the subscription purchase. A subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. You can manage your subscriptions and turn off auto-renewal in your iTunes account settings. If you purchase a subscription, any existing free usage will expire and your account will be charged immediately.
You can find the terms of use for the Feature Unlock subscription at https://www.dictate-plus.com/dictateplus-termsofuse
¹ Calls made from the iPhone itself cannot be recorded
² When using cloud services to transfer dictations, usage data and telemetry may be collected by the respective cloud provider

bluejetty:00184262:ios.summary:
Your keys, your bitcoin. BlueWallet is a free, open source bitcoin wallet. Your private keys are created and kept on your device.
Watch your cold storage, spend from multisig Vaults, sign with a hardware wallet, and choose exactly which co
bluejetty:00184262:ios.description:
Your keys, your bitcoin. BlueWallet is a free, open source bitcoin wallet. Your private keys are created and kept on your device.
Watch your cold storage, spend from multisig Vaults, sign with a hardware wallet, and choose exactly which coins pay. Made by bitcoiners, for bitcoiners.
YOU HOLD THE KEYS
• Private keys never leave your device. You control them.
• Create as many wallets as you like, or import one with its recovery phrase.
• Open source and MIT licensed. Read the code or build it yourself.
COLD STORAGE AND MULTISIG
• Watch-only wallets: follow your cold storage with just the public key.
• Hardware wallet signing: build the payment on your phone, sign the PSBT on your device, broadcast from BlueWallet.
• Multisig Vaults: require more than one key to spend.
CONTROL EVERY PAYMENT
• Coin control: label coins, freeze the ones you want kept apart, and pick which coins pay.
• Flexible fees: you set the fee.
• Speed up a pending payment, or cancel it, with Replace-By-Fee.
• Send to many addresses in one transaction.
• BIP47 payment codes: one reusable code for receiving.
PRIVACY AND SECURITY
• Full encryption: on top of iOS encryption, lock your wallets with your own password.
• Plausible deniability: a second password opens a decoy storage if you are ever forced to unlock the app.
• Your own node: connect to your Bitcoin full node through Electrum.
Also available on Mac.

bluejetty:00016689:ios.description:
To continue enjoying our app, we kindly request that you log in again after this update.
If you're a subscriber, please take a moment to restore your account to ensure uninterrupted access. You can find the “Restore Subscriptions“ button in Settings under Subscriptions.
Welcome to a new app experience, we have optimized our app and giving it a facelift! This faster iOS native app now has the following new features:
Your News:
Provide personalized recommendations for content based on user preferences. Users will be allowed to customize the content they want to engage with by selecting the topics they are truly interested in. By going to the “Your News” tab the user can bypass the noise of all that is published and home in on the content they want
Saved Articles:
Save feature that allows users to save articles or other content they are interested in for later reading or reference.Push notifications will remind users to read their saved articles or suggest related content
Custom Push Notifications:
The user can select what topics they want to be notified about which makes for a much less intrusive experience. 
Top Navigation Bar:
 A top navigation bar lets the user switch between sections by swiping or tapping.
Enews in-app:
Desire the newspaper experience? No need to open a separate app! By simply going to Settings and selecting E-News the user can browse the Digital Replica of the day’s paper.
Offline Reading:
This feature allows users to enable offline reading from Settings. Offline “Reading Preferences” can also be customized for Settings. 
Swipe Left:
Instead of going back to the main section to find more articles, users have the option to simply swipe, immediately opening other articles in the Section.
Follow Topics:
A user will be shown articles on topics they are following. To follow select “follow” at the article level and related articles will gain relevancy and be shown more frequently. Just as easily “Unfollow”

bluejetty:00017087:ios.description:
Play the famous game of Rummy on your iPhone, iPod, or iPad!! 
Play rummy with 2, 3, or 4 players either with a group of friends or using simulated opponents playing with high-level artificial intelligence. 
There are a number of rules that can be modified, making this game very faithful to the original. 
*** SEVERAL GAME MODES - MULTIPLAYER ***
- From 2 to 4 players. 
- Play against simulated opponents with advanced artificial intelligence. 
- Play with your friends in local multiplayer mode through Wi-Fi or Bluetooth. 
- Play online with your friends or against players the Game Center will find automatically. 
- Play as a pair on the same device, taking turns. 
*** SEVERAL VARIATIONS INCLUDED *** 
Several rummy variations are included in the application: 
- Choose the AI level of opponents. 
- Number of cards dealt to each player (from 7 to 14). 
- Number of jokers (from 0 to 4). 
- Number of turns before being able to lay down a combination. 
- Number of points required for the first meld. 
- Sequence required or not for the first meld. 
- Card taken from discard pile has to be played or can be kept. 
- Final card to be discarded or played. 
- And several other variations... 
*** A VERY THOROUGH APPLICATION *** 
- Easy to learn, smooth game play, card animations for a more realistic game experience.
- Opponents endowed with advanced AI. 
- Statistics on games played. 
- Game rules included in the application. 
- Back-up of current game in case the application closes. 
- Game Center: Multi-player, rankings, and achievements. 
Do you have questions about the game? Contact: support.rummy@eryodsoft.com 
Have fun!

bluejetty:00023606:ios.description:
mconnect Player is a media player app to support UPnP/DLNA and Google Cast(Chromecast). 
- Send Video/Photo/Music to UPnP and Google Cast (Chromecast) devices. 
- Gapless Playback by App and to UPnP renderers.
- DSD and FLAC music playback by App.
- Play TIDAL, Qobuz and Bugs music & video to UPnP and Google Cast devices.
- Send media files to Apple AirPlay compatible devices from PC, NAS and Internet.
You can play media files from any Servers to any Playback Devices with mconnect Player.
[Media Servers]
- Your iPhone and iPad.
- UPnP compatible servers: PC and NAS.
- Internet Music integrated into App: TIDAL, Qobuz and Bugs.
- Cloud Server integrated into App: OneDrive and Dropbox.
[Playback Devices]
- Your iPhone and iPad.
- UPnP compatible renderers: Smart TV, UPnP supported Audio, UPnP receivers.
- Google Cast: Chromecast, Google Cast compatible Audio.
- AirPlay compatible devices: Apple TV, Airport Express, AirPlay Audio.
Note: If you send a media file to a remote playback device, the playable media format depends on the media decoder in the remote playback device.

Google Cast and Chromecast are registered trademarks of Google Inc.
DLNA is a trademark of Digital Living Network Alliance.
UPnP is a certification mark of the UPnP Forum in the United States and other countries.
TIDAL is a trademark of ASPIRO AB.
Qobuz is a trademark of XANDRIE SA.

bluejetty:00064907:ios.description:
Join 3.5 million customers using Flex. Split your rent into 2 payments—the first when it's due, the second on a date you choose during the month. When unexpected expenses hit, Flex gives you breathing room, whether you're paid weekly, biweekly, or have variable income. Your landlord or property gets paid upfront.
Help build your credit history with on-time payments. Still have money left over on the 1st.
HOW IT WORKS
1. Apply for Flex. If approved, set up your address and choose your payment schedule.
2. Your rent gets paid in full to your landlord or property.
3. You split rent payments in 2: half when rent is due, half before the end of the month.
BUILD CREDIT FOR PAYING RENT
Your on-time payments are reported to all major credit bureaus at no extra cost, so the rent you already pay can help to build credit history.
SEE, SPLIT AND PAY YOUR BILLS IN ONE APP
Flex is the app to split and pay your bills. Split your rent, car payment and everyday bills into smaller payments on dates that work for you.
TRANSPARENT PRICING, BUILT TO GET YOU AHEAD
What it costs: up to $5.99/month for the Flex membership, a 0.5% processing fee on the total bill amount, and a split fee of up to 3% of what you borrow (no reduction with early repayment). Debit card: no added charge. Credit card: 2.5% surcharge.
FAQs
- Can I pay rent, or my bills, in installments? Yes. One payment when your rent is due, a second later in the month, on a schedule you choose.
- Is Flex a loan? No. Flex provides a line of credit through its bank partners, not a loan.
- Does Flex report to credit bureaus? When turned on, on-time payments are reported to TransUnion, Experian, and Equifax, which helps build your credit history, included free with your Flex membership.
*The #1 rent splitting app based on app store reviews, 2026.

A split fee of up to 3% for each line of credit, based on how much you borrow each month, is also charged and cannot be reduced with early repayment. Flex Pay in Full users who are not extended a line of credit, are also subject to the 0.5% processing fee of their total rent amount (an additional 2.5% surcharge fee applies when using a credit card). bluejetty:00187968:ios.name: Bosch Toolbox
bluejetty:00187968:ios.summary:
For professional tradespeople! The BOSCH TOOLBOX is a new and innovative collection of digital tools for tradesmen and other professionals. Download the digital toolbox now - totally free with no ads.
Bosch Toolbox is for tradespeople work
bluejetty:00187968:ios.description:
For professional tradespeople! The BOSCH TOOLBOX is a new and innovative collection of digital tools for tradesmen and other professionals. Download the digital toolbox now - totally free with no ads.
Bosch Toolbox is for tradespeople working in the construction industry, as electricians, in gardening & landscaping, in industry, as metalworkers, as plumbing & HVAC engineers or as carpenters & masons. It is conceived to make the professionals more efficient in their daily life.
The app allows you to use track and calculate project time, project journeys, tasks and materials used and to create memos with the report sheet. You can measure distance and length of objects for your projects by using the measurement camera. You can use the unit converter to. As a great extra, you will receive promotion offers for expert Bosch tools with Bonus Bang in the craftsman app. You can also register your Bosch blue power tools and measuring tools for 3-year warranty free of charge in the app (only in selected countries). Send in a repair enquiry or find your closest Bosch dealer or service.
Bosch Toolbox app features:
MY TOOLS
- Easily configure your tool based on your individual needs and save the settings for future tasks
- Experience a new way of working and always benefit from the latest features and services 
- Access and organize your connected Bosch power tools inventory via the app using Bluetooth and analyze the estimated tool battery status 
REPORT SHEET
- Quick and easy recording of journey, work done and materials used – directly on the customer’s premises
- Complete report sheet archive, sortable by date or client
- Acceptance procedure is secure and binding due to report sheet’s digital signature
- Export function for quickly sending report sheets as PDF files to accounting and customer
- Create your own company profile including company logo for the export PDF
BUILDING DOCUMENTATION
- Comfortable and efficient project documentation – directly on the construction site (e.g. timesheet)
- Integrated media documentation (e.g. for construction defects): pictures, videos or voice recordings
- Employees have the ability to administer their time sheet digitally or to record the progress of the project 
- Export function of the documents as PDF & TXT files
MEASUREMENT CAMERA
- Input of measured values (e.g. measures of length, angle, etc.) directly into a picture (+ use the unit converter)
- Marking of specifics (wiring, connections, ventilation, etc.) and addition of side notes (voice recording, text, video)
- Creation of new projects and folders
- Transmission via e-mail
UNIT CONVERTER
- The easy-to-use converter helps to quickly convert many units
- Includes more than 50 units that are relevant to craftsmen: e.g. length measures, weight, volume, speed, power, energy, etc. 
- Converts any unit such as cm, meter, yd, square mile, watt, psi, joule, kWh, Fahrenheit and many more within seconds
MORE PRO APPS
- Overview with direct links to other Bosch Professional mobile applications
You will also find many additional features including a product catalogue (power tools and accessories), dealer locator and contact details for Bosch Professional.
This app is provided free of charge by Bosch Power Tools, the leading manufacturer of power tools for trade and industry.
All Bosch Professional apps are of course of the usual high Bosch quality.
It’s in your hands. Bosch Professional.

bluejetty:00100757:ios.name: More Language of Letting Go
bluejetty:00100757:ios.summary: Written by popular self-help author Melody Beattie, More Language of Letting Go provides daily guidance and wisdom for those who struggle with codependency and want to change or leave a difficult relationship as well as those in recovery fr
bluejetty:00100757:ios.description:
Written by popular self-help author Melody Beattie, More Language of Letting Go provides daily guidance and wisdom for those who struggle with codependency and want to change or leave a difficult relationship as well as those in recovery from an addiction. Many people who are looking to work on their personal growth or increase their peace and joy also find this app inspirational and helpful.
The app contains all 366 motivational readings from Beattie’s best-selling book, one for each day of the year. It is a companion to “The Language of Letting Go” and can be used by itself or in conjunction with that title. When the app is opened each day, it will automatically show you that day’s reading. Choose a time for a daily notification reminding you to read, reflect, and meditate on the reading.
Each daily reading focuses on a specific topic and ends with a related prayer or affirmation. Topics include: facing fears, getting to know yourself, dealing with grief, finding hope, recognizing manipulation, learning to have fun, and letting go of the things that are holding you back. Some readings feature activities to extend the experience.
Handy reference lists of the Twelve Steps of AA, the Twelve Traditions of AA, and the Twelve Steps of Al-Anon are also included in the app.
By integrating her own life experiences and fundamental recovery reflections, Melody Beattie helps readers take responsibility for themselves and their self-care as she encourages them to remember that each day is an opportunity for growth and renewal. 
Features:
PRESS the “Today” button to access today’s reading.
SWIPE forward or back to easily access more daily readings.
SHARE the daily reading with friends by e-mail or text.
BOOKMARK your favorite readings (press the star in the upper right-hand corner) and easily return to them (press the star in the bottom toolbar).
SEARCH all 366 daily readings.
RECEIVE a notification every day to remind you to read the daily meditation.
JUMP to a specific reading using the calendar button.
SET your font size using your device settings.
CHOOSE between light or dark mode.

bluejetty:00124183:ios.name: Score Recorder
bluejetty:00124183:ios.summary: This Universal app enables the scores of games to be recorded simply without needing to use pen and paper, while giving the impression that a piece of ruled paper is being used. It can be used for recording the results of many types of game
bluejetty:00124183:ios.description:
This Universal app enables the scores of games to be recorded simply without needing to use pen and paper, while giving the impression that a piece of ruled paper is being used. It can be used for recording the results of many types of games, for example Scrabble, darts and golf, as well as many card games such as UNO, Hand and Foot, tournaments, the pointy end of sailing regattas etc. It can even be used to simply add up a list of numbers, including optional decimal numbers to 6 decimal places with region-appropriate decimal indicator and optional region-appropriate grouping (thousands) indicator. Totals can be hidden if the 'game' is recording a list of numbers rather than scores in a game.
Score Recorder displays the running total of each player's scores so they don't have to be added to the previous total after each round, thereby reducing the need for mental arithmetic.
Names of the players or teams or groups are easily entered and their colours changed. Multiple games can be scored at the same time. Each game can have an 'unlimited' number of players. Completed games can be easily deleted using right to left swipe on the Games list screen.
• To start, tap the Games button at the bottom to create a Game and then add some players. Double-tap a player's name to change its colour.
• To enter a score tap the player's name or total score or immediately under the player's last score; enter the score with the keypad that appears and then either tap the OK button on iPhone or return on iPad, or tap another player.
• Negative scores are easily entered with the minus sign at the top left of the keypad.
• To delete a score or game: long-press on the score to reveal a red minus button alongside the score. Tap that to reveal the red Delete button.
• Games can be sorted by the players' total scores - ascending or descending. When sorting is selected, the columns are sorted by totals left to right as scores are added, modified and deleted. 
• Scores can be modified by simply tapping on them
Each player can have a vast number of scores in each game.
A large number of players can be added to each game.
Score Recorder has the capability to record notes about each game. 
From the Notes screen use the Action button to send a game as a CSV (Excel-readable) file using email or SMS or to some other available app e.g. Numbers.
Auto-lock can be turned off while Score Recorder is the active application. This setting, available in the iOS Settings app, ensures the device will not go to sleep while Score Recorder is the active application.
Decimal numbers and grouping separators are enabled via switches in the iOS Settings app: Settings>Score Recorder
Score Recorder has Accessibility (VoiceOver) capabilities to help visually impaired people use it.
Compatible with iOS12.0 through iOS18 (and probably later). Runs on Apple Silicon.
If you find _any_ issues, please remember to report them via the developer website link in the App Store so they can be addressed or fixed.

bluejetty:00157142:ios.description:
NatureDose® is the leading personalized nature prescription app. Totally free. 
NatureDose can monitor your time inside, outside, and exposed to natural environments to help you leverage the proven benefits of nature exposure for better mental and physical health. In the current world of never-ending technostress and screen addiction, NatureDose is the antidote to help you unplug for just a few minutes a day. Better health and wellness is right outside.
On par with diet, exercise, or adequate sleep, making nature exposure an essential part of your lifestyle is one of the best choices you can make for your health and wellness. Backed by over 500 peer-reviewed scientific studies, increasing your time exposed to natural elements can have profound impacts, from a stronger immune system and reduced anxiety in adults to better eyesight and brain development in kids. In short, these studies prove that nature exposure can result in a longer, healthier, and even happier life.
It's no surprise that "Nature Prescriptions" were named one of the top global wellness trends at The Global Wellness Summit and thousands of health care professionals, public health organizations, and governments around the world are employing nature as a health tool.
NATUREDOSE FEATURES:
- Using a patent-pending technology, NatureDose® can track your weekly outdoor nature prescription in minutes (a “NatureDose”)
 - Daily NatureDose breakdown
 - Determine longest nature session by week
 - Compare week-to-week nature exposure
 - Determine approximate indoor versus outdoor time by week
- Set customized weekly NatureDose targets (for example 120 minutes a week)
- Helpful tips, suggestions, and facts to optimize your time outdoors 
- Determine the relative amount of beneficial nature for any neighborhood (a “NatureScore®”)
 - Determine the highest NatureScore location by week
PARTNER WITH US TO GET OUTSIDE!
In addition to personalized health management, NatureDose can be an integral part of:
- Corporate health and wellness programs - reduce burnout and keep productivity high
- Health insurance - lower medical costs through a safe, scalable, and accessible intervention
- Research 
- Doctor guided prescriptions for preventative care or treatment
- Therapy, meditation, and mental health platforms
- Physical health or activity/fitness apps
- Community/organizational challenges and promotions
- Nature based augmented reality and the “gamification” of time outside
- White-label nature prescriptions 
- Any corporation, non-profit, or government agency who is interested in creating a healthier future through time outdoors! 
Learn more about the connections between nature and health, NatureDose, and NatureScore on our web site. 
NATURE IS NOT A LUXURY. IT IS A NECESSITY.

bluejetty:00064908:ios.summary:
Redefining Convenience in Banking!
FNB Direct, First National Bank’s mobile banking app, makes it easier than ever to bank on the go, right from your mobile device. Quickly check account transactions and balances, manage your FNB Debit Car
bluejetty:00064908:ios.description:
Redefining Convenience in Banking!
FNB Direct, First National Bank’s mobile banking app, makes it easier than ever to bank on the go, right from your mobile device. Quickly check account transactions and balances, manage your FNB Debit Card, deposit checks, transfer money, pay your friends (or the bills), and even locate a convenient FNB branch or ATM. 
Features:
Quick and Easy Enrollment:
Don’t have online access? Simply download the FNB Direct Mobile Banking app and enroll from your device. After you establish your User ID and Password within Mobile Banking, you can use the same login information to access Online Banking.
eStore®:
eStore is an innovative digital banking experience that enables you to shop for and buy financial products and services, and access financial education resources. Open a deposit account, apply for a consumer or small business loan or schedule an appointment to meet with one of our banking experts – just add the product to your shopping cart and checkout. You can access eStore from anywhere – via our website, through our mobile app or in branches throughout our footprint.
Direct Deposit Switch:
With Direct Deposit Switch, you can easily establish or switch your direct deposit securely within our Online and Mobile Banking services. No need to fill out any paper forms. Simply log in and make the switch. It's simple, safe and takes only minutes.
Payment Switch:
With Payment Switch, you can quickly and easily update your payment methods at top providers like Verizon, Amazon, Netflix, and more.
Credit Center:
The Credit Center provides you with access to your latest credit score, gives you an understanding of the key factors that impact your score and may even be able to save you money with special offers.
Secure Chat Support:
Enjoy the convenience of chatting with a Customer Contact Center agent without having to place a call. Simply tap the blue Chat icon in Mobile Banking to get started. Please note that the Chat feature may not be available at all times.
CardGuard™: 
You have the convenience and peace of mind to manage your FNB Debit Card through Online and Mobile Banking. Control where and how your debit card can be used by enabling or disabling your card, setting spending limits by dollar amount, restricting card usage at certain merchants by category and limiting card usage to specific geographic locations. 
Online Statements:
View or download copies of your Online Statements within Mobile Banking. 
Send Money with Zelle®:
With Zelle® and First National Bank, you can use Mobile Banking to quickly and easily send and receive money.
Advanced Biometric Security:
Securely and conveniently log in with Touch ID® (iPhone 5s or later) or Face ID® (iPhone X or later).
View Check Images & Running Balance:
You can view the front and back of checks that have cleared your account in addition to seeing your running account balance.
Make Deposits: 
Deposit your check quickly and easily by using the app to take a picture of the front and back of your check; simply enter your deposit information, center the check and we’ll take the picture for you.
Actionable Alerts: 
Customize alerts and notifications to stay on top of account activity in near real-time.
Account Information: 
View up-to-date information about your FNB accounts, including pending transactions. 
Transfer Money: 
Transfer money between your FNB accounts.
The FNB Direct app is free to install. Message and data rates from your mobile carrier may apply. System availability and response time are subject to market conditions. For general support call our Customer Contact Center at 1-800-555-5455, Monday through Friday from 8:00 AM – 9:00 PM, or Saturday and Sunday from 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM.
Member FDIC.
Apple is a registered trademark of Apple, Inc. 
Zelle and the Zelle-related marks are wholly owned by Early Warning Services, LLC and are used herein under license.

bluejetty:00128701:ios.description:
Relax Your Body & Mind with the Power of Vibration
Turn your iPhone into a personal wellness tool designed to help you relax, unwind, and feel better anytime and anywhere.
Massager combines soothing vibrations, calming sounds, and peaceful visuals to support your daily health and stress-relief routine.
Whether you want to ease muscle tension after a long day, recover from a workout, or find a moment of calm before sleep, Massager provides an effective way to enhance your overall well-being.
## WHY YOU’LL LOVE MASSAGER
- Strong and Soothing Vibration
Choose from a curated selection of vibration patterns designed to promote relaxation and comfort.
- Instant Mental Calm
Combine vibration with a library of white noise, nature sounds, and ambient audio to create a peaceful environment.
- Visual Relaxation Therapy
Slow, calming visual loops help quiet your mind and reduce stress.
- Customizable Comfort
Adjust intensity, duration, and patterns to match your personal relaxation style.
## PERFECT FOR DAILY WELLNESS
- Stress Relief
Take a moment during your day to release tension and reset your mood.
- Better Sleep
Use gentle vibration and calming audio to prepare your mind for rest.
- Neck, Back, and Shoulder Relief
Reduce stiffness and ease muscle fatigue after sitting or exercising.
- Mindfulness and Focus
Improve meditation or breathing exercises with rhythmic, consistent patterns.
## KEY FEATURES
 • 12 unique vibration modes
 • Adjustable intensity and speed
 • Calming sounds and ambient audio
 • Visual relaxation loops
 • Clean, simple, dark-mode interface
 • Works anywhere without additional devices
 • Frequent updates with new content
## IMPORTANT NOTE
Vibration strength depends on your iPhone model.
For best performance, ensure the following settings are enabled:
 • System Haptics
 • Ringer Switch ON (not Silent Mode)
Massager works best on iPhone 8 or later.
## PREMIUM SUBSCRIPTION
Unlock the full potential of Massager App with our Premium features. Get unlimited access to all vibration patterns, exclusive soundscapes, and an ad-free experience.
Subscription Details:
- Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
- Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
- Your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period.
- You can manage your subscription and turn off auto-renewal by going to your iTunes Account Settings after purchase.
- Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription.
## FEEDBACK AND SUPPORT
We welcome your suggestions and feedback.
Contact us anytime: andychung.cc@gmail.com
Terms of Use: http://vibrator.andyrgb.com/terms
Privacy Policy: http://vibrator.andyrgb.com/privacy

bluejetty:00072405:ios.name: ChargerSync
bluejetty:00072405:ios.developer: Chargedot Shanghai New Energy Technology Co., Ltd
bluejetty:00072405:ios.summary:
ChargerSync is a reliable and convenient tool for EV drivers to control and customize their charging sessions, so that charging your EV becomes a seamless experience.
Designed to operate exclusively with the Terra AC charging solutions, Ch
bluejetty:00072405:ios.description:
ChargerSync is a reliable and convenient tool for EV drivers to control and customize their charging sessions, so that charging your EV becomes a seamless experience.
Designed to operate exclusively with the Terra AC charging solutions, ChargerSync provides an extended set of digital features designed to make charging simple and efficient regardless of your level of experience as EV driver.
The ChargerSync app works with Terra AC charging solutions via Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, 4G and Ethernet connectivity. You simply configure the charger to the communication interface you want to use.
Main features include:
• ChargerSync Account - Conveniently view and manage one or multiple Terra wallboxes with a single account. Easily sign up and setup your account via the ChargerSync app.
• Authentication - Use ChargerSync to start and stop your charging session with just one tap. Manage and authorize RFID cards to be used with your Terra AC charging solution.
• Charging - View real-time charging status, like the charging power, and if configured, the cost of your current charging session. Use the schedule feature to define a charging schedule that starts and stops your charging sessions automatically.
• Statistics and Costs – Set different prices for electricity depending on the time of day, allowing the app to share detailed information on charging costs at home. ChargerSync also provides a quick way to see all charging sessions performed via your charger.
• Safety - Balance the charging power of your Terra wallbox to leave enough headroom for the rest of your electrical appliances at home.
New features to the ChargerSync update include:
• Reimbursement reports – Retrieve and easily export company car charge sessions with company car tagging.
• Charger sharing - Set free vending schedules to share your charger with family, friends or visitors without using an app or RFID card.
• Notifications – Receive notifications as soon as wallbox updates, such as the latest firmware upgrade, become available.
• Remote control – After configuring the charger, EV drivers can start/stop their charging session and access their charging information from anywhere with an internet connection via Terra AC charging solution.
• Global support – ChargerSync offers support for over 25 languages and 100 currencies.
* ChargeDot recommends using the ChargerSync Web Portal for commercial operation and sites with multiple chargers.
