bluejetty:00089179:ios.description:
Download our StretchLab app today no matter your flexibility level! Our app will help you find the stretching experience perfectly fit for you.
Features:
- Browse our schedule of upcoming 1-on-1 and group stretches
- Have a favorite Flexologist? Filter stretches by date and Flexologist 
- Book stretches in the app and easily add them to your calendar with a simple click! 
- Check out our in-app activity tracker to keep track of your sessions over time
- In a new area? Find a StretchLab studio near you using our interactive map
- Keep track of your monthly membership

Stretching is ancient, but StretchLab has redefined what it means to stretch. Whether you’re an athlete looking to loosen up after a workout or a desk jockey just looking to increase mobility and reduce tension, we have flexibility experts at our studios with years of experience in yoga, athletics, fitness, health, chiropractic and more to create a personalized stretching experience just for you.
What We offer: 
- Book an innovative group stretch to reclaim your freedom no matter your fitness level. Our group stretch is fully customized to fit your flexibility.
- Need a more personalized experience? Book a 25 minute 1-on-1 with a Flexologist to find the right stretch for you. Our 25 minute customized stretching concentrates on major muscle groups like core, back, shoulders and hips.
- If you need a deeper stretch, book the 50 minute stretch to work the extremities like the lower legs, feet, ankles, neck, arms, wrists and hands. Book your 1-on-1 to not just improve fitness, but your overall health and wellness
Why you will love our stretch: 
- Reduce muscle pain and tension
- Increase flexibility and mobility 
- Increase your sports performance 
- Transform your health and wellness
- Track your stretches on the Apple Watch app 
- Track your progress on Apple Health app
Join ClassPoints, our loyalty program! Sign up for free and accumulate points with every class you attend. Achieve different status levels and unlock exciting rewards, including retail discounts, access to priority booking, guest passes for your friends, and more! 
Download the StretchLab app today to find the flow and flexibility your body needs!

bluejetty:00172266:ios.description:
KeePassium is an open-source password manager compatible with KeePass/KeePassXC. 
Built for IT professionals, power users and privacy enthusiasts, it keeps your data under your control. KeePassium is offline by default, open to review, and independently audited by Cure53.
Security
• Offline by default — privacy you can verify
• Face ID / Touch ID — secure access without typing
• Passkeys and one-time codes — when you need more than a password
• YubiKey support — strong, hardware-backed protection [Premium]
• Password leak audit — detects compromised passwords [Premium]
Convenience
• Password AutoFill — automatically sign in to apps and websites
• Automatic sync — optional, works with major cloud providers or your own server
• Multiple databases — share passwords with family and team members [Premium]
• Quick registration — create new accounts without switching apps [Premium]
• Enterprise storage — keep work passwords in your company’s cloud [Premium]
Compatibility
• Works with KeePass, KeePassXC, and other KeePass-compatible apps
• Supports VoiceOver and large text sizes for accessibility
• Premium license covers both iOS and macOS
…and of course
• No vendor lock-in
• No analytics
• No ads
Privacy
KeePassium does not collect any personal data. We sell the app, not its users.
Privacy Policy: https://keepassium.com/privacy/
Terms of Service: https://keepassium.com/terms/app
EULA: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00135781:ios.description:
Explore thrilling gaming adventures with a variety of captivating chapters featuring special game units in ‘’Space Heroes’’. 
What awaits you in this RPG masterpiece?
•Epic Quests
 Embark on a series of epic quests that will take you across diverse landscapes and introduce you to captivating characters.
•Legendary Heroes
 Assemble a team of legendary heroes, each with their own unique abilities, skills, and backstory, and lead them to greatness.
•Richly Detailed Galaxy
Explore a vast and intricately crafted galaxy filled with lush landscapes, ancient ruins, bustling grounds, and mysterious dungeons. 
•Thrilling Battles
Engage in strategic and dynamic battles against formidable foes, utilizing a variety of tactics and abilities to emerge victorious.
•Character Progression
Level up your heroes, unlock new skills, and equip them with powerful gear to strengthen their abilities and customize their play style.
•Alliances and Clans
Assemble a team of legendary heroes, each with their own unique abilities and strengths with their own goals, motivations, and conflicts. Lead them through a richly detailed world teeming with mysteries to uncover and foes to conquer.
•Quest Variety
Encounter a wide range of quests, including main story quests, side quests, dynamic events, and random encounters, offering endless opportunities for exploration and discovery. 
•Endless Exploration
Venture off the beaten path to discover hidden treasures, secret locations, and easter eggs scattered throughout the skies. 
•Community and Multiplayer
Connect with other players, join clans, and participate in multiplayer activities such as raids, dungeons, and player-versus-player battles for even more excitement and challenge. 
--------------------------
Details on Subscriptions
1. Subscription Pricing & Billing
You can subscribe within the game for ‘Subscription Privileges’, for $9.99 a calendar month.
2. Subscription Content
Subscribers can enjoy the following privileges during the period:
- Green Gem
3. Auto Renewals
The App Store Subscription feature renews automatically via your iTunes Account. Users can manage the subscription through your iTunes/Apple ID Settings Manager. The subscription will auto-renew for the assigned billing period if the auto-renew feature is not turned off 24 hours before the current subscription expires.
4. User Agreement and Privacy Policy
Privacy Statement - https://www.udogames.com/legal/privacy-policy/
User Agreement - https://www.udogames.com/legal/terms-and-conditions/#h1-subscriptions 
5. Subscription Cancellation
If you would like to cancel your subscription, go to ‘Settings’ on your iOS device --> ‘iTunes & App Store’ --> tap ‘Apple ID’ and then ‘View Apple ID’. Enter ‘Account Settings’, tap ‘Subscriptions’ --> ‘Manage’, and select the subscription for ‘Space Heroes: Galactic RPG’ to cancel it. Download Space Heroes now, join the adventure and conquer the sky!

bluejetty:00147387:ios.description:
Easily take contactless payments with just your iPhone. Tofu Pay is the point-of-sale app that gives you everything you need to run and grow your business. It allows you to accept payments from Apple Pay, Google Pay, and other mobile wallets, as well as issue “Tap To Pay” payment links to your customers.
Key Features:
Accept contactless payments. Tofu Pay turns your phone into a payment terminal. You can accept contactless payments from Apple Pay, Google Pay, and other mobile wallets, without the need for any additional hardware. Simply open the app and hold your customer's phone near yours.
Issue payment links. Tofu Pay allows you to issue payment links to your customers. Your customers can then pay by tapping on the link, without having to enter any card details. This is a great way to accept payments for online orders, invoices, and other goods and services.
Features:
Accept contactless payments from Apple Pay, Google Pay, and other mobile wallets
Issue payment links to your customers
Easy to use and set up
Secure and reliable
Affordable pricing
Get paid with QR codes – generate a code and let your customers scan it to pay in seconds.
Benefits:
Increase sales by accepting contactless payments and payment links
Improve the customer experience by making it easy for customers to pay
Save money on credit card processing fees
Reduce the risk of fraud
Tofu Pay is the perfect solution for small business owners who want to accept contactless payments and payment links.
Download Tofu Pay today and start growing your business!

bluejetty:00034906:ios.description:
Translr is more than a dating app - it’s a welcoming space built for the transgender community and those who admire and support it. With over 1 million registered users worldwide, Translr is where real connections and true understanding come to life. Whether you’re exploring trans dating, seeking new friends, or looking for a spark that could turn into something more, Translr makes it easy to connect in a safe, genuine, and respectful way.
Inclusive for Everyone
* Transgender women (MtF) and men (FtM)
* Non-binary, gender-fluid, and explorers
* Crossdressers, sissy identities, and admirers
* LGBTQ+ friends and allies
(18+ only)
No matter your identity or where you are on your journey, Translr welcomes you with open arms.
Why Choose Translr?
*Real Connections, Real People
Profile and video verification to keep the community authentic
Smart privacy settings so you control your visibility
Filters to find romance, friendship, or meaningful chat
*Safe & Respectful
24/7 moderation and zero tolerance for harassment
Real-time protection from unwanted messages
*Beyond Dating
Community tags like ts dating to match interests
Inspiring stories of real connections and confidence
A platform that celebrates identity—not labels
Explore Translr Features
*Spark – Swipe and match instantly with people who catch your eye.
*Search – Use powerful filters to discover the right match for you.
*Moments – Share updates, photos, and connect through real-life stories.
*Buzz – See who viewed your profile, liked you, and visited your page.
Every feature is designed to ensure your experience is safe, authentic, and enjoyable from the moment you join.
Built for Trans & Admirers
Unlike mainstream apps that overlook or misrepresent trans people, Translr creates a place of freedom and joy. Whether you’re MtF, FtM, non-binary, crossdresser, or an ally—you’ll find a supportive space where everyone belongs.
Over 1,000,000 members and growing. No ads. No judgment. Just real connections.

bluejetty:00175813:ios.description:
All Good Things... We had a good run, however it's time to say goodbye.
Thank you to everyone who has supported Minimalist over the years. Your support has been greatly appreciated.
Unfortunately, the amount of time and effort required to continue developing Minimalist has officially exceeded what we have to offer.
As such, we have made the difficult decision to cease development effective immediately, and end support as of August 1st, 2026.
The final version of Minimalist (3.7) will be available in the App Store until August 1st, 2026. There is also a macOS only version available for direct download at https://minimalistpassword.com.
In this final version, we've updated the built-in export options for Apple Passwords, Safari, and a new Text File format. These options include all Minimalist data, including custom fields, so you will have access to all your data once Minimalist is no longer available.
Thanks again to everyone and take care!
- The Minimalist team

bluejetty:00027178:ios.description:

*Get started and order in minimum steps: 
1. Download the app,
2. Choose a preferred mode of language,
3. Check your favorite items categorized as part of the menu,
4. Add items to the cart,
5. Log in to use Saved Addresses or continue as Guest,
6. Choose a mode of ordering as pickup or delivery,
7. Select location and provide a delivery address/pickup address,
8. Proceed to checkout and make payment,
9. Track your order and get it delivered as lightning fast delivery,
10. Enjoy the food delivered at your doorstep.

*Pickup or Takeaway: 
When driving, pickup your delicious food from any nearest store by ordering from the application. 
*Car Hop:
100% Contactless and hassle-free experience. For our customers we bring Car Hop service for contactless delivery in your car parked in our premises.
*Late night delivery:

*Social Login:
Why spend time in the login process when it can be done via social mode. Use your Google or Facebook account to login with ease.

*Special Offers:
Coupons, Offers & deals customized only for you so that you can order more and get rewarded at times you order.

Welcome to Lowins - a global live streaming platform built around creators, live content, and community-driven content discovery.
With Lowins, you can watch live streams, share your experiences through content, and discover creators and communities. Whether you’re exploring cultures, practicing languages through live content, or discovering inspiring creators,Lowins helps you express yourself through live streams and stay engaged - all in one secure, creator-driven app.
MAIN FEATURES
• Live Video Streaming - Watch and host live streams in real time. Discover creators from around the world, participate in public live stream chats, and become part of an active streaming community built around authentic content and real engagement.
• Daily Reward System - Stay active and get rewarded every day. Earn bonuses for logging in, watching live streams, engaging with content, and supporting creators. The more you participate, the more you unlock.
• Content Feed - Explore a dynamic feed filled with live streams, short videos, and updates from creators you follow. Discover trending content and fresh personalities every day.
• Real-Time Translation - Engage in public live stream chats across languages with instant, built-in translation, making global content easier to enjoy and understand.
COMMUNITY & EXPRESSION
Lowins is more than a streaming platform - it’s a place to share content, learn, and be part of something real.
• Creator-Driven Feed - share your moments through live streams and posts, and grow your audience organically through the content feed.
• Engagement - get noticed and rewarded for consistency, creativity, and positive activity. Your engagement helps shape your presence in the community.
• Profile Personalization - customize your profile with videos and photos, so others can understand your vibe before following.
• Safe & Intentional Interactions - direct messaging is available only between users who mutually follow each other, ensuring intentional, respectful, and interest-based connections.
SAFETY & TRUST
We are committed to creating a respectful and secure community for everyone.
• Lowins is for users aged 18 and older.
• Only authentic, appropriate content is allowed.
• Harassment, explicit material, and hate speech are strictly prohibited.
• Violations of our guidelines may result in account restrictions or removal.

- Cross out information that is not relevant for the recipient.
- Enter for whom the copy is intended and for what purpose the copy is required. This text is superimposed with the date on the c
bluejetty:00066424:ios.description:
- Take a photograph of your identity document.
- Cross out information that is not relevant for the recipient.
- Enter for whom the copy is intended and for what purpose the copy is required. This text is superimposed with the date on the copy, as a watermark. 
- You can then send, print or save the copy for subsequent use. 
You can only store the copy if your telephone or tablet is password protected. 
What rules apply to the use of the KopieID-app?
Definitions
App
An application that can be used on a mobile telephone or other portable device.
Identity document
The KopieID app recognises the following Dutch identity documents and documents of Bonaire, St. Eustatius and Saba (BES):
- Dutch ID card
- National passport
- Dutch driving licence
- Travel documents for refugees
- Travel documents for foreign nationals
- Residence documents
- Foreign nationals documents
- Service passport
- Diplomatic passport
- Facility passport
- Business passport
- BES driving licence
- Sedula – Bonaire – St. Eustatius – Saba
National Office for Identity Data (RvIG)
RvIG is an implementing organisation that reports to the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations (BZK). RvIG is the authority and manager for the safe and reliable use of identity data. For more information visit our website.
Conditions of use 
General

bluejetty:00042556:ios.name: TourSaver Alaska 2026
bluejetty:00042556:ios.summary:
The Alaska TourSaver® App for smartphones contains coupons like the traditional Alaska TourSaver Coupon Book...for smart travelers looking to save money on trips to Alaska and top attractions around the state.
The App features a unique boo
bluejetty:00042556:ios.description:
The Alaska TourSaver® App for smartphones contains coupons like the traditional Alaska TourSaver Coupon Book...for smart travelers looking to save money on trips to Alaska and top attractions around the state.
The App features a unique booking number, located at the bottom of each screen when you view an offer. 
You’ll also find maps and GPS locations of TourSaver vendor attractions. 
After downloading the free Alaska TourSaver App from the iTunes App Store, pick one of the three coupon packages to purchase: Statewide, Southcentral/Interior or Inside Passage. Afterwards, use it like the paper coupon book...and save some trees.
There is an app instructional video in the Visitor Info section of the Free App and also at TourSaver.com
Instead of tearing out coupons from the print edition, the TourSaver® app allows you to press a "Redeem Now" button when a tour vendor asks you for a coupon. Don't push the "Redeem Now" button until you are in Alaska...or the instructions on the coupon ask for a screenshot of the redeemed coupon. 
IMPORTANT: You still need to call and make reservations. ONLY press “REDEEM NOW” when you’re checking in on-site with the vendor. DO NOT press “REDEEM NOW” until you are prompted to do so by the participating vendor. Some vendors may ask to redeem and send a screenshot. All of the information you need is on the coupon and vendors will ask for the "Book Number" at the bottom of the coupon embedded in the green bar. This number is different for every customer.
Your personal book number is located at the bottom of each coupon--embedded in the "Redeem Now" button. Tour vendor reservation phone numbers and specific tour information is available for each offer on each coupon in the app. 
The Statewide Alaska Coupon Package has 100 coupons for tours and hotels across the State of Alaska. Total value of savings for Statewide Alaska Coupon package is over $15,000. This includes a 20 percent discount on Alaska Airlines, for travel to or from the Lower 48..with some restrictions. Flight seeing, glacier cruises, wildlife viewing, train excursions, rafting and fishing among others are also featured.
The South Central/Interior coupon package has 80 coupons for the South Central, Far North and Interior regions of Alaska...including Anchorage, Fairbanks, Denali National Park, Seward, Kenai Peninsula, Homer, Soldotna and more. The coupons offers are discounted or 2-for-1 deals on Alaska's top attractions. Total value of savings for SouthCentral/Interior Alaska Coupon package is over $13,000.
The Inside Passage coupon package has 20 coupons for the Southeast part of Alaska including Ketchikan, Juneau, Sitka, Wrangell and Skagway. Total value of savings for Inside Passage Coupon package is over $2,500.
Contact us through our website: https://toursaver.com/contact-us/

bluejetty:00034856:ios.description:
Ready to Speak English Confidently? 
Welcome to Learna AI English Tutor App, your all-in-one solution for mastering the English language! Learn English with grammar, speaking, reading, pronunciation, and vocabulary practices designed to enhance your proficiency in every aspect of the language.
With Learna AI, you can speak English confidently and effectively through interactive conversations. Our app takes your language learning journey beyond traditional methods. Whether you're a beginner or an advanced learner, Learna AI is here to help you learn & speak English in a fun, engaging, and personalized way.
English practices and lessons are guided by our Learna AI Virtual Chat Character, offering tailored support as you learn. You can speak with the AI character to improve both your speaking and listening skills. The app provides real-time feedback, helping you speak correctly and refine your vocabulary as you go. This makes learning English more dynamic, interactive, and efficient, as you can practice speaking at your own pace.
Learna AI also focuses on improving your grammar skills. You’ll learn essential grammar rules and practice them through a variety of exercises that help reinforce your understanding. The grammar practices are designed to gradually improve your proficiency, allowing you to speak with accuracy and clarity. As you learn grammar, you will build a stronger foundation for your speaking and writing skills.
Vocabulary plays a critical role in speaking English fluently. With Learna AI, you can improve your vocabulary by learning new words and phrases that are practical and useful in daily conversations. Each lesson focuses on building your vocabulary, ensuring you have a broad range of words at your disposal. The app features vocabulary practice that adapts to your level, helping you speak more naturally and confidently.
Your pronunciation also gets a boost with Learna AI. As you speak, you’ll receive valuable feedback to improve your pronunciation. The app includes exercises specifically designed to help you master English pronunciation and speak clearly. Pronunciation practices allow you to correct mistakes and sound more authentic when speaking English.
Track your progress with detailed performance metrics and milestones. Set learning goals to monitor your achievements and celebrate your successes. With continuous practice, you’ll see your speaking skills improve, and your vocabulary will expand. By setting specific goals, you ensure that each practice session is focused and effective.

English Conversation Practice with Learna AI Virtual Chat Character
Get feedback from Learna AI for your mistakes

Improve your English Reading Skills

Enhance your English Speaking Skills through practical speaking practice

bluejetty:00092081:ios.name: Reliable Taxi
bluejetty:00092081:ios.summary:
Reliable Taxi is the leading provider of Taxi services in Mount Vernon and lower Westchester. 
We are pleased to offer our valued clients the very latest in smartphone booking technology with our free Reliable Taxi application.
Key Feature
bluejetty:00092081:ios.description:
Reliable Taxi is the leading provider of Taxi services in Mount Vernon and lower Westchester. 
We are pleased to offer our valued clients the very latest in smartphone booking technology with our free Reliable Taxi application.
Key Features of the Reliable Taxi app include:
• Book a trip in as few as 2 clicks
• Monitor the progress of your vehicle on a map
• Create a list of favourite addresses and assign a custom name for each
• Review all reservations you have made over the past 30 days
• Provide feedback related to the application and/or service you received
• Call Reliable Taxi with the push of a button
To begin using the Reliable Taxi app today:
• Download the free app
• Enter your phone number
• Validate your account (via the notification code you receive)
• Login to the app (Set your name and Email for receipts)
• Enter your pickup address
• Enter your destination address (this allows us to provide an estimated fare amount)
• Book your trip 
On booking a reservation, you will immediately receive a confirmation number, along with an update when your vehicle has been assigned. From here you can monitor the progress of your vehicle as it moves towards your pickup location.
The Reliable Taxi app retains a history of your previous reservations for expense management and to quickly rebook the same trip with the push of a button. You may also create a list of favourite locations (Home, Work, etc.) to speed up the booking process.
Let us know how we can serve you better by providing feedback via the Reliable Taxi app or calling us at +1 (914) 664-1234
We look forward to adding many exciting new features to the Reliable Taxi app in the months ahead, and are always interested in what you have to say!

bluejetty:00064599:ios.name: Bankkart Mobil
bluejetty:00064599:ios.summary:
Bankkart Mobil ile Bankkart dünyasının tüm ayrıcalıklarından faydalanın, kart bilgilerinizi ve harcamalarınızı kolayca takip edin. 
Bankkart Mobil'e Ziraat Bankası İnternet Şubesi ve Ziraat Mobil'e girişte kullandığınız TCKN/Müşteri Numara
bluejetty:00064599:ios.description:
Bankkart Mobil ile Bankkart dünyasının tüm ayrıcalıklarından faydalanın, kart bilgilerinizi ve harcamalarınızı kolayca takip edin. 
Bankkart Mobil'e Ziraat Bankası İnternet Şubesi ve Ziraat Mobil'e girişte kullandığınız TCKN/Müşteri Numarası ve internet bankacılığı şifreniz ile giriş yapabilirsiniz. 
KARTLAR 
Bankkart Mobil ile kartınıza ait tüm bilgilere kolaylıkla erişebilir, harcamalarınızı sektör detayında izleyebilirsiniz. Sonradan Taksitlendirme, İşlem Erteleme gibi işlemleri, uygun işlemlerin üzerinde çıkan hızlı işlem butonlarıyla anında gerçekleştirebilir, kart şifrenizi belirleyebilir, kart ayarlarınızı değiştirebilir ve kartınızı geçici olarak kullanıma kapatabilirsiniz.
Kartlar sayfasında listelenen kartlarınızı türüne göre özelleştirilen Sanal Kart Tanımlama, Ek Kart Tanımlama, Limit Artış gibi hızlı işlem butonları ile işlemlerinizi kolay bir şekilde gerçekleştirebilir, Tüm İşlemler butonu ile kart türüne özel menülere tek başlık altında erişebilirsiniz.
Kart Hareketleri sayfası güncel dönem hareketlerinde yer alan Harcama Grafiği, gelecek dönem hareketlerinde yer alan Taksit Grafiği özelliği ile harcamalarınızı düzenli izleyebilirsiniz.
Bankkart başvurusu yapabilir, başvurunuzu takip edebilir ya da mevcut kartınız için limit artış talebinde bulunabilirsiniz. 
KAMPANYALAR 
Kampanya sayfasında tüm kampanyaları kolaylıkla takip ederken, Size Özel sunulacak kampanyaların keyfini çıkarabilirsiniz. Favori sektörünüzü belirleyerek, akıllı sıralama ile ilgi duyduğunuz sektörlerin kampanyalarına anında ulaşabilirsiniz. 
Katıl, Alışveriş Yap, Kazan alanı ile katılımlı kampanyaları bir arada izleyebilir, Katıldığım Kampanyalar alanı ile katılım sağladığınız kampanyaları ve kazanımlarınızı takip edebilirsiniz. Kampanyalar sayfasında yer alan Keşfet alanında kategori sekmeleri ile aradığınız kategorideki kampanyalara daha kolay ve hızlı erişebilirsiniz.
QR İLE ÖDEME
Navigasyon menü yapısında yer alan QR ile Ödeme fonksiyonuna tek tuşla ulaşabilir, ödemelerinizi hızlı bir şekilde yapabilirsiniz.

Kartlar sayfasında listelenen kartlarınızı türüne göre özelleştirilen Sanal Kart Tanımlama, Ek Kart Tanımlama, Limit Artış gibi hızlı işlem butonları ile işlemlerinizi kolay bir şekilde gerçekleştirebilir, Tüm İşlemler butonu ile kart türüne özel menülere tek başlık altında erişebilirsiniz.

Kart Hareketleri sayfası güncel dönem hareketlerinde yer alan Harcama Grafiği, gelecek dönem hareketlerinde yer alan Taksit Grafiği özelliği ile harcamalarınızı düzenli izleyebilirsiniz.

Bankkart başvurusu yapabilir, başvurunuzu takip edebilir ya da mevcut kartınız için limit artış talebinde bulunabilirsiniz. 

KAMPANYALAR 

Kampanya sayfasında tüm kampanyaları kolaylıkla takip ederken, Size Özel sunulacak kampanyaların keyfini çıkarabilirsiniz. Favori sektörünüzü belirleyerek, akıllı sıralama ile ilgi duyduğunuz sektörlerin kampanyalarına anında ulaşabilirsiniz. 

Katıl, Alışveriş Yap, Kazan alanı ile katılımlı kampanyaları bir arada izleyebilir, Katıldığım Kampanyalar alanı ile katılım sağladığınız kampanyaları ve kazanımlarınızı takip edebilirsiniz. Kampanyalar sayfasında yer alan Keşfet alanında kategori sekmeleri ile aradığınız kategorideki kampanyalara daha kolay ve hızlı erişebilirsiniz.

QR İLE ÖDEME

Navigasyon menü yapısında yer alan QR ile Ödeme fonksiyonuna tek tuşla ulaşabilir, ödemelerinizi hızlı bir şekilde yapabilirsiniz.

bluejetty:00083255:ios.description:
Welcome to Fashion Girl, the ultimate dress up game for fashion lovers, stylists, and anyone who loves creating beautiful outfits!
Create your dream look, discover new fashion trends, experiment with makeup and hairstyles, design gorgeous nails, and compete in exciting fashion challenges. Whether you love glamorous dresses, casual outfits, Y2K fashion, vintage style, streetwear, or elegant evening looks, Fashion Girl gives you hundreds of ways to express your style.
CREATE YOUR PERFECT OUTFIT
Become a virtual fashion stylist and mix and match hundreds of clothes, dresses, tops, skirts, pants, shoes, bags, jewelry, and accessories. Create outfits for casual days, romantic dates, parties, vacations, fashion events, and glamorous nights out.
MAKEOVER & BEAUTY SALON
Complete every outfit with the perfect makeover. Visit the Beauty Salon to experiment with makeup and hairstyles, create different beauty looks, and transform your model into a true fashion icon.
DESIGN BEAUTIFUL NAILS
Head to the Nail Art Studio and create stylish manicures with different colors, patterns, and designs. Match your nails to your outfit or create something completely unique.
COMPETE IN FASHION CHALLENGES
Enter fashion battles and styling challenges, dress for the theme, and compete against other looks. Vote for your favorite outfits, discover inspiration from other players, and show off your creativity.
DISCOVER TOP LOOKS
Explore the most stylish outfits created by the Fashion Girl community. See the Top Looks of the day, week, and month, submit your own creations, and climb the rankings.
SHOP NEW CLOTHES & COLLECTIONS
Visit the fashion shop to discover new clothes, accessories, shoes, and seasonal collections. Build your wardrobe and create even more combinations with fresh fashion drops.
TRAVEL TO STYLISH LOCATIONS
Take your outfits beyond the dressing room. Visit glamorous cities and beautiful destinations, create looks inspired by each setting, and find the perfect backdrop for your style.
EXPLORE DIFFERENT FASHION STYLES
Try Y2K fashion, vintage outfits, Old Hollywood glamour, casual street style, elegant dresses, party looks, romantic outfits, seasonal fashion, and more.
FASHION GIRL FEATURES
• Dress Up Game – Create unique outfits with hundreds of fashion items
• Huge Wardrobe – Dresses, tops, skirts, pants, shoes, bags, jewelry & accessories
• Makeover Game – Combine makeup, hairstyles, and fashion
• Beauty Salon – Experiment with glamorous beauty looks
• Nail Art Studio – Create stylish manicures and nail designs
• Fashion Challenges – Style looks for different themes
• Fashion Battles – Compete and see which outfit wins
• Voting – Vote for your favorite fashion looks
• Top Looks – Discover popular outfits and climb the rankings
• Fashion Shop – Discover new clothes and collections
• Stylish Locations – Create outfits for beautiful destinations
Whether you love dress up games, fashion games, makeover games, makeup games, styling games, or simply creating beautiful outfits, Fashion Girl is your place to experiment with style and unleash your creativity.
Build your wardrobe. Create amazing outfits. Compete in fashion challenges. Vote for the best styles. Become a fashion icon.
Download Fashion Girl and start styling your dream looks today!
The Fashion Girl VIP subscription provides ad-free access to all styles and features, plus daily bonus points.
Your subscription renews automatically at the end of each period unless canceled. Canceling will stop automatic renewal, but you’ll continue to enjoy all VIP benefits until the end of the current period.

Cut the fingernails to the length you want ready to color and create a beautiful finger masterpiece. 
Coloring Time 
Choose any color you want and color each nail the same color or individually to create a new and fashionable look that will wow the crowd. Also bring the flare with a patterned approach!

To make it feel more like you, change the skin color of the hands to best suit your skin tone so it feels like you are really getting your nails done!

Different nail colors including patterns
Choices of nail lengths
Skin tone colors
Jewellery wrist bracelets and rings
Jewelled accessories 
Fashion Nail Salon Features
Cut your nails to length ready for coloring. 
Color your nails so they are fashionable and unique. 
Add the bling to compliment your nails ready for showing off to the cameras.

bluejetty:00074026:ios.description:
Kami Home makes it easy and practical to protect and stay connected with the things that matter--your family, pets, and the things you love. With just a few simple steps, you can control your Kami connected devices in one place. Stay tuned for our growing family of smart products for the home!
Kami Home app gives you access to live footage of your home 24/7 and sends activity alerts to notify you of any unusual motion detected activity. Keep tabs on your nanny day and night, check in on your pets, or simply monitor your house. 
Kami Indoor Camera
The first product in our smart home lineup combines advanced AI features with full room visibility and a modern design: 
• Best in class 360 degree pan and 150 degree tilt to see more of the room
• Physical eyelid cover design for privacy on demand 
• Automatic tracking detects people or large pets for smarter alerts 
• Free 24-hour motion-captured video storage (and up to 30 days of video history with a paid subscription to Kami Cloud

bluejetty:00114432:ios.description:
The painter who constantly pursued light and color — Claude Monet.
What lies closed is not merely a "garden" — to step inside is to enter his memories, and his endless pursuit of light.
— The Garden at Giverny
— The pond and water lilies through the seasons
— The silent room where he lost his beloved
— and the "room of light" where his vision grows blurry
Collect the scattered "colors" and complete his final painting of water lilies. Therein lies his hope, entrusted to the artists of the future —
A new escape game where art and loss, as well as light and eternity, intersect.
【Features】
・Easy to start for first players. Let’s challenge!
・There are Hints, so Don’t worry!
・Auto-save function!
・No need for paper and pen! Swipe left from the right edge of the screen to take notes!
【How to play】
Very easy operation method!
・Search by tapping the screen.
・Change the viewpoint by tapping the button on the bottom of the screen.
・Double tap the item button, it will enlarged.
・Use an item by dragging it.
・While one item is displayed, select another item by either tapping or dragging it to combine them.
・There is a hint button from MENU which is the upper left corner of the screen.
【Jammsworks】
programmer：Asahi Hirata
Designer：Naruma Saito
Produced by two of us.
Our goal is to produce a game that would be fun for the users.
If you like this game, please play other games!
【Provide】
Music is VFR：http://musicisvfr.com
Pocket Sound : http://pocket-se.info/
icons8：https://icons8.com/

bluejetty:00073349:ios.summary:
Word Maker: Your Passport to Wordplay Adventure!
Dive into a world of mesmerizing word games and crossword puzzles like never before. Word Maker is your gateway to a captivating realm of brain-bending challenges and endless entertainment. S
bluejetty:00073349:ios.description:
Word Maker: Your Passport to Wordplay Adventure!
Dive into a world of mesmerizing word games and crossword puzzles like never before. Word Maker is your gateway to a captivating realm of brain-bending challenges and endless entertainment. Say goodbye to word game fatigue and hello to an immersive experience that'll put your linguistic prowess to the test while keeping you thoroughly amused. Prepare for an unforgettable word-hunting journey that's both thrilling and mentally stimulating!
Install Word Maker now for an instant ticket to an exhilarating word search and word connection odyssey that will sharpen your cognitive skills like never before.
Embark on a vocabulary expedition that involves letter linking, word uncovering, and crossword solving! Word Maker awaits you 24/7, whether you're on a break from work, school, or traveling, making it the ultimate rewarding pastime. Immerse yourself in the world of online word games and indulge in a delightful and relaxing word connection experience that the whole family can savor.
Word search enthusiasts, both online and offline, it's time to flex your word-searching and letter-linking muscles! Ready for a free word game puzzle challenge? We dare you to unlock an array of Word Maker levels and embark on a virtual word puzzle world tour!
From the dazzling lights of New York to the sun-kissed beaches of L.A., your word game adventure spans the entire globe! With a plethora of exhilarating word puzzles to conquer, you'll weave letters together, discover hidden words, and solve crosswords like never before. Each triumph uncovers fresh and thrilling crossword mysteries, all while supercharging your vocabulary and language skills. Brace yourself for a journey that will transport you to the farthest corners of the world and beyond, where the might of words reigns supreme!
WHY CHOOSE WORD MAKER?
- Hone your intellect with thousands of demanding word puzzles that'll push your language skills to their limits.
- Ascend the vocabulary ladder and unlock over 2000 levels of thrilling crossword challenges – how high can you climb?
- Accumulate gold coins at every twist and watch your rewards grow with each newly discovered word!
PLAYING WORD MAKER IS A BREEZE:
- Swipe letters in all directions to forge words that fill the crossword blanks, both horizontally and vertically.
- Need a nudge? Tap the Hint button for a helpful clue, or utilize the Shuffle button to rearrange the letters.
- Running low on hints? Amass coins or watch videos to bolster your word and letter connecting prowess.
WORD MAKER FEATURES AND PERKS:
- Traverse over 3000 levels and journey worldwide, unveiling new cities with each victory.
- Delight in a plethora of distinctive, gratis word game challenges suitable for the entire family.
- Immerse yourself in captivating graphics and backgrounds that accompany you on a soothing global expedition with our one-of-a-kind Travel Theme.
- Unlock fresh levels and bonus coins as you continue connecting words and unveiling new trials.
- Enjoy daily bonus rewards to boost your advancement and keep your mind razor-sharp.
- Perfect for enhancing memory, focus, and expanding your lexicon.
Challenge your language skills with puzzles that rigorously test your knowledge.
Join the Word Maker community and bask in the thrill of linking words and unlocking novel challenges every day! With our unique Travel Theme, you can explore the world from the comfort of your own home. Share your thoughts with us through reviews – we love hearing from our players!

The ESV Bible app allows you to easily read, study, and engage with God’s Word wherever you go, making it the best possible Bible reading experience for your phone or tablet.
Listen to Scripture with audio Bibles and meditate on God’s Word
bluejetty:00014157:ios.description:
The ESV Bible app allows you to easily read, study, and engage with God’s Word wherever you go, making it the best possible Bible reading experience for your phone or tablet.
Listen to Scripture with audio Bibles and meditate on God’s Word with instrumental background music. Customize your experience with a wide variety of reading plans and thematic playlist options, helping you make daily Bible reading a habit every day.
READ THE BIBLE WHEREVER YOU GO
• Toggle display options to a streamlined, distraction-free reader's mode
• Search tools allow you to quickly search the Bible by reference, keyword, or phrase
• Quick access to cross-references
LISTEN AND MEDITATE
• Listen to the Bible read aloud by acclaimed Christian artists, pastors, and Bible teachers
• Voices include Kristyn Getty, Ray Ortlund, Jackie Hill Perry, Michael Reeves, and more
• Instrumental background music to help you meditate as you listen
• A diverse selection of musical styles, artists, and genres
• Individual volume controls allow you to adjust the music and Bible audio separately
MAKE A HABIT OF BIBLE READING
• Choose from over 50 Bible reading plans
• One-year, devotional, and topical plans offer a wide variety of options to fit your lifestyle and reading goals
DIVE DEEPER INTO GOD’S WORD
• Access the ESV Global Study Bible for free
• Subscribe to unlock a full library of study resources, including the ESV Study Bible, ESV Archaeology Study Bible, Preaching the Word commentary series, ESV Expository Commentary series, and more
ENGAGE WITH SCRIPTURE
• Record your personal reflections using the easy-to-use notes feature
• Highlight and bookmark favorite portions of Scripture 
• All content saved via a free account is synced with ESV.org—giving you access to personal notes, bookmarks, and highlights from any device
• Adjust dozens of layout and text settings including font size, red letter, background color, and more
UNLOCK PREMIUM FEATURES 
• Access to the full range of study Bibles, commentaries, and playlists available online and in the app
• Over 50 playlists compile thematic verses to guide you through a particular mood, topic, or season
Deepen your time in God’s Word with customizable study and audio features available with the ESV Bible app. Download for free today!
EULA: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00136497:ios.description:
The Blood Pressure Diary App by MedM is the most connected blood pressure monitoring app in the world, designed to simplify blood pressure management at home, track trends, and export reports for the doctor. This smart blood pressure tracking assistant enables users to log data manually or to automatically capture readings from over 200 supported smart BPMs via Bluetooth. Aside from blood pressure, the app can help track medication intake, heart rate, oxygen saturation, respiration rate, and body weight with over a dozen of body composition parameters.
The app has a clean and intuitive interface and works with or without registration. Users decide if they want to keep their health data on their smartphone only, or additionally back it up to MedM Health Cloud (https://health.medm.com).
Blood Pressure Diary App by MedM can log the following data types:
• Blood Pressure
• Medication Intake
• Note
• Heart Rate
• Oxygen Saturation
• Respiration Rate
• Body Weight (including over a dozen body composition parameters)
The app’s data analysis tools help users identify patterns in blood pressure fluctuations, enabling them to take timely action and make necessary lifestyle changes or routine adjustments.
Blood Pressure Diary App by MedM is freemium, with the basic functionality available to all users. Premium Members, additionally, can sync select data types with other ecosystems (such as Apple, Google, Garmin, Fitbit), share access to their health data with other trusted MedM users (family members or caregivers), set up notifications for reminders, thresholds, and goals, as well as receive exclusive offers from MedM partners.
MedM follows all applicable best practices for data protection: the HTTPS protocol is used for cloud synchronisation, all health data is stored encrypted on securely hosted servers. Users exercise full control over their data and can at any time export and/or delete their health record.
Blood Pressure Diary App by MedM syncs with the following brands of smart blood pressure monitors: A&D Medical, Andesfit, Andon Health, AOJ Medical, Beurer, Bodimetrics, CliniCare, Contec, Dovant Health, Easy@Home, ETA, EZFAST, Famidoc, Finicare, FirstMed, Fleming Medical, ForaCare, Health&Life, HealthGear, Indie Health, iProven, Jumper Medical, Kinetik Wellbeing, LEICKE, Medisana, MicroLife, Multi, Omron, Oxiline, OxiPro Medical, PIC, Rossmax, SilverCrest, TaiDoc, TECH-MED, Transtek, TrueLife, Viatom, Welch Allyn, Yonker, Yuwell, Zewa, and more. For the full list of supported devices, please visit our website: https://www.medm.com/sensors.html
Jurisdiction statement: Blood Pressure Diary App by MedM enables users to record 7 different types of health measurements. These measurements can be entered manually by the user, imported from Apple Health, or obtained from health and wellness devices that have been approved by regulatory authorities in the countries where they are sold.
Disclaimer: Blood Pressure Diary App by MedM is designed solely for general fitness and wellness purposes and is not intended for medical use. Always consult a doctor before making any medical decisions.
MedM is the absolute world leader in smart medical device connectivity. Our apps provide seamless direct data collection from hundreds of fitness and medical devices, sensors, and wearables.
MedM – Enabling Connected Health®

bluejetty:00175358:ios.summary:

With just one click, you get the knowledge of how to operate the vehicle and its equipment. Explanatory animations, ima
bluejetty:00175358:ios.description:
The BMW Driver's Guide provides important, model-specific vehicle information on selected BMW, BMW i and BMW M models*.
With just one click, you get the knowledge of how to operate the vehicle and its equipment. Explanatory animations, image searches, answers to frequently asked questions and much more complete the app.
By entering the vehicle identification number (VIN), the appropriate model-specific vehicle information is downloaded and is also available offline. You can manage multiple vehicles within the BMW Driver’s Guide. 
If you don’t have a vehicle identification number (VIN) then simply explore the BMW demo vehicle.
The BMW Driver's Guide at a glance:
• Complete, model-specific Owner’s Handbook, including navigation, communication and entertainment
• Explanatory animations and personalized How-to videos
• Explanation on indicator and warning lights
• Quick links and brief information
• 360° View: Explore interactively the interior and exterior of your BMW model 
• Search by topics
• Search by vehicle pictures to find functions
• Answers to frequently asked questions (FAQ)
• Smart Scan for Apple iPhones: Point your mobile phone camera at an icon in the interior and receive information about the function
• Once downloaded, the BMW Driver’s Guide can also be used offline
*The BMW Driver's Guide is available for the following models:
• We support all BMW models starting from 2012 and partially offer support for older models
Supplementary information can be found in other brochures in the on-board documentation. 
The more familiar you are with the vehicle, the more confident you are on the road.
BMW wishes you a pleasant and safe driving.

bluejetty:00068968:ios.description:
Graffiti Creator: AI Graffiti, Editor Studio & Custom Name Design!
Unleash your creativity with Graffiti Creator, the ultimate AI graffiti generator and design studio for creating stunning graffiti text, custom names, stylish lettering, and personalized word art. Perfect for beginners and professionals, transform ideas into eye-catching graffiti designs in seconds—no drawing skills required!
Key Features
 # AI Graffiti Generator
Describe your style, colors, or theme, and let AI generate unique graffiti artwork instantly. Perfect for street art, urban lettering, nicknames, logos, and creative text.
# NEW: Editor Studio
Take full control of your graffiti designs with powerful editing tools.
• Move, resize, rotate, and flip objects
• Add stickers, shapes, and decorative elements
• Customize backgrounds
• Arrange layers for professional compositions
• Continue editing AI-generated graffiti
• Create completely unique artwork your way
# Extensive Graffiti Fonts Library
Explore a growing collection of authentic graffiti fonts, colorful outlines, shadows, and bold lettering styles.
# Custom Text Creator
Create personalized graffiti using up to 12 characters, numbers, and creative effects. Perfect for names, tags, nicknames, quotes, logos, and decals.
# Step-by-Step Drawing Tutorials
Learn graffiti techniques with guided lessons for tags, lettering, and sketching.
# High-Quality Export
Save crisp, high-resolution artwork ready for stickers, decals, shirts, posters, social media, logos, and printing.
# Easy Save & Share
Export your artwork to Photos or instantly share it with friends and social platforms.
# Regular Updates
Enjoy new AI styles, fonts, editing tools, and creative features with frequent updates.
Why Choose Graffiti Creator?
• AI-powered graffiti generation in seconds
• Powerful Editor Studio for complete customization
• Hundreds of graffiti-inspired fonts
• Perfect for names, logos, stickers, decals, shirts, and social media
• Beginner-friendly with professional-quality results
• Create unique graffiti without drawing experience
Whether you’re designing graffiti names, street art, custom logos, personalized lettering, or creative word art, Graffiti Creator gives you everything you need to design, edit, and share amazing graffiti artwork—all in one app.
=========
Read our privacy policy at https://bimake.net/graffiti-creator/privacy-policy.html
Read our terms and conditions at https://bimake.net/graffiti-creator/terms-and-conditions.html

bluejetty:00185533:ios.description:
Fifteen Puzzle is the classic sliding tile game. Slide the tiles into the empty space until the numbers are back in order from 1 to 15.
Shuffle the board to start a new game. The app counts your moves and your time, so you can try to finish faster or in fewer moves. If you get stuck, the preview button shows the solved board.
Pick one of six tile styles, including wood and high contrast, or turn one of your own photos into a puzzle.
You may know this game as the Gem Puzzle, the Boss Puzzle or Mystic Square.

bluejetty:00178932:ios.name: SleepMapper
bluejetty:00178932:ios.summary:
The SleepMapper app pairs with the SmartSleep Deep Sleep Headband and the connected Sleep & Wake-Up Light devices. Download the SleepMapper app to awaken to a better day tomorrow.
Enhancing deep sleep 
With SmartSleep Deep Sleep Headband:
bluejetty:00178932:ios.description:
The SleepMapper app pairs with the SmartSleep Deep Sleep Headband and the connected Sleep & Wake-Up Light devices. Download the SleepMapper app to awaken to a better day tomorrow.
Enhancing deep sleep 
With SmartSleep Deep Sleep Headband: Improves your total sleep experience - falling asleep, sleep quality and waking up. Measures your sleep stages and delivers audio tones to boost quality of deep sleep, increasing daytime energy. Soothes you to sleep with gentle sounds only you can hear. Smart Alarm wakes you with gentle sounds during periods of light sleep.
SmartSleep Deep Sleep Headband is a wearable sleep solution, proven to help improve the quality of your sleep for those who do not get enough sleep due to lifestyle. Sound tones enhance the “slow waves” your brain produces during deep sleep. Feel more rested and refreshed without changing how long you sleep. 
Waking up refreshed
With SmartSleep Sleep & Wake-Up Light: Fall asleep relaxed, wake up refreshed and learn about your bedroom environment. Monitor amongst other the light and sound levels so you can adjust to improve your sleep. 
Philips SmartSleep Sleep & Wake-Up Light is our premier Sleep & Wake-up Light and is designed to help you wake up refreshed after a productive night’s sleep. It combines the benefits of a Wake-up Light with RelaxBreathe, a guided wind-down-to-sleep feature that helps calm your body and mind – and offers extensive app-enabled customization for personalizing your sleeping environment. Philips SmartSleep Sleep & Wake-Up Light is part of our full range of light therapy products created to get you into a positive sleeping, waking and living routine.
You’re part of our first release of our sleep platform and we’d love your help to continuously improve. We welcome any feedback on how you’re finding the app, additional features, and improvement. Thank you for supporting and joining our healthy sleep community. 
Please note SleepMapper supports Philips SmartSleep Deep Sleep Headband and the connected Sleep & Wake-Up Light devices. For CPAP devices, please download the DreamMapper app.
For more info visit Philips.com/SmartSleep
This app is compatible with HealthKit for sleep tracking purposes.

bluejetty:00124164:ios.name: Pyramid Solitaire Mobile
bluejetty:00124164:ios.summary: You win by collecting all the cards from the board. You collect cards by tapping any two cards that add up to 13. Kings count as 13 so you can tap and collect the king with just one move. You can match any uncovered card. The goal of the ga
bluejetty:00124164:ios.description:
You win by collecting all the cards from the board. You collect cards by tapping any two cards that add up to 13. Kings count as 13 so you can tap and collect the king with just one move. You can match any uncovered card. The goal of the game is to clear as many boards as possible. If you can’t make any more matches, you should draw cards from the deck below.
GAME MODES
- Classic Games, the version you know and love using the classical pyramid layout
- Special Games with 290 custom layouts for you to enjoy
- Levels Mode, with 100,000 solvable levels that get more challenging as you play
- Daily Challenges that will put your Pyramid Solitaire skills to the test
FEATURES
- Easy to play and simple to use
- Designed for both Tablets and Phones of any size
- Nice sound effects and music
- Beautiful and simple graphics
- Big cards that are easy to see
- Responsive design
- Smart In-Game Help
- Statistics and many achievements to unlock
- Cloud Save, so you can always pick up where you left off. Your data will be synchronized across your multiple devices
- Online leaderboards to compete with people everywhere
TIPS
- Clear as many boards as you can by matching pairs of cards to get the value 13. Aces count as 1, Jacks count as 11, Queens count as 12 and Kings count as 13.
- You can tap away the king with just one move. To eliminate a queen, you need to match it with an ace. 
- On the board you will find a pyramid of cards and a stack from which you draw cards. If there are no available matches you can continue to draw from the stack.
- You can draw the entire stack three times over. Once there are no more turns to draw you can deal a new deck of cards.
- You can only deal two times. If you eliminate a pyramid of cards, you complete one board and you receive an extra deal.
If you have any technical problems please email us directly at support@gsoftteam.com. Please, don’t leave support problems in our comments – we don’t check those regularly and it will take longer to fix any issues that you might encounter. Thank you for your understanding!

Перший мобільний застосунок в Україні, що відповідає концепції «Д
bluejetty:00140994:ios.description:
Штрафи UA — національний мобільний застосунок для онлайн-перевірки та оплати штрафів ПДР, боргів у виконавчій службі, а також купівлі електронних полісів автоцивілки (ОСЦПВ).
Перший мобільний застосунок в Україні, що відповідає концепції «Держава у смартфоні» та з 2016 року розвиває державні онлайн-послуги у сфері авто-сервісів.
Увага! Знижка 50% при оплаті штрафу за порушення правил паркування протягом перших 10 днів.
АвтоАсистент
Новий сервіс від Штрафи UA — допомога на дорогах України та країн ЄС. Дає відчуття впевненості за кермом у будь-якому місті та країні. Де б ви не перебували, підтримка спілкується зрозумілою вам мовою.
Лише один свайп.
Підписки:
- Premium — повний набір переваг.
- Plus та Basic — гнучкі можливості.
Найпоширеніші запити:
- Евакуація у разі ДТП або поломки
- Доставка пального
- Технічна допомога без евакуації
- Заміна колеса
- Аварійне відкриття дверей
- Доставка дубліката ключа
- Консультації з адвокатом
- Оренда авто
- тощо 
Країни обслуговування: Україна, країни ЄС.
Компенсації та заощадження:
- Компенсація вартості проживання, стоянки авто, квитків
- Максимальні знижки на придбання полісів ОСЦПВ та «Зеленої картки»
- Мінімальна комісія на погашення штрафу
За потреби допомоги чи консультації просто зробіть свайп — підтримка у пріоритетному порядку зв’яжеться з вами та допоможе вирішити питання.
Де б ви не були — у Карпатських горах чи в центрі мегаполісу Європи — наша підтримка завжди вас почує, зрозуміє й допоможе.
Автострахування
Штрафи UA — єдиний застосунок в Україні, де можна купити електронний поліс ОСЦПВ, використовуючи лише державний номер авто. Не потрібно їхати в офіс і заповнювати папери: достатньо ввести номер — система швидко визначить необхідні дані для оформлення. Ми гарантуємо миттєву реєстрацію електронного поліса у централізованій базі МТСБУ. Це дуже зручно!
За державним реєстраційним номером ви отримаєте інформацію про свій транспортний засіб:
1. марка та модель;
2. VIN-код;
3. тип двигуна;
4. місто реєстрації;
5. рік випуску;
6. перевірка страхового поліса.
Усе це допоможе точно розрахувати вартість поліса. Ми використовуємо дані національних реєстрів.
Штрафи
Ми перевіряємо всі типи штрафів ПДР у 26 національних реєстрах. Також надаємо унікальний сервіс перевірки штрафів за паркування в більшості міст України (Одеса, Дніпро, Львів, Ужгород тощо). Після оплати штрафу повідомляємо про його погашення в базі поліції України.
Борги
Будьте впевнені, що за вами не значаться борги: навіть невеликий прострочений штраф може перетворитися на виконавче провадження з арештом майна чи зірваною поїздкою. У застосунку ви вчасно дізнаєтесь про заборгованості.
Документи
Застосунок позбавляє паперової тяганини: усі квитанції за штрафи, борги та поліси автоцивілки зберігаються у вашому смартфоні.
Законодавство
Згідно з ПДР України (п. 2.1 ґ) водій повинен мати чинний поліс ОСЦПВ. Відомості про нього підтверджуються у централізованій базі даних, оператором якої є МТСБУ.
Рекомендації
При перевірці патрульною поліцією достатньо відкрити розділ «Автоцивілка» у застосунку, щоб підтвердити номер і строк дії поліса, або показати візуальну форму поліса (електронну чи паперову).

bluejetty:00180155:ios.description:
Discover what to see, plan a day around your interests, and explore on foot with walking itineraries and an interactive city map. Less time planning. More time enjoying the trip.
- Personalized day plans based on your interests and available time.
- Walking itineraries with clear stops and estimated walking times.
- An interactive map to explore places and see where to go next.
- Sights, history, art, architecture, parks and more to match your mood.
- Useful place details to help you decide what to visit.
- My Day to bring your chosen places together in one plan.
YOUR DAY, YOUR WAY
A few hours to spare or a full day to explore? Choose what you feel like doing and how much time you have. Get a suggested plan, review the stops, and adapt it to the day you want. Spend more time on the things that interest you, whether that means a museum visit, remarkable architecture or a walk through green spaces.
TURN IDEAS INTO A DAY OUT
Browse places by interest, take a closer look at what catches your eye, and add your choices to My Day. Bring together the sights you came to see and places you might otherwise have walked past.
EXPLORE ONE STOP AT A TIME
Pick a walking itinerary, preview its stops and walking times, and see how it fits into your day. Use the map to put each place in context and find your next stop as you explore.
KNOW MORE BEFORE YOU GO
Find out what makes each place worth a visit, check practical details and estimated visit times, and decide where to spend your time.
Download your travel companion and make your next day out your own.

From calculating math problems, taking photos to search for problems, and doing handwritten calculations, to analyzing basic data, calculating date intervals, and calculating body mass index (BMI) - this all-in-one calculator app is designed for study and daily use. Unit & Currency Converter
Quickly convert measurements, currencies, and units across multiple categories.
Photo Problem Solver
Take a picture of your question and get instant step-by-step solutions.
Scientific Calculator
Solve complex math problems with ease — from algebra to trigonometry and beyond.
Handwriting Pad
Write out equations freely like on paper, with smart recognition and real-time solving.
Everyday Utilities
Calculate date differences, track BMI, analyze basic data, and more.
Perfect for students, professionals, and anyone who needs a smart assistant for numbers and daily tasks.

bluejetty:00165807:ios.name: Hidden Object Cursed Heart F2P
bluejetty:00165807:ios.summary: Step into a mystical realm where love, power, and danger collide in "Royal Romances: Cursed Hearts", a spellbinding hidden object adventure. As a princess caught in a web of royal politics and magical peril, your choices will determine not
bluejetty:00165807:ios.description:
Step into a mystical realm where love, power, and danger collide in "Royal Romances: Cursed Hearts", a spellbinding hidden object adventure. As a princess caught in a web of royal politics and magical peril, your choices will determine not only your destiny but the future of the entire kingdom. This richly detailed world is filled with hidden treasures, mythical creatures, and magic puzzles that will challenge both your intellect and courage. With every decision you make, the lives of those you love, and the entire kingdom, hang in the balance.
Would you like to spend some time as a delicate princess in a world full of magic? Life in a royal palace is not as easy as it may seem! Your formidable father organizes a deadly contest among the contenders for your heart, a stab in the back is something to be expected daily even from your dearest, and instead of grand feasts and balls, you have to settle the problems of the subjects living within and beyond the borders of your kingdom. But the result can bring luscious rewards – an undying love willing to pull a star from the high skies just for your pleasure.
· EPIC LOVE STORY!
From secret alliances to tragic love, the story thrusts you into a perilous love triangle where every decision could mean heartbreak, betrayal, or a powerful royal union. Dive into the intricacies of royal life, where every character has hidden motives!
· A VARIETY OF ACHIEVEMENTS!
Put your intellect to the test with intricate puzzles and relaxing mini-games scattered throughout your hidden objects quest. Earn a variety of achievements as you unravel bright objects and hidden objects of the kingdom and prove that true love can conquer any challenge!
· ENCHANTING LOCATIONS!
Travel through beautifully designed landscapes, from lush enchanted forests to foreboding, cursed castles. Each realm is filled with secrets waiting to be uncovered, dangerous foes to outsmart, and hidden treasures to discover!
· YOUR OWN CHOICES!
Join a captivating world of royal romances as you embark on an exciting journey. Explore point and click adventure games where you'll search for hidden treasures and uncover clues that could lead you to the heart of the princess. Every choice you make carries weight, shaping the fates and lives of the characters around you!
Explore a vast world of Royal Romances, from enchanted forests to dark dungeons, and confront magical forces in our free-to play point and click adventure games!
-----
Questions? Email us at support@dominigames.com
Find other games on our official website: https://dominigames.com/
Become our fan on Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/dominigames
Check out our Instagram and stay tuned: https://www.instagram.com/dominigames

bluejetty:00065146:ios.description:
“Meet the new digital face of Nedbank Private Wealth. Our clients now have access to a distinctive, easy-to-use app for keeping track of personal wealth, banking transactions and investments. Using the single, integrated app, our clients can go beyond banking, with an interface for viewing their wealth.”
App Features
Please note that some features will differ for Nedbank Private Wealth South African and International accountholders.
Secure and easy log in using a fingerprint or FaceID.
A consolidated dashboard, which shows a 360° view of your wealth with Nedbank Private Wealth.
Quick and easy access to your accounts wherever you are.
Enjoy the convenience of trading shares on your phone.*
Get help instantly with in-app messaging.*
Make payments, transfer between your accounts and arrange foreign exchange.**
In-app PIN reveal, statement and valuation delivery to your online document store.**
*South African accountholders only
**International accountholders only
We have ensured that the technology used in the app adheres to the highest levels of security, to protect our clients’ personal information and their wealth, and to provide complete peace of mind. With a secure sign-in every time they use the app, and additional security verification steps when transacting, clients can be sure that:
Their personal and wealth information is kept confidential; and
No-one else will be able to transact on their profile if they misplace their phone.
 For more information regarding our app, please visit our website:
Nedbank Private Wealth South African Accountholders
https://www.nedbankprivatewealth.co.za/content/private-wealth-sa/south-africa/en/products-and-services/tools/NedbankPrivateWealthApp.html
Nedbank Private Wealth International Accountholders
https://nedbankprivatewealth.com/information-for-clients/online-access/

bluejetty:00019141:ios.name: Horse World - Show Jumping
bluejetty:00019141:ios.summary:
London, Sydney, Hong Kong and Paris: they all want you! Show your skills in show jumping and take part in international tournaments. Bring home first place and take care of your horses. You are a team. Are you ready for the next course?
**
bluejetty:00019141:ios.description:
London, Sydney, Hong Kong and Paris: they all want you! Show your skills in show jumping and take part in international tournaments. Bring home first place and take care of your horses. You are a team. Are you ready for the next course?
***The second installment in the successful HorseWorld series***
 Following HorseWorld 3D comes HorseWorld: Show Jumping as the next great horse simulation for you to discover and enjoy! Improved graphics and even more exciting riding courses make this app a must-have for any horse lover.
***Equip your horses***
Each of your horses deserves its very own special equipment! Discover various saddles, saddle pads, bridles and leg wraps. Don’t forget to customize your mighty steed’s mane according to your taste! Happy with your new gear? Then make the most of it at the next tournament!
***Build and create your own jumping courses!***
You’re through with the boring old jumping course on the ranch – now it’s time for you and your horses to explore the world! Big cities like Paris and New York await you and your talent on challenging courses. Demonstrate great timing and your love of horses, and win every tournament in the world!
***Jump into a brand new world***
If you are fed up with the big city life, you can retire to the mysterious Fantasy Island. Red mushrooms, magical waterfalls and an exciting course await you here. Here's an idea: Try out this jumping course with the magical unicorn.
***Care for your horses before tackling the course***
Your dear horses can only do their best if they’re taken care of, so you’ve got to fulfill their needs and wishes. Feeding, brushing, and combing are all on the agenda, but of course there’s also time for some cuddles! After lots of fun out in the meadow, the course will be no problem for the two of you.
* Various beautiful horses, such as Hannoverians, English Thoroughbreds, Arabians and Andalusians, are just waiting for you to care for them!
* Customize your horses’ equipment and manes!
* A magical world is waiting to be discovered by you: experience magical moments with the unicorn on Fantasy Island.
* Design and build your very own jumping courses!
* Demonstrate your skills in the world’s biggest tournaments
Jump in the saddle and let’s go! Download HorseWorld: Show Jumping and try out the challenging courses.
Visit us on Facebook: facebook.com/tivolamobile

bluejetty:00091607:ios.description:
AI-Powered Workouts That Deliver Real Results!We will customize a 21-day personalized fitness plan for you! Even if you're a complete beginner in fitness, you can easily master the knack and enjoy the fun of working out. With "MuscleMaxme", you can achieve a healthy and fit physique!
● Professionally Customized, Your Exclusive Personal Fitness Course
Everyone's physical condition and fitness expectations are different. "MuscleMaxme" has assembled a team of top fitness experts in the industry. Through advanced algorithms and detailed questionnaire assessments, we will create a unique customized plan for you. Whether you aim to build muscle, lose fat, or maintain your current body shape, we will precisely plan every step of your training journey to ensure that every drop of sweat you shed brings you closer to a better version of yourself.
● Flexible Workouts, Easy Shaping
Daily workouts only take 10 to 15 minutes, so you don't have to endure the boredom and pain of long-hour exercises.
● From Novice to Expert
Whether you're a fitness novice or an experienced professional, you can find suitable courses through our easy-to-understand guidance. Since everyone's fitness level varies, you should choose exercise methods that match your own ability and pace.
● Work out All Parts of the Body
The courses designed by our fitness experts are aimed at helping you achieve your goals. You can choose a full-body workout or focus on specific body parts, making your training more targeted.
"MuscleMaxme" – The ultimate fitness partner exclusively designed for men, taking you on a personalized fitness journey!
This is a video-based learning platform for fitness enthusiasts. With the help of high-definition video tutorials, professional coaches will demonstrate every movement and explain the key points and details in depth. Even if you're at home, you can enjoy professional gym-level guidance. With daily updated training programs, your fitness journey will always be full of novelty and challenges.
"MuscleMaxme" Automatic Renewal Service Instructions
【"MuscleMaxme"】Enjoy multiple privileges, such as intelligent customized plans, professional assessments, and unlimited access to courses.
【Subscription Cycle】
Continuous Monthly Subscription: The subscription cycle is 1 month.
Continuous Six-Month Subscription: The subscription cycle is 6 months.
Continuous Annual Subscription: The subscription cycle is 12 months.
【Subscription Fees】
Subject to the information of in-App Purchase (iAP). For example, the continuous monthly subscription product costs 48 yuan per month, and the continuous annual subscription product costs 188 yuan per year.
【Payment】
After the user confirms the purchase and makes the payment, the amount will be deducted from the iTunes account.
【Auto-renewal】
The "Continuous Monthly / Annual" products support auto-renewal. After the purchase is confirmed, the fee will be deducted from your iTunes account. Unless you cancel the auto-renewal at least 24 hours before the end of the current subscription, the subscription will be automatically renewed. Apple will automatically deduct the fee from the iTunes account within 24 hours before the subscription expires. Upon successful payment, the membership validity period will be extended by one cycle.
【Canceling Auto-renewal】
On your Apple iOS device, open the "App Store" --> Click on the Apple account avatar in the upper right corner --> Enter the "Account" section --> Click on "Subscriptions" --> Select "MuscleMaxme" and cancel the subscription.

bluejetty:00033685:ios.developer: Maria de los Llanos Goig Monino
bluejetty:00033685:ios.summary: La Biblia Israelita Nazarena VIN es una extraordinaria aplicación diseñada para sumergirte en la riqueza espiritual y cultural de la Biblia Israelita Nazarena, una traducción única y profunda de las Sagradas Escrituras. Con esta aplicación,
bluejetty:00033685:ios.description:
La Biblia Israelita Nazarena VIN es una extraordinaria aplicación diseñada para sumergirte en la riqueza espiritual y cultural de la Biblia Israelita Nazarena, una traducción única y profunda de las Sagradas Escrituras. Con esta aplicación, tendrás acceso a una extensa colección de textos bíblicos, herramientas de estudio y recursos para explorar la palabra de Dios de una manera más profunda y significativa.
La aplicación está diseñada especialmente para aquellos que desean estudiar la Biblia de manera fácil y accesible en cualquier momento y lugar.
Esta aplicación te ofrece la oportunidad única de leer la Biblia en español, preservando el sabor y la fuerza del antiguo texto hebreo. La VIN es una versión actualizada basada en las mejores traducciones y fuentes antiguas y modernas, y se ha cotejado cuidadosamente con el Texto Hebreo Masorético para el Tanakh y con los Textos Griegos y Versiones Arameas para los Escritos Nazarenos.
La aplicación La Biblia Versión Israelita Nazarena VIN es perfecta para aquellos que buscan una experiencia de lectura y estudio directa de la palabra de Dios. Después de descargar la aplicación, podrás disfrutar de la Biblia de y sin necesidad de una conexión a internet, ya que funciona perfectamente en modo offline.
Características Destacadas:
Biblioteca Completa de la Biblia Israelita Nazarena: La aplicación incluye la Biblia completa en su traducción Israelita Nazarena, que es conocida por su enfoque en las raíces hebreas del cristianismo y su fidelidad a los textos originales.
Herramientas de Estudio Avanzadas: La Biblia Israelita Nazarena VIN ofrece una variedad de herramientas de estudio para enriquecer tu comprensión de las Escrituras. Esto incluye comentarios, notas de estudio, diccionarios bíblicos y concordancias para ayudarte a profundizar en los significados y contextos de los versículos.

bluejetty:00029819:ios.description:
See the market at a glance. Stock Map turns the S&P 500, Nasdaq 100, and Dow Jones into heat maps, with tiles sized by market cap and colored by stock performance.
EXPLORE THE MARKET
- Switch between the S&P 500, Nasdaq 100, and Dow Jones
- See a full index on one screen, then zoom into sectors, industries, and individual stocks
- Switch between maps and sortable lists for the main index, favorites, and watchlists
- Sort lists by market cap, best or worst performance, price, or symbol
- View 1 day and 1 week free, or unlock 1 month, 3 months, and 1 year with Premium
- Open stocks in Apple Stocks
YOUR STOCKS, YOUR MAPS
- Keep the stocks you follow together in Favorites
- Create watchlists for your investing ideas and themes
- Sync favorites, watchlists, and settings across iPhone, iPad, and Mac with iCloud (Premium)
ON YOUR HOME SCREEN
- Follow stocks with Category, Favorites, and Watchlist heat map widgets
- Open the app quickly with the Lock Screen icon widget (iOS 16 or later)
- Widget refresh interval: 30 minutes free, or choose 10–60 minutes with Premium. Actual timing depends on the system.
CUSTOMIZATION
- Use dark mode or choose a color-blind friendly palette
- Choose market-cap or equal stock sizes, with separate settings for the main map, favorites, watchlists, and widgets
- Choose a different category for each category widget
- Open stocks in Yahoo Finance in-app or in your browser
- Customize what a tap does when zoomed in or out
Stock Map is free to download, with an optional monthly or annual Premium subscription for additional features and customization. No ads.
Available on iPhone, iPad, and Mac.
Stock Map is a visualization tool, not investment advice. Data is provided for informational purposes only.

bluejetty:00126524:ios.description:
You can use the new Simple app with your usual Simple account. When you log in to your account, you’ll find all the goods and products you bought with the old Simple (Classic) app: mobile tickets and passes, event tickets, vignettes, insurances you’ve taken out, and your purchase history. 
You can use the new Simple app regardless of your bank: you can easily save bank cards issued by any bank and use them to pay for the services available via the application.
Services available in the renewed Simple app
Parking – payment of parking fees for public areas and indoor spaces countrywide:
- parking reservation and timing of expiry time,
- multiple vehicle registration numbers can be saved, 
- warning on zone boundary,
- location-based reminders.
e-Vignette – purchase of Hungarian motorway vignettes:
- for up to several vehicles, timing of the start of validity for weekly and monthly e-vignettes
- electronic invoice available,
- warning of the date of expiry of the vignette.
Mobile ticket/BKK – buy public transport mobile tickets and passes countrywide: 
- BKK passes and weekly and daily tickets, normal and time-based tickets
- Volánbusz intercity and local bus tickets and passes,
- tickets and passes from many other local operators.
Food ordering – order food with the app:
- in nearly 800 cities and towns across the country, 
- from the full range of Falatozz.hu,
- delivery even to multiple addresses.
Vehicle assistance insurance (breakdown assistance):
- in cooperation with the insurance provider Groupama,
- for vehicles up to 15 years old.
Device insurance for mobile phones: 
- in cooperation with the insurance provider Magyar Posta Biztosító 
- against theft and breakage, not just for new devices
- with a monthly payment option.
QR code payment – pay for your online SimplePay purchases quickly and easily using Simple app.
Money orders – with new functions: 
- save money orders for later payment, 
- payment of partially filled money orders.
Loyalty card:
- save any barcode loyalty card in the app.
OTP SZÉP card check balance service.
OTP Health Fund – balance top-up.
You can run Simple and Simple Classic applications on your device simultaneously.
Our Customer Service is available 24/7 via the usual contact details!

* Detailed FODMAP breakdown: understand the "why" behind each rating with a detailed breakdown of oligos, fructose, polyols, and lactose content.
* Powerful search & filter: find exactly what you need by searching for specific foods or filtering by category and FODMAP rating.
* Individual personalization: tailor the food list as you discover your own tolerances, empowering you to fine-tune your diet.
Stop guessing and start enjoying food again! Download this app to help you manage your IBS symptoms and improve your digestive health.
Note: This app is provided for educational purposes only. Always consult a doctor before making changes to your diet.
