bluejetty:00041024:ios.description:
Tales of Fablecraft is a lot like that tabletop RPG with dragons and dungeons – but easier to GM and play.
* ROLEPLAY WITH AN EVOLVING D6 *
Fablecraft uses its own D6 system that’s built around accessibility. Since we’re a virtual tabletop RPG, we do something interesting with our dice: their faces evolve as your Mages level up.
* LESS PREP, MORE PLAY *
Don’t get us wrong, prep can be fun. But if you’re looking for adventures that you can jump into in minutes, Fablecraft is perfect for you and your party.
* DRAG & DROP ARTWORK *
Party gone rogue? Adapt to their off-course antics by dragging and dropping in environments, NPCs, and battlemaps. It’s easy to change plans on the fly, no matter how many chaos gremlins are in your party.
* FIGHT MONSTERS, NOT MANUALS *
Forget rifling through a handbook or cluttered menu to figure out your attack plan. With combat that plays like a turn-based strategy game, you’ll be a damage dealer or friendly healer from the start.
* FEATURES * 
• Easy to pick up and play, in-person or remote, no TTRPG experience required
• Tailormade digital platform with built-in video, audio, and text chat
• Cross-play, cross-platform
• Ready-to-play adventures are easy for GMs to run, limited-to-no prep required
• Full suite of animated artwork, music, interactive battlemaps and combat VFX
• Create your own adventures with a growing list of homebrew tools!

What Plane? was built to answer one question—fast: what’s that aircraft overhead?
Everything is designed for instant glanceability, so you can get the answer without “using an app”. Add the widget to your Home Screen and tap to refresh. Ta
bluejetty:00200201:ios.description:
What Plane? was built to answer one question—fast: what’s that aircraft overhead?
Everything is designed for instant glanceability, so you can get the answer without “using an app”. Add the widget to your Home Screen and tap to refresh. Tap the custom aircraft icon to jump straight into the live map.
Inside the app, controls stay just as simple. Want different units? Tap any stat (altitude, speed, distance) to cycle through options. The default view lets you explore nearby air traffic, and with a single tap on any aircraft—or the menu button—you can browse rich details for every plane within 30 nautical miles.
To keep the interface minimal while adding real information density, What Plane? uses the Compass Ring: the panel border doubles as a bearing indicator, showing the aircraft’s direction relative to you at a glance.
And when an aircraft is overhead, the widget brings it to life with airline-specific liveries and aircraft models—so your Home Screen matches what’s in the sky.
WHATPLANE PRO (OPTIONAL SUBSCRIPTION)
Choose the aircraft you want to spot and get an alert when a match is nearby. Chat with Lookout to ask about aircraft recorded in your area while you were away, and prioritise your matches in Dynamic Island.
Pro is a monthly auto-renewable subscription, purchased separately in the app, with a one-week free trial for eligible new subscribers. After the trial, the subscription renews at the displayed monthly price unless cancelled. The local price is shown before purchase. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. Your subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the current period ends. Manage or cancel in your App Store account settings.
Privacy: https://whatplane.org/privacy
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

Grocery shopping for foods allowed by your WIC* program can be confusing. Much of the problem is from not knowing exactly what products you can purchase with your WIC benefits. WICShopper is here to help you shop with confidence. Using WICShopper, you can check the WIC eligibility of products while you shop! In all of our supported WIC programs, you can use your phone to scan products to check their WIC eligibility. 
In most supported states, you may register your eWIC card, then automatically download your CURRENT and FUTURE benefits every time you shop! WICShopper doesn’t just tell you if the product is WIC eligible… it tells you if you have enough WIC benefits left to purchase the product! 
In states that use "smart cards" such as Texas, New Mexico and Louisiana it is not possible to load your prescription because it is stored on your card. In these states, you can use the app to capture and store an image of your benefits to use the next time you shop.
Here is what WIC participants are saying about WICShopper:
"This app ROCKS! I was able to see my balance & the best part was being able to scan barcodes! Saved me a lot of headaches! Love this app, very convenient!"
"Loooooove this app!!! So helpful, simple and useful! I've recommended it to everyone I know with the benefits. Thanks for making it."
"Awesome app. I love being able to see my wic balance with out having to save and scramble for a recent reciept when I need to go to the store. Very convenient!"
"LOVE IT!!!!!! I can never find my receipt so this is very convenient and handy. Even if this app was $1 I would pay for it."
"This is awesome u know how many times ive got up to the register n it not b wic approved or something is wrong. Now i can check b4 thank u"
"U can scan it to make sure it's approved ?!? Awesome!!"
"This is a wonderful app. I love the options it has for recipes, and its so helpful to remember the benefits your recieving for the month. Its also nice that the App. sends you a reminder on the last day to use your benefits."
"Thought this was neat cause u don't know ur wic balance unless u go to the store n get a receipt. It even lets u scan stuff to see if its wic approved"
"Aww me gusto!"
"I live in Iowa and this app has been SUCH a lifesaver! I am using the barcode scanner constantly because there are things covered by WIC that I never knew about and it's so handy! Juggling my 3 girls at the store is hard enough without having to wonder "is this covered?" or "did I use all of that already?" I love that when you scan an item it bot only tells you if its allowed but it tells you exactly how much is allowed! I couldn't be happier. :)"
"I have it and love it takes the guess out of shopping for my daughter."
"This is awesome!! Since we don't have checks anymore I've been forgetting what all I have left lol."
We are adding new states as quickly as possible, so if your state isn't listed please check back soon! To learn more about WICShopper, please visit our website @ www.ebtshopper.com.

bluejetty:00123803:ios.summary: Craft The World is a unique sandbox strategy game, the mix of Dungeon Keeper, Terraria and Dwarf Fortress. Explore a random generated world populated by dangerous creatures, build a dwarf fortress, gather resources, and craft all the items,
bluejetty:00123803:ios.description:
Craft The World is a unique sandbox strategy game, the mix of Dungeon Keeper, Terraria and Dwarf Fortress. Explore a random generated world populated by dangerous creatures, build a dwarf fortress, gather resources, and craft all the items, weapons, and armor you need. 
Pocket Edition contains all 4 worlds of the Steam version:
http://store.steampowered.com/app/248390
GOD-SIMULATION
You control a tribe of dwarves by giving them commands to dig in certain places, attack enemy creatures, and build houses and other structures. You'll need to provide your dwarves food and clothing, as well as help them with magic when fighting against other inhabitants of the world. You start the game with one dwarf and gain additional dwarves as your experience level increases.
SANDBOX GAME
Each game level has many layers of earth to explore, from the sky down to boiling subterranean lava. The level is randomly generated as an island, restricted by natural boundaries: oceans on the edges, lava beneath it, and the sky above. Other features include day and night and changing weather conditions. The worlds differ in size, humidity, temperature, terrain, and flora and fauna. Abandoned halls and rooms with treasure are hidden somewhere deep within the islands.
CRAFTING
One feature of the game is a user-friendly system of recipes for crafting. The recipes are organized and easily accessible. You can craft dozens of different items: building blocks for houses, furniture, decorations, weapons, armor, ammunition, and food for your dwarves.
RTS
At the outset you find the recipes for basic tools and items, and build a small house with places to sleep and eat. Then, the size of the tribe increases and catches the attention of other inhabitants of the world. Most of them are night creatures and dwell underground. The worlds are full of fantasy creatures like zombies, skeletons, goblins, beholders, ghosts, giant spiders, and others. Some of them pay little attention to the dwarves, as long as the dwarves do not come into their field of vision. Others gather into quite large groups and try to break into the dwarves’ residence.
TOWER DEFENSE
Especially dangerous are the waves of monsters that appear from time to time from portals. So, do not neglect to build a safe haven with strong walls and numerous trapdoors, cells, firing towers, and secret passageways.
MAGIC
As a divine being, you possess various spells. You can speed up the movement of the dwarves, open small portals, illuminate dark caves to scare away monsters, evoke natural magic in the form of rain or tree growth, hurl fireballs at the monsters’ heads, and find useful resources and hidden rooms underground, thereby helping to speed up resource extraction, exploration of the world, and the population growth of your assistants.

bluejetty:00180650:ios.description:
If you need an app to track temperature for you, your family or your patients, this app will be the one.
You can track multiple people’s temperature separately by this app; Log the temperature with time, test position, symptoms, taken medicines and other note text; Check temperature tendency by chart by day, week, month or custom date range; Share the logs with others by email in format of PDF, CSV or HTML.
Install this app for those who need to keep a close eye on the temperature changes.
Key Features:
⁃ Log temperature with time, test position, symptoms, taken medicines and other note text.
⁃ Track multiple people’s temperature separately.
⁃ View chart tendency of temperature by day, week, month or custom date range.
⁃ Check statistics of different temperature range by number and pie chart.
⁃ Share date by email in format of PDF, CSV or HTML.
⁃ Print data directly.
⁃ Manage medicines data.
⁃ Custom each profile’s max normal and min normal temperate.
⁃ Custom symptoms when taking temperature.
⁃ Add unlimited reminders to take temperature, take medicines or do other things. 
⁃ Passcode protection.
⁃ Dropbox backup and restore.
⁃ Supports Apple Watch.
⁃ Supports universal version (available on both iPhone and iPad). 
Apple Health
Temp. Statistics is able to read and write temp data only according to your permissions and preferences.
If allowing TEMP. STATISTICS to write data, you could transfer the temp data to Health App easily. If allowing TEMP. STATISTICS to read data, you could import temp data manually from Health App to this App conveniently. 
Please contact us by email for any feedback or suggestion: linklinksapp@tom.com.

bluejetty:00177089:ios.description:
Health Weather is an APP that pays attention to the impact of weather changes on human health, analyzes and log the impact of weather factors, predicts the health weather index, and makes early warnings for weather changes.
 Many people often have headaches or joint pains before rain. Many studies have shown that weather changes can trigger some symptoms. Some weather factors have a similar effect, such as pollen for asthma patients, air pollution for COPD patients,But some factors do have significant individual differences, and each person's tolerance level is also very different. Therefore, it is necessary to log and analyze the weather conditions of symptom. Comprehensive analysis may give a general reference.
 The Health Weather track and analyzes the weather impact for six symptoms: Arthritis, Asthma, Migraine, Sinus headache, Common cold, and COPD.
 【Disclaimer】
 But we must make the following statement:
 1. The APP cannot be used as a diagnostic tool. you can not judge whether you are a patient with a symptom based on your reaction to the weather coincide with the weather forecast effect of the APP on the symptom, but you should go to the hospital doctor for a diagnosis.
 2. The App also does not give any medical advice. The app just reminds you that weather changes may affect you.
 3. Weather changes are only one of the many reasons that trigger symptoms. After using this APP, you should not only pay attention to the influence of the weather, but also the influence of other factors.
The APP is mainly divided into the following four parts:
1. Weather
 Hourly weather forecast and analysis, daily weather, air pollen, health index forecast
2. Log
 List of health logs, view and modify, delete
3. Analysis:
 Graphical analysis showing the influence distribution of each factor
4. Mine
 App setting

Will you manage to solve the mystery of Detectives United 7: Mission Possible? Immerse yourself in the detective hidden object game by solving puzzles. Explore unusual locations and find out what happened to the DU agents.
Ewan, Dorian and Anna go on a mission to Myst Hill, where, according to their sources, people are disappearing and the streets are covered with the footprints of ferocious predators. On their way into town, the agents get into a car accident and are attacked by an unknown man in a beast mask. 
Note that this is a free trial version of the hidden objects game. 
You can get the full version by means of an in-app purchase.
FIND OUT WHAT HAPPENED TO DU AGNETS
Play as your favorite characters - each of them has a different personality. Complete puzzles and mini-games, find clues, explore hidden object scenes and find out what's really going on in Myst Hill?
LEARN WHO IS RESPONSIBLE FOR DISAPPEARANCES OF PEOPLE IN MYST HILL
Anna comes back to her senses at the scene of the accident to see that Dorian and Euan are missing and a few bloody footprints nearby. She sets off on the trail of her colleagues, but her plans are thwarted by the ferocious predators and men in white robes that infest the streets of the small town. Will the DU agents be able to cope with the next threat and stay alive? Can they find out what secrets Myst Hill is keeping?

Play as DU agents and find out what happened to Ewan who went to meet his newfound relative. Travel back in time and learn more about Ewan's family. Face the new danger threatening the DU agents and prove yourself.

bluejetty:00200044:ios.name: Scrivener
bluejetty:00200044:ios.summary:
“The biggest software advance for writers since the word processor.” —Michael Marshall Smith, bestselling author
Typewriter. Ring-binder. Scrapbook. Scrivener combines all the writing tools you need to craft your first draft, from nascent
bluejetty:00200044:ios.description:
“The biggest software advance for writers since the word processor.” —Michael Marshall Smith, bestselling author
Typewriter. Ring-binder. Scrapbook. Scrivener combines all the writing tools you need to craft your first draft, from nascent notion to final full stop.
Tailor-made for creating long manuscripts, Scrivener banishes page fright by allowing you to compose your text in any order, in sections as large or small as you like. Got a great idea but don’t know where it fits? Write when inspiration strikes and find its place later. Grow your manuscript organically, idea by idea.
Whether you plan or plunge, Scrivener works your way: meticulously outline every last detail first, or hammer out a complete draft and restructure later. Or do a bit of both. All text sections in Scrivener are fully integrated with its outlining tools, so working with an overview of your manuscript is only ever a tap away, and turning Chapter Four into Chapter One is as simple as drag and drop.
Need to refer to research? In Scrivener, your background material is always at hand. Write a description based on a photograph. Reference a video or PDF. Check for consistency with an earlier chapter. On the iPad, open two documents side-by-side; on the iPhone, flip between research and writing with just two taps.
Once you’re ready to share your work with the world, simply compile everything into a single document for printing, or export to popular formats such as Word, PDF, Final Draft or plain text. You can even share using different formatting, so that you can write in your favorite font and still keep your editor happy.
FEATURES
Get Started
• Interactive tutorial project
• Keep each manuscript and supporting materials in a self-contained project
• Import Word, RTF, Final Draft and plain text files
• Easily split imported text into separate sections
Get Writing
• Write your manuscript in sections of any size
• View all sections as a single text using the “Draft Navigator” (iPad only)
• Quickly navigate sections using the “binder” sidebar
• Format with fonts and presets
• Comments, footnotes, links and highlights
• Simple bullets and lists
• Insert images
• Pinch-zoom to resize text
• Full-screen mode (iPad only)
• Typewriter scrolling mode keeps typed text center-screen (iPad only)
• Write a screenplay using scriptwriting mode
• Live word and character counts
• Set word and character count targets
• Find and replace
• Customizable keyboard row provides quick-access buttons for formatting, navigation and punctuation
• Comprehensive keyboard shortcuts for external keyboard users
• Dark mode
Find Your Structure
• Write in any order and reorganize later
• Write a synopsis for any text section and see it in the outline
• Expand, collapse and drill down into sections of your project
• Rearrange sections as index cards on the corkboard (iPad only)
• Project-wide search
• Track ideas using labels and status
• Apply custom icons to your sections
Refer to Research
• Import research material such as image, PDF and media files
• View research files or other sections right alongside your writing (iPad only)
• Every section has its own notes area for jotting down ideas
• Supports multitasking split screen mode (supported devices only)
Share Your Work
• Compile to a single document for sharing or printing
• Use different formatting in your exported or printed document
• Export to Word, RTF, Final Draft, PDF or plain text
• Convert rich text to Markdown for sharing with Markdown apps
• Create and email zipped backups of your projects
Work Anywhere
• Use Dropbox to sync between devices and with the macOS and Windows versions of Scrivener*
• Copy projects between devices via iTunes
* Requires a Dropbox account (not compatible with iCloud).
SUPPORT
You can contact us at ios.support@literatureandlatte.com, visit our forums at http://www.literatureandlatte.com/forum, or find us @scrivenerapp on Twitter.

bluejetty:00035808:ios.description:
Tripbook is a mileage tracker app built to save you time and ensure complete, accurate trip logs. Whether you're a freelancer, employee, or anyone who needs reliable mileage records for tax deductions or expense reporting, Tripbook makes vehicle tracking effortless and dependable.
Powered by industry-leading trip detection technology, Tripbook automatically recognizes when you're driving and logs your journey, no manual input required. This ensures accurate, complete records without the hassle of traditional mileage tracking.
Why Tripbook?
◉ SAVE TIME - Automatically track trips, no manual logging needed.
◉ COMPLETE RECORD - Never miss a journey thanks to accurate, automatic logging.
◉ INSTANT TAX REPORTING - Generate ready-to-use mileage reports in seconds.
◉ DATA STAYS WITH YOU - Your mileage logs are backed up to your personal iCloud, not shared or stored elsewhere. 
◉ CONSISTENTLY ACCURATE - You get dependable, precise mileage tracking. Every trip, every time.
Key Features
◉ AUTOMATIC TRIP DETECTION - Trips are logged automatically as soon as you start driving, no manual input required.
◉ CLASSIFY TRIPS - Easily tag each trip as business, personal, or commuting with a simple swipe.
◉ FOREVER FREE PLAN - Always free. Track up to 20 trips per month, no trial, no expiration.
◉ DETAILED REPORTS - Export your trip data as XLS, CSV, or PDF files, perfect for taxes, reimbursements, or business records.
◉ ICLOUD BACK-UP - Your data stays yours, Tripbook never stores or accesses your trip information.
◉ CUSTOM ALLOWANCES - Set your own mileage rates for business and commuting trips.
◉ VEHICLE & ODOMETER TRACKING - Add your vehicles and log odometer readings to include accurate mileage data in your reports.
Download Tripbook today for accurate and effortless trip tracking. For support or feedback, contact us at info@tripbook.io.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://tripbook.io/app-privacy-policy/

bluejetty:00022055:ios.description:
▷iLocation+ is a tool to search and share location easily and quickly.
With iLocation+, you can tell the current location or the specified location by several screen clicks. And if you want to know the coordinates or address of the current location, you can simply run iLocation+.
When you want to explain an appointment, or when you need to know your current location in a hurry, you can also pin the map on top of the map and simply select the transport to share the location.
◉ Function
• Automatically display current location information when running App
• Coordinate and altitude display of current position or specified position
• Show the location's address
• Show compass bearing
• Change the map format (General, Satellite)
• Specify the center of the map and check the coordinates and addresses
• Specify coordinates by entering coordinates
• Specify an arbitrary location by entering an address (Pro)
• Save map to camera roll or clipboard
• Save your location to Favorites for reuse
• Save the specified location information and map or share it via SNS
• The location is sent to the URL so that the recipient can connect to the map immediately
If you have iLocation+, you will be able to explain your location without having to talk.
◉ Notice
• Depending on the user's location and environment, GPS signal reception may not be smooth or there may be differences in accuracy.
• This app cannot change your device's system GPS information.

bluejetty:00007563:android.summary:
FANTASTIC HIDDEN OBJECT PUZZLE ADVENTURE GAME FROM THE CREATORS OF ENIGMATIS AND GRIM LEGENDS!
Defeat the scary sorcerer and save the royal heir in a beautiful and captivating story inspired by one of the Grimms’ fairy tales. Queen's Quest
bluejetty:00007563:android.description:
FANTASTIC HIDDEN OBJECT PUZZLE ADVENTURE GAME FROM THE CREATORS OF ENIGMATIS AND GRIM LEGENDS!
Defeat the scary sorcerer and save the royal heir in a beautiful and captivating story inspired by one of the Grimms’ fairy tales. Queen's Quest: Tower of Darkness is an exciting adventure game that takes place in a faraway realm full of magic and wonders.
Explore 30 hand painted vistas to save the princess! 
The idyllic life of the beautiful queen and her husband is shattered when a scary sorcerer arrives at their palace to kidnap their newborn daughter.
Solve 39 puzzles and HO scenes! 
The godfather Magnus saves our heroine with his magic, but Prince Henrik is turned to stone, allowing the intruder to escape with the royal heiress. Detective skills are called upon to solve the mystery.
Immersive hand drawn locations and mini games! 
To save her family, our beautiful heroine will have to prove her mettle and act like a true queen. She will have to embark on a long adventure through beautiful hand painted locations, solve numerous puzzles, deal with plenty of hidden objects, and discover the truth about the scary curse that has befallen her family. Can she break the spell cast on her husband and retrieve her daughter?
Save Prince Henrik in the Collector’s Edition! 
Save your spouse in a bonus chapter with more additional content, hidden objects, and puzzles as well as a captivating soundtrack and hand painted concept art.
Play with your family! 
A simple but beautiful game that’s easy to enjoy with your kids!
Take the adventure on the bus! 
Optimized for phones and tablets, filled with hidden objects, perfect for playing while traveling. No internet connection required, so you can play offline!
Sign up to our newsletter and get adventure games on sale! 
Captivating adventures, beautiful stories, and scary mysteries await in our selection of immersive hidden object puzzle games!
• Find your way through 30 vivid locations to save the princess!
• Test your intellect in 39 riddles and unique HO scenes!
• Become a master by unlocking 22 achievements!
• Save Prince Henrik in an additional adventure!

bluejetty:00131232:ios.description:
A NEWEST number puzzle game - Ten Crush is coming!
Ten Crush is a challenging number puzzle game, our team design lots of special levels for it. Playing this game will let you relax especially after a work day, solving a puzzle everyday will train your logic and maths skills.
We design lots of special levels in it, you should complete different targets while match numbers, such as catch a bat 10 times or collect 5 stars. There are so many funny designs waiting for you to discover and you won‘t stop playing this super addictive and relaxing puzzle game.

bluejetty:00069035:ios.name: Soundcraft ViSi Remote
bluejetty:00069035:ios.summary: Soundcraft ViSi Remote 3.6.2 is an iOS application that allows remote control of Soundcraft Vi, Si Compact, Si Performer, Si Expression and Si Impact mixing consoles wirelessly from an iPad device using no additional hardware other than a w
bluejetty:00069035:ios.description:
Soundcraft ViSi Remote 3.6.2 is an iOS application that allows remote control of Soundcraft Vi, Si Compact, Si Performer, Si Expression and Si Impact mixing consoles wirelessly from an iPad device using no additional hardware other than a wireless router connected to the Harman HiQnet® Ethernet port of the console.
With ViSi Remote you are free to roam the venue and adjust mixes and other audio parameters directly from the iPad.
Applications:
• Optimise the front of house mix from anywhere in the room
• Set mic gains and 48V from the stage
• Adjust monitor levels while standing next to the artist
• Adjust channel strip settings remotely from the console
• Use to extend the fader count of an existing control surface
• Use in standalone (demo) mode for familiarisation with console functions
• Control a network of consoles, e.g., FOH and Monitor
• Provide a separate surface for DMX functionality (Si Performer only)
• Allow multiple users on the same console to control their own mixes
• Have a global metering overview or “meter bridge” as an extension of the console
ViSi Remote 3.6.2 Console Minimum Software Requirements:
(Latest software is available on the Soundcraft website)
Si Impact: V1.0 build 0010 or higher
Si Performer: V1.6 build or higher
Si Expression: V1.6 build or higher
Si Compact: V3.0 build or higher
Vi1/2/4/6: V4.9 or higher
Vi200: V6.4 or higher
Vi400/600: V6.3 or higher
Vi1000: V6.3 or higher
Vi2000: V6.3 or higher
Vi3000: V6.3 or higher
Vi5000/7000: V6.3 or higher
Note: For Vi & Si consoles, the latest software listed above is needed in order to access the full channel processing and metering functions. Older software versions would result in basic functionality with fader, mute, mix, and GEQ settings only.
Mute group functionality is only supported on Si V2.2 build1 or higher and on Vi V6.4.5.340 or higher.
ViSi Remote 3.6.2 iOS Compatibility:
iOS 12.0 or higher.
Functions controlled:
• Channel naming
• Input faders and mutes
• Bus, Master LR & Mono (C) and VCA master faders and mutes
• Channel strip settings, including:
 - Mic Gain, Digital Trim, and 48V
 - Phase Invert
 - HPF & LPF (HPF only on Si consoles)
 - Delay
 - Channel EQ with grabbable parametric EQ curve
 - Gate and Compression settings
 - Pan
 - LR and Mono (C) bus routing
• Graphic EQs on all bus outs
• Channel contributions to each Aux Mix
• Channel contributions to each FX bus (Si consoles only)
• Mix contributions to each matrix bus
• DMX Masters (Si Performer Only)
• Mute Group Masters (Requires Si software 2.2.1 or later and Vi V6.4.5.340 or higher; not supported on Si Compact; Vi1, Vi2, Vi4 or Vi6).

Featured by Apple in "Apps We Love" for six consecutive years and selected by the App Store's Editors as an Essential Finance App, the Canadian Mortgage App has been used over 90 million times and ranks as Canada's #1 mortgage app.
The Financial Post calls it "the app everyone loves to talk about when it comes to mortgages," and CBC, Yahoo Finance, OREA, La Presse, CMT, MBN, Toronto Star, Metro, and many other news outlets have given it extensive media coverage.
Easily calculate your total home ownership cost, get pre-qualified, do the stress test, compare rates by national and regional lenders and brokers, find out if a refinance is worth the penalty, calculate land transfer taxes and determine your affordability to the penny
Here is a summary of some of the features:
• Canadian Payment Calculator
• All Possible Payment Frequencies
• Award-winning Pre-Qualification tool
• Powerful Refinance Analyzer
• Stress Test Rules
• Minimum Down Payment Calculator
• Total Monthly Ownership Calculator
• Closing Cost Calculator
• Affordability Calculator
• Maximum Loan Calculator
• Extra Payments Calculator
• Advanced GDS / TDS Calculator
• CMHC Premium Calculator
• PST on CMHC
• Amortization Schedule and Totals
• Load and Save Multiple Scenarios
• Scenario Comparison (side by side)
• All Provincial & Municipal Land Transfer Fees
• ON / TO First-time buyer rebates
• ON Non-Resident Speculation Tax
• BCs First-timer and newly built rebates
• BCs Foreign Buyer Tax
• PEIs First-time buyer rebates
• Real-time Mortgage Rates
• Ability to apply with an expert
• Find an Expert
• Import / Export Calculations
• Generate Summary PDFs
• Beautiful graphs and illustrations
• English, French, Spanish, Chinese and Hindi
• Direct Technical Support Chat
• Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
• Support for Webhooks
• Realtors and Mortgage Professionals can now brand CMA to offer clients a unique mobile experience
The calculations have also been rigorously tested both mathematically and physically against almost all available mortgage calculators we could find. It's super accurate. It calculates at an extended number of decimal places, avoids floating-point errors and uses specialized rounding as suggested by the European Commission on rounding currency amounts and IEEE 754.
The Canadian Mortgage app is free to use and download.
ABOUT CMA PRO
We offer Real estate and Mortgage Professionals a premium subscription to PRO.
CMA PRO offers industry professionals the ability to personalize the Canadian Mortgage App and share their branded app with clients, prospects and partners.
The PRO mobile app can be customized with your company logo, profile picture, brand colours, contact information, rates and much more. PRO offers premium analytics and the ability to invite and co-brand with referral partners to increase your business.
CMA PRO starts at $23.99/month CAD and up to $249.99 / 3 months, depending on your subscription type
Payment will be charged to your iTunes account
Your PRO subscription automatically renews monthly or quarterly for the price of the initial package you have selected. Subscription is automatically renewed unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Auto-renewal can be turned off by going to your App Store Account Settings after purchase. Prices are in Canadian dollars, may vary in countries other than Canada, and are subject to change without notice. Terms of use and privacy policy are available here: https://canadianmortgageapp.com/terms
If you don't choose to get CMA PRO, you can continue using the Canadian Mortgage App for free forever.
We know you will love it.
Enjoy!
------------------------------
Thank you for using CMA. If you are an industry professional and have questions or would like to learn how to leverage CMA PRO for your business, please contact us via the support chat in the app, located under the "Settings" tab.
• The Bendigi Team •

PVP battles let you duel other players in strategic head-to-head card battles. Enter epic card wars with Bob, Linda, Tina, Louise or Gene and fight Peter or Stewie Griffin! Battle, build and upgrade your deck for a cartoon card clash.
Build a deck and join a guild with your friends, share tips and tricks through chat. Can you rise to the top?
Card battles may be digital, but the stakes are real!* The fate of the world rests in your hands!**

Collectible Card Game
Collect cards of your favorite characters from each and every show
Collect and fuse to design an epic deck
Build card combos and find powerful new cards in Mom’s Mystery Box for special surprises and skins.
Card Battles
Battle to conquer 30+ islands of story levels to win cards – can you unlock Onyx Mode?
Duel other players to level up in the Arena and unlock Secret Fight Club.
Card battle challenges and Guild wars are available every week for big rewards.
Play for infinite hours, provided that you never stop playing!
Cartoon characters from your favorite shows:
Family Guy’s Peter Griffin arrives alongside, Stewie, Lois, Meg, & Chris!
Futurama’s Bender approaches with Fry, Leela, & Zoidberg!
American Dad’s Stan Smith goes in for the attack with Francine, Klaus & Hayley!
King of the Hill’s Hank Hill puts the “pain” in “propane” with Peggy, Dale, Jeff, & Bobby!
Bob's Burgers’ Tina Belcher cooks the competition, joined by Bob Belcher, and Teddy!
Your favorite Cartoon characters will make you laugh ‘til you drop your phone (or tablet) in the toilet!
FX's Archer needs you on his very own spy missions!
Download Animation Throwdown and join the card battling adventure today!
Please Note:
A network connection is required to play. Login or sign up for a Kongregate account to save progress across devices! 
Rated 18+ by the Indonesia Game Rating System (IGRS).
Animation Throwdown CCG is free to play, but some extra game items can be purchased for real money. You can disable in-app purchases in your device's settings.

bluejetty:00143253:ios.description:
The Qscan Patient Results app offers you the convenience of accessing and managing your medical imaging and reports right from your smartphone or tablet. With this user-friendly app, you can easily view and share your reports and images in one centralised location.
The app is ideal if:
 - You suffer from a long-term medical condition and need your imaging history.
 - You are pregnant and would like to share your precious baby scans with family or friends.
 - You would like to share scans with other health professionals such as a physiotherapist or chiropractor.
 - You travel and need to access your scans anywhere, anytime.
You can download the patient app from the App Store or by visiting patient.qscan.com.au. If you encounter any difficulties accessing your results through the app, please visit qscan.zed.link for assistance.
For more detailed information about Qscan and its services, please visit our website qscan.com.au/patientaccess
Please remember to always consult with your healthcare professional for a proper medical evaluation and interpretation of your results.

bluejetty:00167668:ios.description:
VietDi - Cảnh Báo & Phạt Nguội giúp tài xế nhận cảnh báo phía trước trong lúc di chuyển và tra cứu lỗi vi phạm, thông tin đăng kiểm phương tiện một cách đơn giản. Nguồn dữ liệu được lấy trực tiếp từ trang web của Cảnh Sát Giao Thông (https://www.csgt.vn/tra-cuu-phat-nguoi) và Cổng thông tin điện tử Cục Đăng kiểm (https://gcndangkiem.vr.org.vn), nơi dữ liệu được cập nhật đầy đủ và liên tục.
Chức năng chính:
- Cảnh báo tốc độ và biển báo phía trước (Có chế độ PIP để hoạt động song song với các ứng dụng bản đồ)
- Tra cứu phạt nguội
- Tiện ích (Widget) theo dõi xe ngay màn hình chính mà không cần mở ứng dụng
- Kiểm tra thông tin đăng kiểm phương tiện
- Tra cứu giấy xác nhận gia hạn đăng kiểm
- Tra cứu vi phạm theo biển kiểm soát
- Nhận thông báo tự động khi có phạt nguội, hết hạn đăng kiểm, hết hạn nộp phí đường bộ
- Cảnh báo sự cố giao thông
- Lưu lịch sử tra cứu
- Xem hình ảnh đường phố Sài Gòn (Nguồn dữ liệu được lấy trực tiếp từ trang web Sở Giao Thông Vận Tải TP. HCM - http://giaothong.hochiminhcity.gov.vn/map.aspx) và các tỉnh khác
- Chế độ xem 10 camera cùng lúc
- Tổng hợp trung tâm đăng kiểm
- Quản lý biển kiểm soát
- Chế độ sáng/tối
- Tra cứu mức phạt
---------
Lưu ý: Ứng dụng này HOÀN TOÀN KHÔNG đại diện cho chính phủ hay bất kỳ tổ chức nào.
---------
Tuyên bố từ chối trách nhiệm: 
Ứng dụng này chỉ cập nhật nội dung từ các nguồn bên dưới với mục đích cung cấp thông tin tra cứu tiện lợi và nhanh chóng. Việc sử dụng ứng dụng này đồng nghĩa với việc bạn đã đọc và hiểu rõ những điều khoản và điều kiện trong Tuyên Bố này và đồng ý tuân theo chúng.
* http://giaothong.hochiminhcity.gov.vn (Mọi dữ liệu trên trang này do Sở Giao Thông Vận Tải TP. Hồ Chí Minh - Bộ Giao Thông Vận Tải quản lý và phát hành)
* https://www.csgt.vn/tra-cuu-phat-nguoi (Mọi dữ liệu trên trang này do Cục Cảnh sát giao thông - Bộ Công An quản lý và phát hành)
* https://gcndangkiem.vr.org.vn (Mọi dữ liệu trên trang này do Cục Đăng Kiểm Giao Thông - Bộ Xây Dựng quản lý và phát hành)
* https://dichvucong.gov.vn (Mọi dữ liệu trên trang này do Cục Đăng Kiểm Giao Thông - Bộ Công An quản lý và phát hành)

– lifehacker
bluejetty:00127574:ios.description:
UniChar is a powerful yet beautiful Unicode character app and keyboard that allows you to quickly find, type, and work with special symbols.
◣
"This iOS keyboard app will give you all the Unicode characters you’ll ever need." 
– lifehacker
“UniChar is a cool little app and keyboard, and offers access to a huge world of Unicode characters that are otherwise absent within the standard iOS keyboard.” 
– iDownloadBlog
"On the Mac, you can type any character [with] the Emoji & Symbols viewer ... The selection on iOS is much more limited ... But UniChar changes that."
– Cult of Mac
“It’s a full-featured utility for searching and copying symbols … it’s always nice to see a developer who’s dedicated to improving this kind of utility over time and adopting new features … it's a very handy app.”
– AppStories
◤
Utilize hundreds of thousands of characters organized neatly into categories and a full Unicode table. You can quickly search for the character you’re looking for, type special symbols in any app with the custom keyboard, and collect your favorite characters to access them even quicker.
For developers, UniChar is an efficient tool to work with Unicode code points and UTF-8 encodings. Revamp your workflow by using UniChar alongside other apps on iPad, or use Universal Clipboard to copy on your iPhone and paste on your Mac.
App
◉ Work with characters and their info – Name, Unicode, and UTF-8
◉ Browse curated categories in grid or list view
◉ Customize your categories – choose from more than 150 symbol and script categories*
◉ Access the entire Unicode table by character blocks*
◉ Go to a specific block, category, or code point
◉ Search for symbols by name, info, or even by drawing**
◉ Identify characters and see a breakdown of code points that form them
◉ Ask Siri questions about a Unicode character
◉ Select custom fonts to use when rendering glyphs
◉ Collect and organize your favorite symbols
◉ Quickly copy character info to the clipboard
◉ Insert characters into the text field and compose text using the system keyboard
◉ Share your text via Messages, Mail, Mastodon, etc – or open it in other apps like Pages
Keyboard
◎ Type special symbols in any app
◎ Quickly input your favorite and recently used characters
◎ Browse curated categories – choose from more than 150 categories*
◎ Designed to compliment the Emoji keyboard
Widgets
■ Add your favorite symbol to your Lock Screen
■ View stats for how many drawings you've submitted to help improve Search by Drawing
Apple Watch
◆ Add your favorite symbol to your watch face
◆ Quickly access your favorite and recently used characters
◆ Copy character info to your iPhone’s clipboard
And More
● Beautiful Liquid Glass design
● Light and dark mode
● Full accessibility support
● Handoff
● Drag and Drop
● Keyboard shortcuts and menu bar on iPad
● Universal app for iPhone, iPad, and Apple silicon Mac
● No ads, no tracking, no subscriptions
* All Categories can be unlocked via a one-time in-app purchase.
** Search by Drawing is powered by an on-device machine learning model that predicts matching symbols as you draw in real-time. You can help improve symbol recognition by submitting your own drawings!

bluejetty:00091710:ios.name: busybusy GPS Time Clock Mobile
bluejetty:00091710:ios.summary: busybusy is a cloud-based time tracking and job costing app designed for construction and field employees. Collect real-time data and generate powerful automated reports–enabling smarter decisions, saving valuable office time, and simplifyi
bluejetty:00091710:ios.description:
busybusy is a cloud-based time tracking and job costing app designed for construction and field employees. Collect real-time data and generate powerful automated reports–enabling smarter decisions, saving valuable office time, and simplifying labor, project, and schedule management.
Field employees can easily track labor, materials, and heavy equipment all within an easy-to-use mobile app. Jobsite data is organized by project and is instantly available to your team, allowing you to see what’s going on anytime, anywhere.
Features:
Time Tracking 
-Clock in/out, offline mode
-Kiosk mode digital punch clock
-Supervisor tools allow supervisors to clock in/out crews, edit time, assign cost codes and projects, and split time entries
-GPS map showing employees on the clock, equipment, & projects
-GPS-based notifications to remind employees to clock in/out on the jobsite
Equipment
-View employees using each piece of equipment
-Easy access to a detailed equipment list
-Performance report (operator vs machine)
-View equipment location on map
Job Costing
-Assign time to projects, sub-projects, cost codes, and equipment- easily switch throughout the day
-Projected labor budgets vs actual labor costs
-Employee labor burden broke down by projects
-Activity reports
-Easily add missing job costs and cost codes with the job costing tool
-Quickly export to CSV
Liability Protection
-Jobsite photos are time, location, and employee stamped, easily searched, and grouped by project.
-Overtime & break reports
-Employee and supervisor digital signatures
-End-of-day injury/non-injury verification
-Kiosk photo verification
Products:
-Progress Tracking
-Accurate material and quantity reporting
-View crew progress in real-time and see work accomplished
-Easily submit photos showing job site progress
-Get detailed progress reports 
Daily Reports
-Auto-generate weather reporting, job costing, and injury reports
-Detailed summary of project progress and equipment insights
-Automate job site checklists with start and end times
-Safety sign-offs
Documents
-Easily upload files, including job site plans, permits, building codes, and more
-Attach documents and descriptions to a specific project
-Upload fillable forms and documents in Offline mode, no matter the location
Scheduling
-Schedule one employee or the whole crew
-Assign project, cost code, or equipment from a schedule
-Automatically notify employees of changes
-Submit and manage time off requests
BusyPayroll
-Instantly run payroll and pay employees
-Reduce payroll time by 67%
-Automatically scan for signatures, time-off requests, time-entry conflicts, and more
-Set lock dates to prevent editing
Integrations
busybusy seamlessly integrates with Procore, QuickBooks, CompanyCam, Zapier, Foundation, Sage, and many more…
Hear what our customers have to say:
“We tried three other time tracking apps before switching to busybusy. Switching to busybusy is the single best thing we have done for our employees in years. I can't think of the last time they were all this happy.” Austin - Certified Fire and Security
“It can be used anywhere. We have construction crews in the field and it's great that they can use it wherever they are and we can have real-time data without having to wait for the end of the week for paper timecards. It takes a lot of the burden off of our foremen and frees them up for more important work. Plus, their customer service is outstanding!” Melinda - Klingelhofer Management
Get support from our easy-going, friendly customer support team who offers online and in-app chat, telephone, and email support 24/7. Se habla Espanol.
*We respect your privacy. Your data is never shared, sold, or used for any marketing purposes.
**Please note that GPS is used to obtain accurate clock in/out locations. In order to provide accurate locations, GPS operates for a short duration in the background after pressing clock in/out.

How will your mobile device perform when push comes to crunch? How will it compare to the newest devices on the market? Find out today with Geekbench 6.
Test the performance of your Android smartphone or tablet and compare your results with Geekbench – a leader in CPU and GPU benchmarking.
Test Your Devices
Quickly test how fast your tablets and phones are with Geekbench's trusted CPU and GPU benchmark tests.
Compare Your Results
Geekbench shows benchmark results in an easily-understood set of numbers. Your scores are automatically uploaded to Geekbench Browser where you can share & compare your scores against the newest devices on the market. 
New and Updated Real-World Tests
Geekbench tests reflect how people use their devices. Instead of just crunching digits of pi for an hour or doing 80 different versions of the same task, Geekbench's tests measure tasks like how quickly a device can load an example website, render a PDF, add filters to photos, and process HDR. These tests are precisely crafted to ensure that results represent real-world use cases and workloads. 
In Geekbench 6, we've added several new tests, including:
* Blurring backgrounds in video conferencing
* Removing background objects from images
* Processing text within a development workflow.
CPU Benchmark
Test your processor's single-core and multi-core power for everything from browsing the web to editing photos to playing games, or all of it at once. In Geekbench 6, new tests measure performance in popular application areas, including Artificial Intelligence, Augmented Reality, and Machine Learning, so you'll know how close your device is to the cutting edge. 
GPU Compute Benchmark
Test your system's potential for gaming, image processing, or video editing with the GPU Compute Benchmark. Test your GPU's power with support for the OpenCL, Metal, and Vulkan APIs. New to Geekbench 6 is support for Machine Learning and more uniform GPU performance across platforms.
Cross-Platform
Compare apples and oranges. Or Apples and Samsungs. Designed from the ground-up for cross-platform comparisons, Geekbench allows you to compare system performance across devices, operating systems, and processor architectures. Geekbench supports Android, iOS, macOS, Windows, and Linux.

bluejetty:00116129:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00116129:ios.description:
► WE’RE GOING ON AN ADVENTURE!
Join your animal friend in sticker world! Here you’ll be merging items to create stickers, which you can then use to fill in the coloring page and see what your furry four-legged friend has gotten up to this time! With tons of fun themes like travel, fantasy, and more, children and adults will get a real kick out of finding and merging all the items as well as seeing the final image come to life.
► MERGE AND STICK
Each level starts with a variety of items falling down the screen – you’ll need to identify the identical ones and merge them before putting them through the sticker maker. Once you’ve collected all the stickers, head over to the puzzle page where you can place your final stickers and, like a color by number, watch the colors appear! With chill vibes and no rush, you can take your time merging all of the stickers, making this a great game for relaxing.
Fantastic features:
• Adorable graphics – In addition to the main capybara, have fun meeting other characters and creatures as you travel around their sticker world. Lots of bright, bold colors and fun images await, so kick back and let loose as you travel the world or enjoy an ice cream cone – only once you’ve completed the final puzzle page will you see what all is happening!
• Relaxed gameplay – This color by number sticker game is great for kids or adults who want some quiet time thanks to the easy mechanics and fun pictures. On top of that, there’s no timer meaning no panic to finish each level as fast as possible – take your time and enjoy the ASMR sound effects as you merge and color.
• More and more levels – Just when you think the critters have run out of adventures, here come more exciting and fun levels! We’re always adding new levels to the game to keep things exciting, so keep your sticker maker handy and keep your eyes peeled for colorful new puzzle levels to appear.
► JOIN THE FUN
Part sticker book, part color by number, all fun – Capybara Puzzle is the fun and relaxing sticker game you’ve been waiting for! Join the capybara and see what fun adventures they get up to as you carefully collect and merge items to create beautiful stickers. With said stickers in hand, head over to the coloring page where you can place each of them and bring the piece to life thanks to the 3D sticker book mechanic. Don’t forget to visit old pieces in your gallery and remember the fun adventures you had together! 
Both young and old will enjoy puzzling through the items to find the identical ones to merge, so come try it out today and have a blast!

bluejetty:00100240:ios.description:
Join "Christmas Fables: Nutcracker’s Tale", a mesmerizing christmas hidden objects journey where dreams and courage collide! On Christmas Eve, Alex’s wish for a friend brings his Nutcracker to life as Prince Henry. Together, they battle the sinister Wormtooth and his steel-clawed army in a breathtaking christmas adventure filled with magic, friendship, and wonder. Immerse yourself in enchanting christmas stories, festive puzzles, and glittering realms in one of the most heartwarming christmas games!
On Christmas Eve, young Alex places his beloved Nutcracker beneath the tree, along with a heartfelt letter to Santa. His only wish: a true friend. But when the clock strikes midnight, the world shifts - Alex is swept into a snow-covered realm where toys breathe, kingdoms sparkle, and battles rage. Here, his Nutcracker awakens as Prince Henry, locked in a desperate struggle against the sinister Wormtooth, commander of an army of steel-clawed rats. By aiding Henry in battle, Alex uncovers a terrible truth: Wormtooth hungers not only for the Dolly World, but also for the real world beyond. To stop him, Queen Marie sends Alex and Henry on a perilous journey to the Sugar Plum Fairy’s castle, where the secret to bridging worlds lies hidden. Soaring on enchanted sleighs, battling swarms of clockwork vermin, and piecing together the shattered Christmas Star - the heroes must summon every ounce of courage to restore magic before Wormtooth’s darkness spills into Alex’s home. But when the portal finally opens, and Henry steps into the real world as a human for the very first time, danger follows: a mechanical rat, its eyes gleaming with malice, slips through the snow after them…
· A Magical Christmas Adventure!
Embark on a dazzling christmas adventure through snow-covered lands, sparkling castles, and magical skies. Uncover hidden clues, solve festive puzzles, and experience the spirit of xmas in a world where courage, magic, and friendship light the way!
· Battle the Forces of Darkness!
Join Alex and Prince Henry in their quest to stop the evil Wormtooth! Face enchanted toys, mechanical rats, and epic battles that redefine christmas stories. Each discovery brings you closer to saving both worlds in this spellbinding tale of bravery and heart.
· Enchanting Hidden Object Challenges!
Explore beautifully crafted christmas hidden objects scenes brimming with detail and mystery. From twinkling toy shops to icy palaces, each location hides secrets waiting to be revealed in this unforgettable hidden object games experience.
· The True Spirit of Christmas!
Restore the shattered Christmas Star, unlock achievements, and protect both worlds from darkness. With every challenge you conquer, feel the warmth and wonder of christmas games as Alex and Henry uncover the true meaning of courage, hope, and friendship.
Join the adventure and let your heart be filled with Christmas magic — where every hidden object tells a story, and every wish can change the world.

bluejetty:00071323:ios.name: Nonogram.com Color: Logic Game
bluejetty:00071323:ios.summary: Discover the mystery of Nonogram.com Color! With its enhanced gameplay, it's easy to follow the game rules and become a Nonogram master. Explore Nonogram.com Color and discover a fresh take on this classic paper-and-pencil nonogram puzzle.
bluejetty:00071323:ios.description:
Discover the mystery of Nonogram.com Color! With its enhanced gameplay, it's easy to follow the game rules and become a Nonogram master. Explore Nonogram.com Color and discover a fresh take on this classic paper-and-pencil nonogram puzzle.
Start with the basic rules and logic behind the picture cross puzzle with a challenging multicolor style.
- Fill the squares with colors and reveal the hidden picture
- Numbers above the column are read from top to bottom
- Numbers to the left of the rows are read from left to right
- Follow the order of color groups and switch colors to mark appropriate squares
- Different color groups may be placed next to each other
- Groups of the same color should be separated by at least 1 empty square
- If you figure out that a square shouldn’t be colored, mark it with an X
- Use hints if you get stuck
- Get extra lives if you make a mistake
Nonogram.com Color is easy to learn and quite addictive once you start playing. Challenge yourself and enjoy hours of fun with logic number puzzles!

bluejetty:00068867:ios.summary: CST Exam Prep 2026 is an exam preparation app that will help you pass the Certified Surgical Technologist (CST) exam administered by the National Board of Surgical Technology and Surgical Assisting (NBSTSA) with a high score on your first a
bluejetty:00068867:ios.description:
CST Exam Prep 2026 is an exam preparation app that will help you pass the Certified Surgical Technologist (CST) exam administered by the National Board of Surgical Technology and Surgical Assisting (NBSTSA) with a high score on your first attempt.
CST Exam Prep 2026 will not only help you gain insight into concepts related to CST exam preparation, but also help you increase your confidence in passing the exam on the first attempt by practicing hundreds of exam-like questions.
### Passing the exam on the first attempt ###
In CST Exam Prep 2026, there are a large number of questions prepared by exam experts that cover the range of official exam requirements. According to the exam requirements, you must master several subjects in order to successfully pass the CST exam.
Specifically, these subjects include.
- Pre-operative Care (17%)
- Intra-operative Procedure (37%)
- Post-operative Procedure (6%)
- Administrative and Personnel Duties (6%)
- Equipment Maintenance and Sterilization (6%)
- Anatomy and Physiology (17%)
- Microbiology (6%)
- Surgical Pharmacology (6%)
To help you pass the exam, our exam experts have carefully analyzed and broken down the above subjects. You will need to practice all 8 subjects which will help you pass the exam with confidence!
### Key Features ###
- Over 1000 practice questions with detailed answer explanations for each question
- Specialized practice by content area, with the flexibility to switch between them at any time
- View analysis of your current performance in the "Statistics" section
The most important part of passing the CST exam is to keep practicing and not lose confidence in the exam. You will find that each time you practice on CST Exam Prep 2026, your knowledge of the exam increases, thus increasing your certainty of passing the exam.
Set aside a certain amount of time each day to practice some questions, while hinting to yourself that you will do the same tomorrow. After you develop good study habits, you will find it easier to pass and score high not only on the CST exam, but on any other exam!
### Purchase, Subscriptions and Terms ###
You will need to purchase at least one subscription to unlock access to all features, content areas, and questions. Once purchased, the cost will be deducted directly from your Apple account. Subscriptions will automatically renew and be charged based on the rate and term selected for the subscription plan. If you need to cancel your subscription, please do so no later than 24 hours before the end of the current term or your account will be automatically charged for renewal.
You can manage your subscription by turning off auto-renewal in your account settings in Apple after purchase. If a free trial period is offered, any unused portion will be forfeited at the time you purchase your subscription (if applicable).
Terms of Service - http://cst.yesmaster.pro/terms-of-service.html
Privacy Policy - http://cst.yesmaster.pro/privacy-policy.html
Any questions or comments you may have about your use, please let us know via email at contact@yesmaster.pro and we will resolve them for you within 3 business days at the latest.

bluejetty:00061619:ios.description:
The Rocketbook app instantly sends your Rocketbook pages and whiteboards enhanced with Beacons to your favorite cloud services. Access and share them anytime, anywhere!
The app has a unique seven-symbol shortcut system that gets your auto-cropped and high quality scans into the cloud faster than any other scanning app. Using our Handwriting Recognition (OCR) features, you can search your handwriting inside the app, use your handwritten text as the filename, and get a full-page transcription via email.
The Rocketbook app is designed to work with Rocketbook products including the:
- Core (endlessly reusable notebook)
- Mini (pocket sized version of the Core)
- Wave (microwave-to-erase notebook)
- Color (reusable kid's coloring book)
- Whiteboards enhanced with Rocketbook Beacons (adjustable whiteboard attachments)
- One (single use notebook)
Enjoy the pleasure of writing and the efficiency, organization, and shareability of digitization. Write freely and use our shortcut system to send your scans as PDFs or JPEGs to specific locations in Google Drive, Dropbox, Trello, Evernote, Box, OneDrive, OneNote, Slack, iMessage, iCloud, and Email.
For more information about our reusable notebooks, please visit getrocketbook.com. Free Rocketbook PDFs and customizable pages can be found at start.getrocketbook.com.

bluejetty:00131284:ios.description:
*Apple Editor’s Choice Award Winner*
Build muscle, gain strength and lose weight with a customized workout plan just for you. Fitbod is the ultimate fitness platform made to help enhance your strength training and endurance through personalized AI workouts. You won’t just get stronger—you’ll do it on your terms. Get optimized weight lifting routines with a workout planner made to help you reach your fitness goals. No gym? No problem. Fitbod adapts to you with home training with no equipment needed. Each training session is custom-built for your fitness level and equipment so you can make the most of every workout. Make lasting progress with Fitbod – your own AI trainer guiding you to your strongest self
Get everything from recovery and exercise tracking to AI-generated recommendations tailored to your fitness objectives. Need access to a trainer? Shoot a quick email and get all your strength training questions answered easily. Fitbod lets you save and build your own strength training & endurance routines based on your preferences. Change up sessions, choose your favorite exercises, and maximize gains with the help of our AI workouts.
Monitor your progress across multiple devices with integrations that make fitness tracking easy. Build customized workouts that integrate with Apple Health. Hit your next session with Strava, Fitbit, and Apple Watch integration. Fitbod does it all.
Explore over 1000 exercises and let Fitbod create a customized workout plan for you. With easy-to-follow instructions and hi-res video walkthroughs you can hit each exercise the right way. Cardio, mobility, or strength training and endurance – Fitbod was made for you.
Download today and discover a better way to achieve your fitness goals.
Fitbod Features
AI-Generated Workouts
◆ Customized workout plan built around you and your fitness goals
◆ AI workouts maximize fitness gains by varying and balancing exercises
◆ Adaptive AI learns from your edits to its workout recommendations
◆ Non-linear periodization to optimize your workouts for sustained progress
◆ Fitness for everyone with advanced, intermediate, and beginner levels
◆ Wide variety of workout modifiers to change up single sessions
◆ Ability to save, build, or use your favorite strength training workouts
◆ Pro fitness trainers available via email for all strength training questions
1000+ Exercises

◆ Search exercises by muscle group, equipment type or keyword
◆ Cardio, mobility, pregnancy-safe exercises and more are available
◆ Consistent updates made to optimize the exercise library
Integrations
◆ Integrated with Apple Health to build customized workouts
◆ Integrated with Strava and Fitbit
◆ Available for iOS and Apple Watch

bluejetty:00095379:ios.description:
BugBiteCheck – Snap. Identify. Soothe.
BugBiteCheck is your smart, AI-powered tool for identifying common insect bites quickly and confidently. Whether you're dealing with a mystery welt or just curious about what bit you, BugBiteCheck uses image-based analysis to suggest likely culprits and offer helpful next steps — all in seconds. Identify bug bites with pictures!
Key Features
Instant Bite Identification
Snap a photo or upload an image of a bite. BugBiteCheck analyzes the shape, color, and skin response to suggest possible insect sources — complete with confidence score and visual match.
Confidence Scores & Clarity Feedback
See how confident the AI is in its identification. If the image isn’t clear, BugBiteCheck will let you know — or give you a best-guess result to keep things moving.
Personalized Tips & Prevention Advice
Every result includes bite characteristics, likely symptoms, and general advice on what to do next — including when to seek medical attention or avoid scratching.
Bite History & Tracking
Save bite scans to monitor how they evolve over time. Great for showing your doctor, tracking reactions, or keeping peace of mind when travelling.
Clean, Camera-First Design
BugBiteCheck features a calming, intuitive interface with a strong focus on imagery. It's designed for speed, clarity, and accessibility when you need answers fast.
Go Pro for Full Access
Upgrade to Pro for unlimited identifications, ad-free use, advanced suggestions, and full bite history tracking.
Accuracy and Use Disclaimer
BugBiteCheck provides AI-generated suggestions based on image analysis. It is for informational and educational purposes only and is not a diagnostic or medical tool. Always consult a healthcare professional for medical concerns, allergic reactions, or unusual symptoms.
Why Choose BugBiteCheck?
Fast, photo-based bite ID
Confidence scores and clarity feedback
Useful bite care tips and symptom hints
Private, on-device results log
Safe, simple, and designed for peace of mind

Create super realistic slime and play with it on your mobile device. Relax your mind and discover our unique ASMR experience. Stretch your slime, squish it, knead it, pop it - just like you would with real slime or putty. Enjoy that oddly satisfying feeling right from your phone or tablet.
With a huge selection of slimes types, decorations and colors to create with, this app is for slime beginners and pro slime experts, young and old, boys and girls. You can even share the experience by sending slime gifts for your friends to enjoy on their own devices.
App features:
- Play with your simulated slime right on your phone.
- Realistic slime simulation: Stretch it, squish it, knead it, pop it - just like real slime!
- Relieve stress and discover our one of a kind ASMR experience.
- DIY. Create your very own slime. Choose from a huge collection of materials, colors and add-ins: add glitter, jelly cubes and tens of other amazing decorations.
- Rich slime gallery: Clear, milky, metallic, jiggly and many more.
- Each slime boasts a unique texture, sound and behavior.
- Fun area: Play Lu-lu's Slime Quest, guessing games, turn your photos into slime (greenscreen effect) & experience slime painting.
- Send slime gifts to your friends. Hit the gift button and send gifts that your friends can load into their devices and play with!
- Satisfying 3D Sounds: Turn up the volume and listen to your slime squishing as you touch it. For best experience, use a headphones set.
- Shake it till you make it: Shake your phone to undo stretches.
- Share your creations! Hit the share button and send images of your slimes to your friends.
FOLLOW US at
Instagram @superslimesimulator

Mivio AI is an innovative app that lets you transform your photos into amazing works of art using AI technology. Whether you want to create a realistic portrait, a cartoon avatar, or a unique collage, Mivio AI offers a wide range of options to realize your ideas.
Key Features:
AI Photo Generator
Create realistic images using advanced AI algorithms. Just upload a photo and our AI will make it even better.
1000+ Styles
Experiment with different artistic styles, from classic to futuristic. Each style is unique and suitable for any project.
Transform Photos into Labuba
Transform your photos into adorable cartoon characters with the Labuba feature. It’s perfect for creating fun avatars or creative projects.
Create Shared Portraits
Merge multiple photos or videos into one shared portrait. It’s a great way to capture moments with friends or family.
From text to image
Describe your idea in words, and our AI will create an image that matches your description. From simple ideas to complex scenes, everything is possible!
Why choose Mivio AI?
Ease of use: The intuitive interface makes the app accessible to everyone.
Professional quality: Our technology delivers high-quality results suitable for both personal and professional use.
Unlimited creativity: With over 1,000 unique styles and options, you can bring any idea to life.

bluejetty:00184624:ios.description:
---------- The next major release of Toy Collector is here!! ---------- 
1) Runs side-by-side with Toy Collector 2. Try out 3.0, provide feedback, and watch it flourish while maintaining your collection in 2.x 
2) Export from 2.x to 3.0 to bring all your data over at once
3) Participate in design and feature ideas. Code has been completely rewritten in Swift.
---------- Special Thanks to ---------- 
Allan Joseph Martinez, Graphic Designer, www.SPOONRDESIGN.com
Allan designed the awesome new app icon!
---------- Version 3.0 brings the following changes ---------- 
1) Streamlined interface. One window to rule them all. All information (and all options) are now contained within a single page.
2) View multiple images at once (up to 4 per item)
3) Swipe to mark at item owned or wanted from the table view
4) Add shortcuts to subsections of lines
5) Searching is now almost instantaneous
6) Sync your data across multiple devices using iCloud
7) Remove ads (for free!) by participating in the collector community
8) Quickly filter between just lines you collect and all lines available in the application from the Options menu
9) Quickly filter between all, owned, wanted and more from the Options menu
10) Run updates and corrections in just one step
---------- To-Do (Bug) List ---------- 
Please notify developer of any bugs discovered and this to-do list will be updated accordingly
---------- Under Construction ---------- 
This app is, and remains, a hobby project supported by collectors around the world. It isn't, and probably never will be, "done" - If you have some suggestions or concerns, your feedback is greatly appreciated. 3.0 is a major change to the user interface, and there is plenty of room for improvement. You can find me on Twitter (@toycollectorapp) or on email (toycollectorapp@gmail.com) if you have concerns, complaints, or suggestions

Perfect for Christmas cards, holiday cards, invitations, return address labels, parcels, business mailings and everyday post. Label Printer supports popular Avery®, Herma and Unistat label sheet sizes.

Select people directly from your iPhone or iPad Contacts and quickly turn their addresses into ready-to-print labels. Edit individual labels where needed and create a whole mailing list in minutes.
PERFECT FOR CHRISTMAS CARDS
Save time addressing Christmas and holiday cards. Choose the people you want from Contacts, create your address labels and print an entire sheet at once.
WORKS WITH POPULAR LABEL SHEETS
Choose from a wide range of common Avery®, Herma and Unistat label formats.
USE EVERY LABEL ON THE SHEET

MORE THAN JUST ADDRESS LABELS
Create labels containing your own text and images for organising, products, boxes, name labels, return addresses and much more. Save reusable designs and templates for labels you print regularly.
PRINT OR SAVE AS PDF

bluejetty:00128718:ios.summary:
NPTE Prep 2026 is a test preparation app that will help you pass the National Physical Therapy Exam (NPTE) administered by the Federation of State Boards of Physical Therapy (FSBPT) with a high score on your first attempt! 
NPTE Prep 2026
bluejetty:00128718:ios.description:
NPTE Prep 2026 is a test preparation app that will help you pass the National Physical Therapy Exam (NPTE) administered by the Federation of State Boards of Physical Therapy (FSBPT) with a high score on your first attempt! 
NPTE Prep 2026 will not only help you gain insight into concepts related to NPTE exam preparation, but will also help you increase your confidence in passing the exam on your first try by practicing hundreds of exam-like questions. This app is available for NPTE Physical Therapist and Physical Therapist Assistant.
### Passing the test on the first attempt ###
In NPTE Prep 2026, there are a large number of questions prepared by test experts that cover the scope of the official test requirements. According to the test requirements, you must master several subjects in order to successfully pass the NPTE.
Specifically, these subjects include:
- Cardiovascular & Pulmonary Systems
- Musculoskeletal System
- Neuromuscular & Nervous Systems
- Integumentary System
- Metabolic & Endocrine Systems
- Gastrointestinal System
- Genitourinary System
- Lymphatic System
- System Interactions
- Equipment, Devices & Technologies
- Therapeutic Modalities
- Safety & Protection
- Professional Responsibilities
- Research & Evidence-Based Practice
To help you pass the exam, our test experts have carefully analyzed and broken down the above subjects. You will need to practice all 14 subjects, which will help you pass the exam with confidence!
### Key Features ###
- Over 1000 practice questions with detailed answer explanations for each question
- Specialized practice by content area, with the flexibility to switch between them at any time
- View analysis of your current performance in the "Statistics" section
The most important part of passing the NPTE exam is to keep practicing and not lose confidence in the exam. You will find that each time you practice on NPTE Prep 2026, your knowledge of the test increases, thus increasing your certainty of passing the test.
Set aside a certain amount of time each day to practice some questions while hinting to yourself that you will do the same tomorrow. After you develop good study habits, you will find it easier to pass and score high not only on the NPTE exam, but on any other exam!
### Purchases, Subscriptions and Terms ###
You will need to purchase at least one subscription to unlock access to all features, content areas, and questions. Once purchased, the cost will be deducted directly from your Apple account. Subscriptions will automatically renew and be charged based on the rate and term selected for the subscription plan. If you need to cancel your subscription, please do so no later than 24 hours before the end of the current term or your account will be automatically charged for renewal.
You can manage your subscription by turning off auto-renewal in your account settings in Apple after purchase. If a free trial period is offered, any unused portion will be forfeited at the time you purchase your subscription (if applicable).
Terms of Service - https://www.yesmaster.pro/Terms-of-service/
Privacy Policy - https://www.yesmaster.pro/Privacy-Policy/
If you have any questions or comments about your use, please email us at contact@yesmaster.pro and we will resolve them for you within 3 business days at the latest.

bluejetty:00070750:ios.name: Zones for Training
bluejetty:00070750:ios.summary:
Get the most out of your Apple Watch! Zones monitors your exercise intensity and visualize it in meaningful ways. Know your activities and be smart about how you work out.
Zones supports over 70 types of workouts like Running, Walking, Cy
bluejetty:00070750:ios.description:
Get the most out of your Apple Watch! Zones monitors your exercise intensity and visualize it in meaningful ways. Know your activities and be smart about how you work out.
Zones supports over 70 types of workouts like Running, Walking, Cycling, Treadmill, Exercise Bike, and Strength Training. Great for outdoor/indoor/gym workouts.
Measure it on your Apple Watch, review it on your iPhone. Efficient workouts with Zones!
------------------------------------------------
■ Features
------------------------------------------------
◎ Monitor real-time exercise intensity and heart rate during workouts. (Apple Watch only)
◎ Show your time spent in the four Heart Rate Zones.
◎ Display all workouts data from the Apple Health app, so that you can use Zones as a total workouts dashboard.
------------------------------------------------
■ Training With Heart Rate Zones
------------------------------------------------
Everybody has a different purpose for their training. Someone run for diet, someone ride for improving their cardio endurance. Exercising at the correct intensity can help you get the most out of your workouts.
This app shows you your exercise intensity using your real-time heart rate, and it has four heart rate zones to understand your exercise intensity at a glance.
• PEAK - for improving performance and speed.
• CARDIO - for improving cardio endurance.
• FAT BURN - For longer exercise. Predominantly uses fat for energy.
• WARM UP - For preparation and recovery.
With these four zones, you can start heart rate training very easily and quickly.
You don't have to remember your target heart rate or intensity %.
------------------------------------------------
■ Measuring with Apple Watch
------------------------------------------------
◎ Heart Rate and Exercise Intensity in real-time
• You can easily see which Heart Rate Zone you are in while exercise.
• Your Apple Watch taps you on the wrist when heart rate zone changes.
• Automatic pause/resume function (Running only) 
◎ Review your improvements with Recovery Heart Rate
Recovery Heart Rate is the difference between your exercising heart rate and your heart rate one minutes after the exercise has stopped.
It is a good indicator to gauge your fitness level!
This app measures it automatically right after your workouts. (Over CARDIO intensities only)
◎ Leave your iPhone at home
You can leave your iPhone at home when you go for training!
※ Measurement function is only available on the Apple Watch.
------------------------------------------------
■ Detailed Information of Your Workouts
------------------------------------------------
◎ Details of Workout
• Duration
• Active Calories
• Distance, Pace, Splits
• Time in heart rate zones
• Heart Rate and Exercise Intensity (Average, min/max heart rate)
• Graphs of heart rate and pace
• Show your workout on Widgets
◎ Insights (Graphs & Lists)
• Recent Workouts
• Weekly Calories Burned
• Top 10 Distance
• Running Pace
------------------------------------------------
■ Many Ways to Use Zones
------------------------------------------------
◎ Supports over 70 types of workouts
Running, Walking, Cycling, Core Training, Flexibility, Strength Training... and so on!
◎ Works great with other apps through the Apple Health
Zones reads all Workouts data from the Apple Health app, so you can use Zones as a total workouts dashboard.
In this way, you can continue using the apps you already love. Of course, you can see your workouts data from Apple Workouts app in Zones.
◎ Upgrade to PRO
• Stats (Weekly, Monthly, Yearly)
• Create & customize Insights
• Change Heart Rate Zones
• Create Custom Workouts (5 Zones)
• Edit Workout Name
------------------------------------------------
■ Required Device
------------------------------------------------
Apple Health is required to use.
For iPad, please update your OS to iPadOS 17 or higher.

bluejetty:00178473:ios.description:
Travel to a faraway and distant land nestled in the mountains, where mankind is often unseen, and stories of the ages unfold. 
You crash land in a very isolated, dense area in the forest. It appears to be another world - totally uncharted territory, where only outliers dwell.
With a backpack as your only supply, you start your journey through the vast woods, picking up clues on your expedition.
Along your way, you see visions of young children in the distance, waving you to keep moving along, as if there is a path and destiny to be reached.
Where did you come from? Who are these young children, and what are they leading you into?
The mystery of the Long Journey will unravel before your very eyes, and another improbable twist ending will unveil and leave you astounded, and wanting to discuss the turn of events that lead up to the epic finale...
Features Include:
Over 110 Gorgeous HDR Scenes from many places around the world, sewn together to bring you one stunning game.
Beautifully crafted music and sounds immerse you into a whole other world.
Captivating new storyline that builds up into an improbable twist ending!
Includes a Map System, Hints, Answers & other tips and tricks to help you along the way!

- Use the Subscription on any iPhone/iPad/ registered with your Apple Account
- Auto-renewal can be canceled anytime during the active subscription period

- Perfect for puzzle lovers of all ages
