bluejetty:00069923:ios.description:
Compex Coach App will guide you to set up your objectives, it will help you to plan your training and remind you when to have your next Compex session. Also, you can easily share your sessions with your friends.
Examples of objectives available*:
- Prepare for a 10km, half-marathon, marathon
- Prepare for a cycling race
- Prepare for a triathlon
- Improve your core stabilisation
- Increase your muscle volume
- Improve your strength
- Treat your tendinopathy
- Treat your cervical pain
- Treat your contracture
- Prevent cramps
- Prevent low back pain
- Tone your arms
- Firm your thighs
And many others...
App features:
- Find an objective that fits your needs (eg: Prepare for a marathon, triathlon or cycling race, Treat a back pain or tendinopathy, Increase your strength…) and set up the plan to reach it. 
- Show you the right electrode placements
- Display precise images of electrodes placements and body position according to the programme
- Explain how to manage the stimulation intensity according to the programme
- Provide all the details for each Compex programme (description, usages, effects, stimulation intensity, electrode placements)
- Explain how muscle stimulation works
For more information on Compex product, please visit our website www.compex.com
*Objectives availability related to the product
***This app doesn't control your Compex device, it is meant to be used as a standalone app***

- Higher product margins.

Sell on Etsy, Ebay, Walmart platforms, your own Shopify store and even wholesale for example on FAIRE. 
- Make business global. 
Expand your sales volumes and business geography including the markets of Europe, Asia, and India through the Amazon marketplace.
- Simple logistics with Amazon FBA. 
Amazon FBA will ensure that products are shipped to customers when they bought them through your website. 
- More marketing channels. 
Social networks, influencers, affiliate marketing to strengthening your brand.
Start a multi-million business under your own brand from a scratch. Create a capitalization business that you can attract investors or sell. You don't need a big team, we will cover all your needs in market analysis, manufacturers search, product branding and worldwide delivery.
Need more information? Contact our customer support via email: support@supplyleader.com

bluejetty:00132082:ios.name: Spirit Notes: Sermon & Bible
bluejetty:00132082:ios.summary: “I absolutely love Spirit Notes. When I’m in church, at a Bible study, or reflecting on my own, it makes capturing revelations effortless - verses drop in automatically, sermon audio is saved, and everything stays beautifully organized!” -
bluejetty:00132082:ios.description:
“I absolutely love Spirit Notes. When I’m in church, at a Bible study, or reflecting on my own, it makes capturing revelations effortless - verses drop in automatically, sermon audio is saved, and everything stays beautifully organized!” - Rachel
Spirit Notes is the original, purpose-built Christian note-taking app designed to support your faith journey every day. Keep every sermon, personal study, and small-group insight in one beautifully organized place. Express, organize, and share your walk with God - without juggling multiple apps.
Why Spirit Notes?
• Scripture Auto-complete: 
Type “John 3:16” (or any scripture reference) and the full verse appears instantly, right inside your note. Choose from many trusted translations including - NIV, ESV, NKJV, MSG, ASV, NIrV, NLT, CSB, TPT and KJV - no copy-and-paste, no Wi-Fi required.
• Record + Write Together: 
Capture high-quality audio and type notes in a single file. Stay present during the message and revisit every insight with ease afterward.
• Time-stamping: 
As you take notes, Spirit Notes automatically saves the exact time in the recording with each point you write. Later, just tap the timestamp next to your point to jump back and re-listen to the exact moment it was said in the sermon. This makes it easy to revisit important insights without wasting time searching through the entire audio.
• Organize Effortlessly:
 Quickly find notes with dedicated fields for preacher, sermon title, and more. Add tags to group by topic, and organize everything into notebooks for ministries, conferences, events, and beyond.
• Sharing:
 Spirit Notes keeps your recordings, text, scriptures, images, and more together in one place. Easily share everything in a single link with friends or family. They can read your notes, listen to the recording, and even add their own thoughts. It’s the simplest way to stay connected and grow together.
• Custom Bible Reader:
 Choose from dozens of fonts and unlimited color themes. Tap any highlighted verse to view every note you’ve ever made on that passage - perfect for quick cross-reference during study.
• Works Completely Offline:
 Spirit Notes is fully functional without an internet connection - perfect for retreats, mission trips, or places with limited service.
• Built for Christians, by Christians:
 Every feature is thoughtfully designed to enhance your experience and help you grow in your faith.
---
To allow you to try the app, you can create up to 5 notes with full access to all features - no sign-up required. If you find Spirit Notes helpful, you can unlock unlimited use by subscribing to Spirit Notes Pro with a monthly or yearly plan.
spiritnotes.com
Privacy Policy: spiritnotes.com/privacy
Terms of Service: spiritnotes.com/terms

bluejetty:00131449:ios.description:
Explore the world your way with the personalised Emirates App for iPhone and Apple Watch. 
1. SEARCH AND BOOK YOUR NEXT GETAWAY
Search for flights to over 150 destinations around the world, and complete your entire booking through the app.
2. MANAGE YOUR TRIP ON THE GO
Choose your meal and seat preference, and add services such as Chauffeur-drive. It’s easy to update your details, and you can view your full itinerary at any time - even when you’re offline.
3. DOWNLOAD YOUR BOARDING PASS
Check in online and download your boarding pass. You can print it, or send it to your phone via SMS or email to use it as a digital boarding pass.
On The Emirates App for iPhone and iPad you can download your boarding pass directly to Wallet.
4. GET REAL-TIME FLIGHT UPDATES
We’ll send you real-time information about your check-in, departure gate, boarding time, baggage belt and more, straight to your personal device. Tailor the app to your needs by choosing which notifications you want to receive.
5. GET THE MOST OUT OF EMIRATES SKYWARDS
Explore ways to earn and spend your Skywards Miles directly within the app. Enjoy easy access to information about your tier status, benefits and Skywards Miles balance, and manage your account wherever you are.
6. THE EMIRATES APP FOR APPLE WATCH 
Get live travel updates at a glance. The app reminds you when it’s time to board, lets you know if there’s a change to your flight and tells you where to pick up your bags when you land – all without you reaching for your phone.

bluejetty:00065632:ios.description:
Select is a next-generation membership card, concierge, and membership community offering exclusive and unlimited benefits with premier brands and venues at over 1.3 Million locations worldwide & online.
Benefits
Select partners with industry-leading brands and venues across categories to provide exclusive, ongoing benefits to our members. These include 15-30% off the bill or complimentary items (or both) at renowned restaurants, up to 60% off room rates at over a million hotels worldwide, VIP status and amenities with 5,000+ luxury resorts, and significant private discounts with leading travel, retail, lifestyle, entertainment, and business brands including Ferragamo, BMW, Mercedes, Tumi, Lazzoni, Herman Miller, Caraway, Google, Hubspot, UPS, and many more.
Events
Select hosts a variety of members-only events in major cities throughout the US and online. These range from complimentary cocktail hours and digital speaker series to major events during Art Week, Fashion Week, the Masters, award show pre-parties, and more.
Concierge
Members also gain access to the Select concierge team, who are available via live chat to assist with reservations and recommendations seven days per week. Select's in-house concierges are trained and knowledgeable about the various activities and experiences our members enjoy so that they can make informed recommendations and suggestions wherever they are.

bluejetty:00074167:ios.name: SkyDemon
bluejetty:00074167:ios.summary:
SkyDemon is Europe's favourite software for VFR flight planning and in-flight navigation.
Use this app to access your SkyDemon subscription on your iOS device, unlocking SkyDemon's powerful features while on the move.
FLIGHT PLANNING FEAT
bluejetty:00074167:ios.description:
SkyDemon is Europe's favourite software for VFR flight planning and in-flight navigation.
Use this app to access your SkyDemon subscription on your iOS device, unlocking SkyDemon's powerful features while on the move.
FLIGHT PLANNING FEATURES
- SkyDemon vector charts are the clearest aeronautical charts you'll ever use, with dynamic airspace clipping and choice of map layers
- Route planning is as simple as touching consecutive waypoints and dragging to make changes
- Virtual Radar shows how your route relates to airspace, terrain, obstructions and other features
- Pilot Log facility calculates headings and groundspeeds from actual wind data, and shows useful frequencies
- Plates and other documents for relevant airfields are displayed automatically as you plan, and many are available georeferenced for use in flight
- Intuitive pan, pinch and rotate support with no loss of map clarity or text legibility
- File a VFR flightplan for your route directly to air traffic controllers
- Automatic TAF, METAR and SIGMET briefing as you plan a route, with graphical decoding
- Rainfall data can be overlaid on the main map, with animation, showing the trend of rainfall over time
- Integration of GAFOR route forecasts for Switzerland, Austria, Slovenia and Croatia
- Both narrow-route and area NOTAM briefings available, updated as you plan
- Advanced NOTAM graphical interpretation and depiction on the main map
- Easily print your PLOG and the output from various briefings
- Warnings for airspace and other potential hazards to your flight, updated in real time
- Airfield Admin Information shows useful contacts and other details for airfields featured in our charts
- Forecast winds aloft are automatically retrieved for the flight time and displayed on the map
- Create an advanced flight performance profile for each aircraft you use
- ATS Routes mode offers an alternative chart presentation for flight along airways
- Accurate fuel, weight and balance calculations including flight costings
- Create an unlimited number of user-defined waypoints
- Analyse your track logs for posterity
- Choose between six different vector chart styles
- Extensive European chart coverage as standard
GPS NAVIGATION FEATURES
- Intelligent warnings for approaching airspace, NOTAM, obstacles, terrain and other hazards
- Virtual Radar shows a side-on projection of all approaching features and how your trajectory relates to them
- Vector map automatically follows the aircraft in north up, track up or course up orientation
- Clear and concise instruments show you flight statistics and help keep you on track
- An HSI/ILS instrument helps you keep to your planned route and line up early for approach
- Live Pilot Log shows progress through your route, ETAs, ATAs and useful frequencies based on your current position
- TerrainSafe dynamically colours mountainous terrain around you to quickly identify safer areas
- Direct To allows easy re-routing in a hurry by picking from a selection of nearby airfields
- Approach Information shows runway diagrams, TAF, METAR, NOTAM and other airfield details useful for making an approach
- Live updates of TAF and METAR while in flight, with associated alerts*
- Extended runway centrelines appear automatically on the map as you near your destination airfield
- Permanent display of position relative to nearest well-known waypoint, for position reporting
- Easy changing of the planned route while in flight by touching and dragging
Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.
* Internet connection required for live weather update while in flight

bluejetty:00173564:ios.description:
Upscale 4x uses AI technology to restore low-resolution, poor-quality images, generating up to 800% enlarged high-definition restored images. Its core features include:
-Resolution enhancement
With Upscale 4x, you can enlarge an image and increase its resolution by 200%, 400%, or 800%.
-Portrait restoration
By introducing Face AI technology, even images with low-resolution faces of poor quality can be transformed into clear, realistic high-definition images.
-Detail preservation
We remove the noise in the image, retain the textures within the image, and enhance them in a way that looks realistic when the image is enlarged.
Examples of usage scenarios:
-For professional users. 
Easily create the high-definition images you need from poor quality images, from portraits to landscapes, from product images to PPT illustrations.
-For e-commerce. 
Configure clearer images for products.
-For personal users. 
Enhance the quality of poor-quality images from social apps by 400%, transforming blurry character avatars into high-definition large images. Even old, cracked photos can be restored to high-definition new photos through image restoration.
-For anime users. 
Convert low-resolution anime images into high-quality anime without loss.

◆ Game features ◆
• FREE CHIPS—Play the game every day to get free chips!
• POKER AGAINST THE CASINO—Get 7 cards and split them into two hands, one hand of 5 cards and one hand of 2 cards. To win Pai Gow Poker, both of your hands have to be better than the dealer's!
• HONE YOUR STRATEGY—Feel the thrill of Pai Gow in the familiar classic casino atmosphere! Your 5-card hand needs to be better than your 2-card hand. Everything else is up to you. Refine your skills in Pai Gow and win!
• PLACE SIDE BETS—Want to win even more chips? Side bets help you win regardless of who wins the hand! Any combination from three of a kind and better makes you a Pai Gow Poker winner!
• INSURANCE BET—In Pai Gow Poker, you can win with any cards in your hands! Even if your cards can't make a combination, you can still get a payout from an Insurance bet!
• PLAY WITH A JOKER—Every Pai Gow Poker deck in our casino has a joker! The joker allows you to collect a straight or flush, replacing a missing card. If there are no combinations, the joker replaces an ace to make your chances of winning at the Pai Gow table even higher!
• PVE CASINO GAMES—Play other casino games, all in one app: three-card poker, blackjack, Ultimate Hold'em, roulette, baccarat, slots, video poker, craps, Keno, and Chinese Pai Gow Poker!
• VIP LEVELS—Get huge bonuses and exclusive access to the latest in-game features!
• FAIR PLAY GUARANTEED—All our games use a Random Number Generator (RNG) and are certified by independent experts. We guarantee the best and fairest Pai Gow Poker experience!
• CHAT WITH OTHER PLAYERS—Have even more fun at the casino tables with our convenient in-game chat, instant messenger, and animated emojis. Discuss the hands played or share your emotions with your Pai Gow Poker opponents and friends!
• REFERRAL SYSTEM—Invite your friends to play Pai Gow Poker, and everyone will get a reward!
• BUILD YOUR PROFILE—Share your successes with friends. Show off how many games you've played, your biggest wins, level, card collections, achievements, property and trophies!
• UNIQUE AVATAR—Create a one-of-a-kind look in the avatar editor to show off at pool tables.
• QUESTS—Complete daily quests to get free chips!
• EASY TO LEARN—New to Pai Gow but always wanted to try it? Our simple-to-follow tutorial mode will help you take the first steps in Pai Gow Poker!
• NO REGISTRATION—Choose guest mode to play poker against the house immediately after installing the game!
• SINGLE ACCOUNT—Play on different devices. Choose the authorization method that works best for you and start playing Pai Gow Poker right away for free!
Want more than Pai Gow Poker?
Try our other games for an unforgettable 3D experience:
• TEXAS HOLD'EM POKER—The most popular casino game among professional players! Test your skills in amazing poker tournaments!
• BLACKJACK—A simple game of "21". An exciting 3D game that any blackjack fan is sure to enjoy.
• SLOTS—Explore our themed slots with lots of unique features!
• SET POKER—Play poker with three cards against the dealer! Place combination bets and win tons of chips!
• OMAHA POKER—A more dynamic version of poker with 4 cards in a hand. Have more fun with amazing combinations!
• ULTIMATE HOLD'EM—Get two cards and play poker against the dealer in this dynamic PvE variant of Texas Hold'em. The strongest poker combination wins!
This game is only available to users of legal age. The game offers no possibility of winning money or anything of value. Success in playing this game does not imply your success in a similar real-money casino game.

bluejetty:00025324:ios.name: Faraday Future
bluejetty:00025324:ios.summary:
Join the Conversation. 
Engage with like-minded users and EV enthusiasts in the automotive industry’s truly unique, intelligent ecosystem application. The FF App is the best place to communicate and share ideas with fellow Futurists as well
bluejetty:00025324:ios.description:
Join the Conversation. 
Engage with like-minded users and EV enthusiasts in the automotive industry’s truly unique, intelligent ecosystem application. The FF App is the best place to communicate and share ideas with fellow Futurists as well as key FF employees. 
Share and Co-create. 
The FF App is the primary channel for all users to come together and deliver feedback on our ultimate, intelligent, tech luxury FF 91. If you’re looking for more, become a Futurist Product Officer (FPO) and work with FF employees to see your dreams realized. FPOs, exclusive events, Co-creation opportunities, and more are within the app. Be among the first to experience the FF 91 and help shape the future of mobility, together. 
Live Updates and Latest News. 
Whether you’re an EV enthusiast, a fan, an investor, or just love technology, the Faraday Future Intelligent App is your go to platform for all FF related news and content. Official press releases, exclusive FFInsider interviews, as well as interactive, behind the scenes livestreams are all available on the app, sometimes, exclusively from our other channels. 
Interact and Grow. 
Through the FF app’s exciting ieAwards program, you will receive special recognition for your contributions to the FF ecosystem. Certain actions will award you with Growth Value to track your status as a Futurist and place you among others on a leaderboard. FF Points are distributed and serve as a form of incentive to be used within the FF ecosystem. Complete special tasks to receive commemorative ieMedals to celebrate achievements and be recognized by other passionate users. 
This is just the beginning. 
With a dedicated team of top level developers, new updates and features are released regularly. Faraday Future is built upon the pillar of Co-creation, so download today, make your voice heard, and join us on this journey towards the Future.

bluejetty:00095845:ios.summary: Cat Translator is the ultimate app for playful communication, sound-based training, and fun interaction with your feline. Translate your voice into cat language, decode meows, and explore our interactive soundboard filled with AI-powered ca
bluejetty:00095845:ios.description:
Cat Translator is the ultimate app for playful communication, sound-based training, and fun interaction with your feline. Translate your voice into cat language, decode meows, and explore our interactive soundboard filled with AI-powered cat sounds and training tools.
Choose from a variety of realistic cat sound effects, including meows, hisses, purrs, and more. Each sound is paired with expressive cat emojis to keep things fun and engaging. The smart AI translator turns your words into attention-grabbing sounds, while meow-to-human mode helps you interpret what your cat might be trying to say. Perfect for both entertainment and behavioral engagement.
Whether you're training a kitten or just having fun, Cat Translator makes it easy to connect with your cat using playful cues and audio feedback.
Key Features:
1. Translate your voice into cat language using AI-powered sounds
2. Decode your cat’s meows into human phrases with AI-based meow recognition
3. Play meows, hisses, and purrs using a fun emoji soundboard
4. Use playful AI training sounds to grab attention or reinforce behavior
5. Save and replay translations for repeated use or interactive play
Why Cat Translator:
• Built for cat lovers who want a fun, smart way to connect
• Uses advanced AI algorithms to generate and interpret realistic cat sounds
• Ideal for training, bonding, or sparking curiosity in your cat
• Includes realistic feline sounds and reactions to engage your pet
• Helps you build a stronger connection through interactive audio feedback
• Combines AI, sound, and fun in one cat-friendly experience
Whether you're experimenting with cat translation or using sounds to engage, Cat Translator gives you the tools to better communicate with your furry friend. From playful meows to training tones, it’s the translator that makes bonding more fun, effective, and rewarding.
Privacy Policy: https://www.onerack.nl/apps/cat-translator/privacy-policy
Terms Of Service: https://www.onerack.nl/apps/cat-translator/terms-and-conditions

bluejetty:00015119:ios.name: Collins-Robert Concise
bluejetty:00015119:ios.summary:
57,000 headwords and more than 190,000 translations • more than 90,000 phrases • full conjugations for thousands of French and English verbs • hundreds of usage notes and examples • no internet connection required
Carry a dependable French
bluejetty:00015119:ios.description:
57,000 headwords and more than 190,000 translations • more than 90,000 phrases • full conjugations for thousands of French and English verbs • hundreds of usage notes and examples • no internet connection required
Carry a dependable French and English reference everywhere you go with the latest edition of the Collins Pro French-English Translation Dictionary. This app combines detailed, professional dictionary data from HarperCollins and Le Robert with our new, easy-to-use Ultralingua interface. Our smart search goes beyond dictionary entries to give you complete conjugations of thousands of verbs in all standard forms, convert numerals into French or English text instantly, and catch common misspellings to get you to the word you are looking for faster than ever.
DICTIONARY:
• Over 57,000 entries with 190,000 translations
• Over 90,000 example phrases
• Tap-and-hold any word or phrase and choose "Speak" from the popup menu to hear that word spoken using Apple's built-in text-to-speech feature.
• Genders for all French nouns
• Idioms, slang, technical language, and regional differences in spelling and usage
• Hundreds of usage notes about troublesome constructions
• Dozens of cultural notes
• Smart search results in both French and English simultaneously, in case you misspell or mistype
• Search-as-you-go displays words and narrows your selection as you type
• Tap on a word in a definition to quickly look it up, conjugate it, or copy it to your clipboard. This features recognizes inflected forms and chooses the correct language for you.
• Search the dictionary by speaking to Apple’s Siri on applicable devices
VERBS:
• Conjugations for thousands of French and English verbs
• Includes all standard tenses and forms
• Displays the direct translation of each conjugation when available
• Smart search finds infinitives and catches misspellings
• View verb conjugations in a single tense or expand a verb to view all conjugations in one user-friendly format
MORE:
• Translates numerals into French and English text as you type
• Language swapper button to switch from French-English to English-French with ease
• Tap the history button to view the 50 most recent dictionary definitions, verb conjugations, and more in one place. Sort the list alphabetically or by date, and choose to clear the list completely or delete one entry at a time.
• Favorite individual definitions and verbs and view them by tapping on the favorites button.
• No internet connection required
• Change your device settings to view the app display in English, Spanish, French, Italian, Portuguese, or German
This universal app will run on iPad, iPhone, and iPod touch, so you can purchase it once and load it onto all your devices. The iPad and iPhone/iPod touch versions look and behave differently to give you a great experience on every device you own. The Collins Robert Concise French Dictionary is a must-have reference tool for students and language professionals alike.
REVIEWS:
(5 stars) "Best French dictionary ever - In the 30 years that I have been studying and using French I have yet to find a better French-English dictionary, whether in-print, online or an app. This app is totally worth the price." -User review
(5 stars) "Wonderful for an high intermediate reader like me who often needs a clarification but doesn't want to haul around a heavy dictionary. The interface is great because it anticipates the word as you type and if your French spelling is weak - like mine is - it saves a lot of time." -User review

http://www.twitter.com/ultralingua

bluejetty:00175245:ios.description:
Playing Words of Paradise 10 minutes a day boosts your mental prowess and takes you away from daily stress! 
Enjoy word puzzles while immersing yourself into beautiful nature sceneries from around the world; it’s entertaining and calming! 
Connect letters and find all words to complete the crosswords! Your vocabulary will be boosted while you relax your mind!
Do you like word connect and word search games? Words of Paradise is the only word game you need; you won’t be able to put it down! With more than 5000 word-puzzle levels, 300 inspiring locations to discover, you won’t run out of fun!
Our game is free to play, nothing in our word game is behind a paywall, for now and for all future updates.
GAME FEATURES:
► Easy and Fun Gameplay! Just slide your finger to connect the letters in order to form words. No actual typing will be involved!
► So Many Levels! We have over 5000 puzzle levels waiting for you. Don’t worry about getting stuck, you can always use hints to get past most challenging puzzles.
► Lots of Word Quiz levels to challenge your grammar and fix your spelling mistakes!
► Best Word Game Dictionaries! Carefully selected by experts to challenge you in a fun way!
► A game designed to train your brain, boost your memory and upgrade your intellectual capacity!
► Available in more than 30 languages! Improve and study any language you desire!
► Mini game levels to spice up your gameplay experience and earn you rich rewards quickly!
► See stunning places that you have not heard of before! From majestic mountains to lush rain forests, crystal-clear lakes to rushing rivers, and colorful sunsets to dazzling starry nights explore the beauty of nature, and discover the magic and wonder of our planet!
► Suitable for all ages, kids and adults alike. Supported on both phone and tablet. A game for everyone, everywhere, anytime!

bluejetty:00091649:ios.description:
Print from your Phone, Pick up at Walgreens Photo Partner, CVS, and Duane Reade!
Introducing the one-stop solution for your photo printing needs - Same Day Prints! With this amazing app, you can now print your favorite photos directly from your phone and pick them up in just one hour at over 16,000 retailers nationwide. Whether you need prints for your scrapbook, photo album, or just to decorate your wall, Same Day Prints can make the process quick and easy.
The app is incredibly user-friendly, with an intuitive interface that makes it easy to select your photos, choose your print size, crop and adjust the images, and place your order. Print and create with photos on your phone. Choose from many pre-designed cards and create a last minute gift, ready in just 1 hour at a store near you.
With Same Day Prints, you can rest assured that your prints will be of the highest quality, with vibrant colors, sharp details, and excellent clarity. Plus, you can choose from a variety of pickup locations, including CVS, Walgreens Photo Partner, and Duane Reade, making it convenient to get your prints wherever and whenever you need them.
So why wait? Download Same Day Prints today and start printing your favorite photos in no time!
Products vary by location please refer to the lists below --
PHOTO PRODUCTS VARY BY STORE
- CVS -
Photo Prints: Glossy and Matte 4x6, 5x5, 5x7, 6x6, 6x8, 8x8 8x10 prints. 2x3 wallet prints
Photo Print Enlargements and Posters: 11x14, 16x20, 20x24, 24x36
Photo Mugs: 11 and 15 oz Photo mug
Metallic Prints: 11x14, 12x16, 12x18, 16x20, 18x24, 20x24, 20x30, 24x36
Greeting Cards: 4x8 photo greeting cards or holiday cards
Canvas Prints: 5x7, 8x8, 8x10, 11x14, 16x20 Canvas photo prints, 11x14 Framed Canvas
Board Prints: 11x14,16x20 Board Prints
Mounted Photo Panels: 4x6, 6x8, 8x10 photo panels, 8x10 acrylic panel
Bamboo Photo Panels: 8x10 Bamboo Panel
Hanging Canvas: 11x14 Hanging Canvas Print
Magnets: 4x6 Photo Magnet
Photo Books: 4x6 photo book (10 photos), 8.5x11 Layflat Photo Book
Wall Tides: 8x8 Wall Tile Photo Prints
Photo Collages: 5x7, 8x10 Multi Layout Collage Photo Prints
Acrylic Collage Panel: 8x10 Multi Layout Acrylic Collage Panel
Bamboo Collage: 8x10 Multi Layout Acrylic Collage Panel
Other Photo Gifts: Double-sided (2x2) bamboo ornament, 2x2 Cube Ornament, 3x3 Photo cube, 11x13 Photo Puzzle, Tumbler, Can Cooler
- Walgreens Photo Partner -
Photo Prints: 4x4, 4x6, 5x5, 5x7, 8x8, 8x10 prints
Holiday Cards: 4x8 Holiday Cars (Set of 20)
Photo Canvas: 8x10, 11x14, 12x12, 16x20 photo wrapped canvas
Enlargements: 11x14, 16x20, 20x30, 24x36 Enlargements/Poster
Wood Panel: 5x7, 8x10 wood panel photo prints
Metal Panel: 11x14 Metal Panel Prints
Board Prints: 11x14, 16x20 and 20x30 Board Prints
Mouse pad, Photo Puzzles
HOW TO PRINT
1. Start by downloading our Same Day Prints app to your iPhone.
2. After downloading open the app and choose between CVS, Walgreens Photo Partner, or Home Delivery.
3. Select the product you’d like to print. Products vary depending on your chosen retail store (refer to the list above).
4. Upload photos from your camera roll to our app. Once uploaded, choose which photo you want to print. When selected a green check mark appears on the bottom right corner.
5. You can choose your desired dimensions and quantity by selecting the red box down below.
6. After you add your selected product to the cart, tap “find your store” and select you’re the best store in proximity to your location.
7. Enter your name, email, and phone number and review your order. No Credit Card Necessary. (Credit Card or PayPal need in case of Home delivery.)
8. Once your order is placed, you will receive an email in less than 1 hour letting you know your order is ready!
9. Pay when you review your photos at the store you selected and enjoy the rest of your day!

apple-macos:1516358085.name: TT Algebra 2
apple-macos:1516358085.description:
The Teaching Textbooks Algebra 2 app makes your TT course even better! Not only will your student enjoy math while learning independently, but, with the app, that learning can also take place on the go. Even when offline! Specifically, the app can be used offline for up to 6 lessons at a time. That makes it perfect for homeschool parents who need their kids to stay productive while the family is out and about during the day.
The app’s other features include…
• 137 audiovisual lectures that teach every core concept in the standard 11th grade curriculum
• thousands of problems that give students all the practice they need to master each concept
• automated grading and instant feedback for every single problem
• step-by-step audiovisual explanations to every single problem so students can see exactly what they did wrong when mistakes are made (This makes the program feel as if a tutor is at the student’s side!)
• parental controls that let you track your student’s progress
• the digitized version of the printed Teaching Textbooks Algebra 2 textbook (with a search feature and a hyper-linked index)
• no advertising or in-app purchase offers
• Internet connectivity is required, but you can remain offline for up to 6 lessons.

apple-macos:6474945380.name: Pocket Reader: Read Later
apple-macos:6474945380.description:
Pocket Reader - This is a reading app that does not require account registration or login, offering an extremely simple and easy-to-use interface.
Core Features:
Save web content you plan to read later or valuable content you have already read and want to keep.
Design Philosophy:
Pocket Reader is designed with the best user experience in mind. We understand the burden that new account registrations impose on users, so unlike apps like Instapaper, Feedly, or Readwise, Pocket Reader does not require users to register a separate account.
Users can continue using their Apple ID, leveraging the powerful capabilities of iCloud for cloud synchronization. This is what we believe to be the natural usage pattern for such an app.
Key Features:
- Save any URL: Simply enter the content URL.
- iCloud Cloud Sync: Sync your saved articles across multiple devices.
- Multi-device Support: Whether you use an iPhone, iPad, or Mac, your data is synchronized across devices.
We are continuously developing more features, including support for additional languages, categorization by tags, reading data analytics, and more, aiming to provide an even better product for our users.
